title: 写作精修｜复合句、介词与中式英语纠错 · 1000 题
description: 40 个单元覆盖复合句骨架、介词搭配、各类从句、非谓语、中式英语纠错、论证边界、段落展开、IELTS 写作、图表流程与句子精修。每题均含独立语境和具体讲解。

items.zh: 委员会接受了短期成本会上升这一点，但认为长期收益足以证明改革合理。
items.en: The committee accepted that costs would rise in the short term but concluded that the long-term benefits justified the reform.
answers: The committee accepted that costs would rise in the short term but concluded that the long-term benefits justified the reform.
items.notes: 两个 that 从句分别作 accepted 和 concluded 的宾语；but 对照承认与结论。

items.zh: 图书馆延长了开放时间，因为许多走读学生晚上才有安静的学习场所。
items.en: The library extended its opening hours because many commuting students have access to a quiet study space only in the evening.
answers: The library extended its opening hours because many commuting students have access to a quiet study space only in the evening.
items.notes: because 从句给出具体原因；only 修饰时间范围。

items.zh: 市政府修复了旧剧院，同时保留了使它具有地方特色的砖墙。
items.en: The council restored the old theatre while preserving the brick walls that give it its local character.
answers: The council restored the old theatre while preserving the brick walls that give it its local character.
items.notes: while doing 表示伴随措施，that 从句限定 brick walls。

items.zh: 虽然试点项目规模不大，但结果足以支持开展更大范围的测试。
items.en: Although the pilot was small, its results were strong enough to support a larger trial.
answers: Although the pilot was small, its results were strong enough to support a larger trial.
items.notes: although 引出让步；strong enough to 表示程度足以产生后续行动。

items.zh: 如果学校取消所有截止日期，那些需要明确安排的学生反而可能更难完成任务。
items.en: If schools remove every deadline, students who need clear structure may find it harder to complete their work.
answers: If schools remove every deadline, students who need clear structure may find it harder to complete their work.
items.notes: if 引出真实条件，who 从句限定受影响的学生。

items.zh: 新的公交线路开通后，住在河对岸的员工通勤时间缩短了。
items.en: Once the new bus route opened, employees who live across the river had a shorter journey to work.
answers: Once the new bus route opened, employees who live across the river had a shorter journey to work.
items.notes: once 说明时间节点，who 从句补充员工范围。

items.zh: 研究人员没有公布初步数字，以免未经核实的结果被当作最终结论。
items.en: The researchers did not release the preliminary figures in case unverified results were mistaken for final conclusions.
answers: The researchers did not release the preliminary figures in case unverified results were mistaken for final conclusions.
items.notes: in case 在此表示防范风险；be mistaken for 表示被误认为。

items.zh: 我们可以在今天仓促决定，也可以等到供应商回答仍未解决的问题后再决定。
items.en: We can either decide in haste today or wait until the supplier answers the questions that remain unresolved.
answers: We can either decide in haste today or wait until the supplier answers the questions that remain unresolved.
items.notes: either ... or 连接两个选择；until 和 that 从句共同限定等待条件。

items.zh: 该政策不仅降低了申请费用，还简化了首次申请者最容易混淆的表格。
items.en: The policy not only reduced the application fee but also simplified the form that first-time applicants find most confusing.
answers: The policy not only reduced the application fee but also simplified the form that first-time applicants find most confusing.
items.notes: not only ... but also 保持并列成分一致；that 作 find 的宾语。

items.zh: 由于传感器在寒冷环境中失灵，工程师重新检查了此前被视为异常值的数据。
items.en: Because the sensor failed in cold conditions, the engineers re-examined the data that had previously been treated as outliers.
answers: Because the sensor failed in cold conditions, the engineers re-examined the data that had previously been treated as outliers.
items.notes: because 说明原因；过去完成时表示被判为异常值发生在重新检查之前。

items.zh: 等合同经过法律审查后，我们才能确认哪些条款需要修改。
items.en: We cannot confirm which clauses require revision until the contract has been reviewed by a lawyer.
answers: We cannot confirm which clauses require revision until the contract has been reviewed by a lawyer.
items.notes: not ... until 表示前置条件；which clauses 为宾语从句，使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 凡是无法在线提交文件的人，都可以预约到服务台办理。
items.en: Anyone who cannot submit the documents online may book an appointment at the service desk.
answers: Anyone who cannot submit the documents online may book an appointment at the service desk.
items.notes: anyone who 构成范围明确的主语；at the service desk 表示办理地点。

items.zh: 这项规定听起来很简单，然而它如何适用于临时员工仍不清楚。
items.en: The rule sounds simple, yet how it applies to temporary staff remains unclear.
answers: The rule sounds simple, yet how it applies to temporary staff remains unclear.
items.notes: yet 连接转折；how 引导的名词性从句作主语。

items.zh: 即使调查回复率有所提高，样本也未必能代表整个社区。
items.en: Even if the survey response rate improves, the sample may not represent the community as a whole.
answers: Even if the survey response rate improves, the sample may not represent the community as a whole.
items.notes: even if 强调即便条件成立，结论仍受限制。

items.zh: 为了让读者判断证据是否可靠，报告说明了数据是如何收集的。
items.en: So that readers can judge whether the evidence is reliable, the report explains how the data were collected.
answers: So that readers can judge whether the evidence is reliable, the report explains how the data were collected.
items.notes: so that 表示目的；whether 和 how 分别引导嵌套的宾语从句。

items.zh: 价格上涨并不是因为原料短缺，而是因为运输合同到期了。
items.en: Prices rose not because the material was scarce but because the transport contract had expired.
answers: Prices rose not because the material was scarce but because the transport contract had expired.
items.notes: not because ... but because 准确对照被否定与真正原因。

items.zh: 只要居民提前收到通知，夜间施工就不太可能引起严重投诉。
items.en: Provided that residents receive advance notice, overnight construction is unlikely to cause serious complaints.
answers: Provided that residents receive advance notice, overnight construction is unlikely to cause serious complaints.
items.notes: provided that 表示条件；receive advance notice 是自然搭配。

items.zh: 尽管两种方案预算相近，它们给低收入家庭带来的影响却截然不同。
items.en: Whereas the two plans have similar budgets, their effects on low-income households are markedly different.
answers: Whereas the two plans have similar budgets, their effects on low-income households are markedly different.
items.notes: whereas 突出同一比较框架中的反差。

items.zh: 评审小组要求作者删去无法由所引证据支持的主张。
items.en: The review panel asked the author to remove claims that could not be supported by the evidence cited.
answers: The review panel asked the author to remove claims that could not be supported by the evidence cited.
items.notes: ask someone to do 表示要求；两个后置成分分别限定 claims 和 evidence。

items.zh: 无论设备是买的还是租的，操作者都必须记录每次安全检查。
items.en: Whether the equipment is purchased or leased, operators must record every safety inspection.
answers: Whether the equipment is purchased or leased, operators must record every safety inspection.
items.notes: whether ... or 引出两种均不改变主句义务的情况。

items.zh: 我们越早识别瓶颈，就越有时间在需求达到高峰前解决它。
items.en: The earlier we identify the bottleneck, the more time we will have to address it before demand peaks.
answers: The earlier we identify the bottleneck, the more time we will have to address it before demand peaks.
items.notes: the + 比较级，the + 比较级表达联动变化；before 从句不用将来时。

items.zh: 这个平台很受欢迎，并不意味着所有用户都能轻松使用它。
items.en: The fact that the platform is popular does not mean that every user can navigate it easily.
answers: The fact that the platform is popular does not mean that every user can navigate it easily.
items.notes: the fact that 作主语；第二个 that 从句作 mean 的宾语。

items.zh: 由于没有说明缺失数据的处理方法，该分析无法被独立复现。
items.en: Since the treatment of missing data was not explained, the analysis cannot be independently reproduced.
answers: Since the treatment of missing data was not explained, the analysis cannot be independently reproduced.
items.notes: since 引出原因；the treatment of 指处理方式，而非 treatment to。

items.zh: 这家企业承诺会回收旧设备，但没有说明回收费用由谁承担。
items.en: The company promised to collect old equipment but did not specify who would bear the cost of collection.
answers: The company promised to collect old equipment but did not specify who would bear the cost of collection.
items.notes: but 连接同一主语的两个谓语；who 引导间接疑问。

items.zh: 除非指南同时提供实例，否则增加更多规则未必能减少误解。
items.en: Unless the guidance also provides examples, adding more rules may not reduce misunderstanding.
answers: Unless the guidance also provides examples, adding more rules may not reduce misunderstanding.
items.notes: unless 表示必要条件；动名词短语 adding more rules 作主语。

items.zh: 旧系统速度慢，但运行稳定；新系统速度更快，却仍会偶尔丢失记录。
items.en: The old system is slow but stable; the new one is faster, yet it still loses records occasionally.
answers: The old system is slow but stable; the new one is faster, yet it still loses records occasionally.
items.notes: 分号连接两个关系紧密的独立分句；one 代替 system。

items.zh: 请先核对发票，因为金额已经更正，但银行信息没有变化。
items.en: Please check the invoice first, because the amount has been corrected but the bank details remain unchanged.
answers: Please check the invoice first, because the amount has been corrected but the bank details remain unchanged.
items.notes: because 管辖整个原因分句；but 在从句内对照变更与未变更内容。

items.zh: 委员会可以推迟表决，也可以附带条件批准该计划；两种选择都有成本。
items.en: The committee can postpone the vote or approve the plan with conditions; either choice carries a cost.
answers: The committee can postpone the vote or approve the plan with conditions; either choice carries a cost.
items.notes: or 并列选择，分号后的 either choice 概括前述两项。

items.zh: 道路已经重新开放，不过路面仍然湿滑，因此司机应降低车速。
items.en: The road has reopened, but the surface remains slippery, so drivers should reduce their speed.
answers: The road has reopened, but the surface remains slippery, so drivers should reduce their speed.
items.notes: but 和 so 分别表达转折与结果，逻辑顺序清楚。

items.zh: 我们删去了重复的问题，并把技术术语改成了普通参与者能理解的说法。
items.en: We removed the repeated questions and replaced the technical terms with wording that ordinary participants could understand.
answers: We removed the repeated questions and replaced the technical terms with wording that ordinary participants could understand.
items.notes: and 连接两项平行动作；replace A with B 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 灯光很暗，录音也不完整；尽管如此，两份证词在关键时间点上是一致的。
items.en: The lighting was poor, and the recording was incomplete; nevertheless, the two accounts agreed on the crucial timing.
answers: The lighting was poor, and the recording was incomplete; nevertheless, the two accounts agreed on the crucial timing.
items.notes: 分号后用 nevertheless 连接完整句；agree on 表示对某一点意见一致。

items.zh: 这项补贴不会覆盖装修费用，也不能用于偿还已经产生的债务。
items.en: The grant will not cover renovation costs, nor can it be used to repay debts already incurred.
answers: The grant will not cover renovation costs, nor can it be used to repay debts already incurred.
items.notes: 否定分句后用 nor 引起部分倒装。

items.zh: 我原以为会议在楼上；事实上，前台把我们带到了院子里的临时会场。
items.en: I had assumed that the meeting was upstairs; in fact, reception directed us to a temporary venue in the courtyard.
answers: I had assumed that the meeting was upstairs; in fact, reception directed us to a temporary venue in the courtyard.
items.notes: 过去完成时标明原先假设；in fact 修正预期。

items.zh: 先确定哪些数据是必要的，然后再决定应当保留多久。
items.en: First determine which data are necessary; then decide how long they should be retained.
answers: First determine which data are necessary; then decide how long they should be retained.
items.notes: 分号分开连续步骤；which 和 how long 使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 报告批评了审批流程，而不是一线员工；因此，回复不应把责任推给个人。
items.en: The report criticised the approval process, not frontline staff; therefore, the response should not place blame on individuals.
answers: The report criticised the approval process, not frontline staff; therefore, the response should not place blame on individuals.
items.notes: 插入的 not 界定批评对象；therefore 后接完整结果句。

items.zh: 通知既没有说明入口在哪里，也没有提供需要帮助时可拨打的电话。
items.en: The notice neither explained where the entrance was nor provided a number to call if assistance was needed.
answers: The notice neither explained where the entrance was nor provided a number to call if assistance was needed.
items.notes: neither ... nor 连接两个谓语；间接问句不用倒装。

items.zh: 我们可以扩大停车场，不过这会占用绿地；或者，我们可以改善公交接驳。
items.en: We could enlarge the car park, but this would take up green space; alternatively, we could improve bus connections.
answers: We could enlarge the car park, but this would take up green space; alternatively, we could improve bus connections.
items.notes: alternatively 明确引出另一方案，避免连续使用 but。

items.zh: 样品在运输途中受损，所以实验室没有检测它们，而是要求重新取样。
items.en: The samples were damaged in transit, so the laboratory did not test them but requested a fresh collection.
answers: The samples were damaged in transit, so the laboratory did not test them but requested a fresh collection.
items.notes: so 说明决定的原因；not A but B 对照实际处理。

items.zh: 这不是一个完美的指标，却是目前唯一能在所有地区以相同方式测量的指标。
items.en: This is not a perfect measure, but it is the only one that can currently be applied consistently across all regions.
answers: This is not a perfect measure, but it is the only one that can currently be applied consistently across all regions.
items.notes: but 承认局限后说明采用理由；that 限定 one。

items.zh: 培训免费，而且无需具备相关经验；不过，参加者必须自备安全鞋。
items.en: The training is free, and no previous experience is required; however, participants must provide their own safety footwear.
answers: The training is free, and no previous experience is required; however, participants must provide their own safety footwear.
items.notes: however 前用分号，后用逗号；must 表达明确义务。

items.zh: 投诉数量下降了，可满意度并未上升，这表明两个指标衡量的并非同一件事。
items.en: The number of complaints fell, yet satisfaction did not rise, which suggests that the two measures capture different things.
answers: The number of complaints fell, yet satisfaction did not rise, which suggests that the two measures capture different things.
items.notes: yet 表示反预期，which 回指前面整件事并引出推论。

items.zh: 修订后的表格更短，也更容易阅读，但它仍然要求申请人提供同样多的证明材料。
items.en: The revised form is shorter and easier to read, but it still requires applicants to provide the same amount of supporting evidence.
answers: The revised form is shorter and easier to read, but it still requires applicants to provide the same amount of supporting evidence.
items.notes: and 并列两个比较项，but 指出实质负担未减。

items.zh: 请不要只报告平均值；中位数也很重要，因为少数极端值会拉高平均数。
items.en: Do not report the mean alone; the median also matters because a few extreme values can pull the mean upwards.
answers: Do not report the mean alone; the median also matters because a few extreme values can pull the mean upwards.
items.notes: 分号将建议与理由连接；because 解释中位数的价值。

items.zh: 经理认可问题的严重性，也道了歉，不过没有承诺具体的解决日期。
items.en: The manager acknowledged the seriousness of the problem and apologised, but gave no firm date for resolving it.
answers: The manager acknowledged the seriousness of the problem and apologised, but gave no firm date for resolving it.
items.notes: 三个动作不是机械并列；but 突出回应中缺失的关键信息。

items.zh: 游客人数有所恢复，酒店入住率却依旧偏低；一种可能的解释是停留时间变短了。
items.en: Visitor numbers have recovered, whereas hotel occupancy remains low; one possible explanation is that stays have become shorter.
answers: Visitor numbers have recovered, whereas hotel occupancy remains low; one possible explanation is that stays have become shorter.
items.notes: whereas 对照两个指标；that 从句说明假设而非既定事实。

items.zh: 该软件会标出拼写错误，却识别不了语气是否适合收件人。
items.en: The software can flag spelling errors, but it cannot judge whether the tone suits the intended reader.
answers: The software can flag spelling errors, but it cannot judge whether the tone suits the intended reader.
items.notes: whether 引导宾语从句；suit 直接接人，不用 suit for。

items.zh: 租户负责日常清洁，房东则负责结构性维修。
items.en: Tenants are responsible for routine cleaning, while the landlord is responsible for structural repairs.
answers: Tenants are responsible for routine cleaning, while the landlord is responsible for structural repairs.
items.notes: while 用于职责对照；be responsible for 后接名词。

items.zh: 我们知道哪里发生了延误，却不知道延误为何只影响部分订单。
items.en: We know where the delay occurred, but we do not know why it affected only some orders.
answers: We know where the delay occurred, but we do not know why it affected only some orders.
items.notes: where 与 why 引导平行的间接疑问，均使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 结果可以支持进一步调查，却不能单独证明该干预有效。
items.en: The results can justify further investigation; they cannot, on their own, prove that the intervention works.
answers: The results can justify further investigation; they cannot, on their own, prove that the intervention works.
items.notes: 分号防止逗号拼接；on their own 限定证据强度。

items.zh: 你可以用图表呈现趋势，但若差异很小，正文中的准确数字会更有帮助。
items.en: You can present the trend in a chart, but exact figures in the text may be more helpful when the differences are small.
answers: You can present the trend in a chart, but exact figures in the text may be more helpful when the differences are small.
items.notes: but 比较呈现方式；when 限定数字更有帮助的情形。

items.zh: 申请必须在周五下午五点前提交，而不是在周五当天任何时间都可以。
items.en: Applications must be submitted by 5 p.m. on Friday, not at any time during the day.
answers: Applications must be submitted by 5 p.m. on Friday, not at any time during the day.
items.notes: by 表示截止点，on 用于具体日期，during 表示一段期间。

items.zh: 会议从九点持续到十一点，中间在十点左右休息十分钟。
items.en: The meeting will run from nine until eleven, with a ten-minute break at around ten.
answers: The meeting will run from nine until eleven, with a ten-minute break at around ten.
items.notes: from ... until 表示起止，at 用于具体钟点，with 补充安排。

items.zh: 新入口位于药房和电梯之间，正对着接待台。
items.en: The new entrance is between the pharmacy and the lift, directly opposite reception.
answers: The new entrance is between the pharmacy and the lift, directly opposite reception.
items.notes: between 用于两个明确对象；opposite 前通常不加 to。

items.zh: 沿着河岸走，穿过铁路桥下方，再从市场旁的小路出去。
items.en: Walk along the riverbank, pass under the railway bridge, and leave by the path beside the market.
answers: Walk along the riverbank, pass under the railway bridge, and leave by the path beside the market.
items.notes: along、under、by、beside 分别表达路径、下方、经由和邻近。

items.zh: 数据是在三个月内收集的，而变化发生在调查结束之后。
items.en: The data were collected over three months, whereas the change occurred after the survey had ended.
answers: The data were collected over three months, whereas the change occurred after the survey had ended.
items.notes: over 表示持续时段；after 从句用过去完成时明确先后。

items.zh: 冬季，这个村庄与主干道隔绝，有时一次长达数日。
items.en: During winter, the village is cut off from the main road, sometimes for several days at a time.
answers: During winter, the village is cut off from the main road, sometimes for several days at a time.
items.notes: during 接季节；cut off from 和 for several days 是自然搭配。

items.zh: 展览在一楼，从主楼梯顶部向右走即可到达。
items.en: The exhibition is on the first floor, to the right at the top of the main staircase.
answers: The exhibition is on the first floor, to the right at the top of the main staircase.
items.notes: on 表示楼层，to the right 表示方位，at the top 表示位置点。

items.zh: 截至六月底，团队已在预算范围内完成了十二个站点中的九个。
items.en: By the end of June, the team had completed nine of the twelve sites within budget.
answers: By the end of June, the team had completed nine of the twelve sites within budget.
items.notes: by the end of 表示截止时间；within budget 表示未超预算。

items.zh: 事故发生在两个车站之间，因此乘客被转移到备用线路上。
items.en: The incident occurred between two stations, so passengers were transferred to an alternative route.
answers: The incident occurred between two stations, so passengers were transferred to an alternative route.
items.notes: between 说明区间；transfer someone to 表示转移到另一线路。

items.zh: 在过去十年里，中心城区以外的租金上涨得更快。
items.en: Over the past decade, rents outside the city centre have risen more rapidly.
answers: Over the past decade, rents outside the city centre have risen more rapidly.
items.notes: over the past decade 常与现在完成时连用；outside 不需要 of。

items.zh: 请在表格顶部写上编号，不要写在页边空白处。
items.en: Write the reference number at the top of the form, not in the margin.
answers: Write the reference number at the top of the form, not in the margin.
items.notes: at the top of 指页面顶部位置；in the margin 指页边区域内部。

items.zh: 该药应随餐服用，并在两次服药之间至少间隔六小时。
items.en: The medicine should be taken with food, with at least six hours between doses.
answers: The medicine should be taken with food, with at least six hours between doses.
items.notes: with food 表示随餐；between doses 表示两次剂量之间。

items.zh: 所有决定都必须依据申请时有效的规则作出。
items.en: All decisions must be made under the rules in force at the time of application.
answers: All decisions must be made under the rules in force at the time of application.
items.notes: under the rules 表示依据规则；at the time of 表示在特定时点。

items.zh: 由于地图比例尺较小，步道看起来比实际距离更靠近公路。
items.en: At this small scale, the footpath appears closer to the road than it is in reality.
answers: At this small scale, the footpath appears closer to the road than it is in reality.
items.notes: at this scale 表示在某比例尺下；close to 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 我们将在收到付款后的五个工作日内寄出证书。
items.en: We will dispatch the certificate within five working days of receiving payment.
answers: We will dispatch the certificate within five working days of receiving payment.
items.notes: within 表示不迟于该时限；of receiving payment 确定起算事件。

items.zh: 设备不得存放在阳光直射处或低于零度的环境中。
items.en: The equipment must not be stored in direct sunlight or at temperatures below zero.
answers: The equipment must not be stored in direct sunlight or at temperatures below zero.
items.notes: in sunlight 与 at a temperature 是不同介词搭配。

items.zh: 除少数沿海地区外，全国的参与率都高于目标值。
items.en: Participation was above target throughout the country apart from a few coastal areas.
answers: Participation was above target throughout the country apart from a few coastal areas.
items.notes: throughout 表示遍及范围；apart from 引出例外。

items.zh: 合同在签署之日起生效，并持续有效至下一财政年度结束。
items.en: The contract takes effect on the date of signature and remains valid until the end of the next financial year.
answers: The contract takes effect on the date of signature and remains valid until the end of the next financial year.
items.notes: on the date of 与 until the end of 分别表达起点和终点。

items.zh: 研究对象按年龄分成三组，每组内部再按居住地比较。
items.en: Participants were divided into three groups by age and then compared within each group according to place of residence.
answers: Participants were divided into three groups by age and then compared within each group according to place of residence.
items.notes: divide into、by age、within each group、according to 分工明确。

items.zh: 货物从后门运入，以免穿过对公众开放的区域。
items.en: Deliveries are brought in through the rear entrance to avoid passing through areas open to the public.
answers: Deliveries are brought in through the rear entrance to avoid passing through areas open to the public.
items.notes: through 表示经过入口或区域内部；open to 表示向某群体开放。

items.zh: 在需求高峰期，回复时间可能从两天增加到一周。
items.en: At times of peak demand, response times may increase from two days to a week.
answers: At times of peak demand, response times may increase from two days to a week.
items.notes: at times of 表示在某类时期；from ... to 表示范围变化。

items.zh: 这项安排对五月一日之后加入的员工不适用。
items.en: The arrangement does not apply to employees who joined after 1 May.
answers: The arrangement does not apply to employees who joined after 1 May.
items.notes: apply to 是固定搭配；after 用于日期之后。

items.zh: 会议室最多可容纳十二人，包括主持人在内。
items.en: The meeting room has capacity for up to twelve people, including the facilitator.
answers: The meeting room has capacity for up to twelve people, including the facilitator.
items.notes: capacity for 表示可容纳数量；up to 表示上限。

items.zh: 在图表所涵盖的时期内，支出始终占收入的三分之一以下。
items.en: Throughout the period covered by the chart, expenditure remained below one third of income.
answers: Throughout the period covered by the chart, expenditure remained below one third of income.
items.notes: throughout 强调全时段；below 用于数值低于某界线。

items.zh: 该条款在紧急情况下不适用，但紧急情况必须在事后以书面形式说明。
items.en: The clause does not apply in an emergency, but the circumstances must be explained in writing afterwards.
answers: The clause does not apply in an emergency, but the circumstances must be explained in writing afterwards.
items.notes: in an emergency 表示情境；in writing 表示形式；afterwards 不加介词。

items.zh: 公众对改革缺乏信任，部分源于此前的承诺没有兑现。
items.en: Public distrust of the reform stems partly from earlier promises that were not kept.
answers: Public distrust of the reform stems partly from earlier promises that were not kept.
items.notes: distrust of 与 stem from 是固定搭配；that 从句限定 promises。

items.zh: 该建议与委员会减少行政负担的目标一致。
items.en: The proposal is consistent with the committee's aim of reducing the administrative burden.
answers: The proposal is consistent with the committee's aim of reducing the administrative burden.
items.notes: be consistent with；aim of 后接动名词。

items.zh: 我们反对的不是收费本身，而是收费方式缺乏透明度。
items.en: Our objection is not to the fee itself but to the lack of transparency in how it is calculated.
answers: Our objection is not to the fee itself but to the lack of transparency in how it is calculated.
items.notes: objection to 中 to 是介词；how 引导介词后的名词性从句。

items.zh: 这次延误不能归咎于单个供应商，因为多个环节都出现了故障。
items.en: The delay cannot be attributed to a single supplier because failures occurred at several stages.
answers: The delay cannot be attributed to a single supplier because failures occurred at several stages.
items.notes: attribute A to B 表示把原因归于；at a stage 表示在某环节。

items.zh: 培训重点从记忆规则转向在真实情境中应用原则。
items.en: The training shifts the emphasis from memorising rules to applying principles in realistic contexts.
answers: The training shifts the emphasis from memorising rules to applying principles in realistic contexts.
items.notes: from ... to 中两端都用动名词，保持结构平行。

items.zh: 居民有权了解收集其数据的目的。
items.en: Residents are entitled to information about the purpose for which their data are collected.
answers: Residents are entitled to information about the purpose for which their data are collected.
items.notes: be entitled to 后接名词；for which 正式表达数据收集目的。

items.zh: 与原计划相比，修订方案更重视步行者的安全。
items.en: Compared with the original plan, the revised scheme places greater emphasis on pedestrian safety.
answers: Compared with the original plan, the revised scheme places greater emphasis on pedestrian safety.
items.notes: compared with 引出比较基准；place emphasis on 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 这项结论建立在自报数据之上，因此容易受到记忆误差的影响。
items.en: The conclusion is based on self-reported data and is therefore vulnerable to errors of recall.
answers: The conclusion is based on self-reported data and is therefore vulnerable to errors of recall.
items.notes: be based on 与 be vulnerable to 均需准确使用介词。

items.zh: 费用增加与服务质量改善之间没有明显联系。
items.en: There is no clear relationship between the increase in cost and the improvement in service quality.
answers: There is no clear relationship between the increase in cost and the improvement in service quality.
items.notes: relationship between A and B；increase in 表示某方面的增加。

items.zh: 该机构因未能回应警告而受到批评。
items.en: The agency was criticised for failing to respond to the warning.
answers: The agency was criticised for failing to respond to the warning.
items.notes: criticise someone for doing；respond to 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 我们应区分对结果不满意和认为程序不公平。
items.en: We should distinguish dissatisfaction with the outcome from a belief that the process was unfair.
answers: We should distinguish dissatisfaction with the outcome from a belief that the process was unfair.
items.notes: distinguish A from B；dissatisfaction with 指对某结果不满。

items.zh: 参与者是否有资格获得补贴，取决于其主要居住地。
items.en: Eligibility for the grant depends on a participant's main place of residence.
answers: Eligibility for the grant depends on a participant's main place of residence.
items.notes: eligibility for 与 depend on 是常见名词和动词搭配。

items.zh: 这份摘要让非专业读者得以了解争议的核心。
items.en: The summary gives non-specialist readers access to the central issues in the dispute.
answers: The summary gives non-specialist readers access to the central issues in the dispute.
items.notes: give someone access to；issues in the dispute 表示争议中的问题。

items.zh: 许多小企业难以应对对现金流的突然冲击。
items.en: Many small businesses struggle to cope with a sudden shock to their cash flow.
answers: Many small businesses struggle to cope with a sudden shock to their cash flow.
items.notes: cope with 表示应对；a shock to 表示对某系统的冲击。

items.zh: 作者没有为样本为何排除兼职员工作出解释。
items.en: The author provides no explanation for the exclusion of part-time employees from the sample.
answers: The author provides no explanation for the exclusion of part-time employees from the sample.
items.notes: explanation for、exclusion of A from B 均为固定搭配。

items.zh: 我们对短期预测有把握，但对五年后的估计仍持谨慎态度。
items.en: We are confident about the short-term forecast but cautious about estimates five years ahead.
answers: We are confident about the short-term forecast but cautious about estimates five years ahead.
items.notes: confident about 与 cautious about 对照确定程度。

items.zh: 新设计优先考虑无障碍使用，而不是外观上的对称。
items.en: The new design gives priority to accessibility over visual symmetry.
answers: The new design gives priority to accessibility over visual symmetry.
items.notes: give priority to A over B 表示优先顺序。

items.zh: 委员会未能就谁应承担维护责任达成一致。
items.en: The committee failed to reach agreement on who should be responsible for maintenance.
answers: The committee failed to reach agreement on who should be responsible for maintenance.
items.notes: agreement on 后接议题；responsible for 后接职责。

items.zh: 这项发现与较早研究的结论相矛盾，但并未证明那些研究无效。
items.en: The finding conflicts with the conclusions of earlier studies but does not prove them invalid.
answers: The finding conflicts with the conclusions of earlier studies but does not prove them invalid.
items.notes: conflict with 表示与结论冲突；prove something invalid 不加 to be 也可。

items.zh: 长期接触高噪声会增加听力受损的风险。
items.en: Prolonged exposure to high noise levels increases the risk of hearing damage.
answers: Prolonged exposure to high noise levels increases the risk of hearing damage.
items.notes: exposure to 与 risk of 是需要记忆的名词搭配。

items.zh: 这套规则为处理利益冲突提供了明确框架。
items.en: The rules provide a clear framework for dealing with conflicts of interest.
answers: The rules provide a clear framework for dealing with conflicts of interest.
items.notes: framework for 后接动名词；conflict of interest 是固定表达。

items.zh: 调查结果使人们注意到郊区服务覆盖的缺口。
items.en: The survey draws attention to gaps in service coverage in suburban areas.
answers: The survey draws attention to gaps in service coverage in suburban areas.
items.notes: draw attention to；gap in 表示某领域中的缺口。

items.zh: 是否延长试点，应根据其对不同群体的影响来判断。
items.en: Any decision on extending the pilot should be informed by its impact on different groups.
answers: Any decision on extending the pilot should be informed by its impact on different groups.
items.notes: decision on 后接事项；be informed by 表示以证据为依据。

items.zh: 该计划以牺牲维护预算为代价增加了新设施。
items.en: The scheme added new facilities at the expense of the maintenance budget.
answers: The scheme added new facilities at the expense of the maintenance budget.
items.notes: at the expense of 表示一项收益以另一项损失为代价。

items.zh: 企业必须遵守有关数据保留的规定，无论实施成本多高。
items.en: Companies must comply with the rules on data retention regardless of the cost of implementation.
answers: Companies must comply with the rules on data retention regardless of the cost of implementation.
items.notes: comply with、rules on、regardless of 构成三个不同关系。

items.zh: 最终入选的方案，是唯一同时满足消防和无障碍标准的方案。
items.en: The proposal that was eventually selected was the only one that met both fire-safety and accessibility standards.
answers: The proposal that was eventually selected was the only one that met both fire-safety and accessibility standards.
items.notes: 两个 that 从句分别识别入选方案和说明唯一性；both ... and 连接两项标准。

items.zh: 我们采访了居住地受新铁路直接影响的居民。
items.en: We interviewed residents whose homes would be directly affected by the new railway.
answers: We interviewed residents whose homes would be directly affected by the new railway.
items.notes: whose 表示居民与住所的所属关系，避免写成 their homes 的重复主语。

items.zh: 该设备在潮湿环境中可能失灵，这是山区诊所需要特别考虑的问题。
items.en: The device may fail in humid conditions, which is a particular concern for clinics in mountain areas.
answers: The device may fail in humid conditions, which is a particular concern for clinics in mountain areas.
items.notes: which 回指前面整件事并说明其影响。

items.zh: 五月是游客人数开始超过当地人口的月份。
items.en: May is the month when visitor numbers begin to exceed the local population.
answers: May is the month when visitor numbers begin to exceed the local population.
items.notes: when 修饰 month，并在从句中作时间状语。

items.zh: 这座旧仓库如今所在的地块过去是一处公共花园。
items.en: The site on which the old warehouse now stands was once a public garden.
answers: The site on which the old warehouse now stands was once a public garden.
items.notes: on which 对应 stand on the site，正式写作中介词可前置。

items.zh: 有些申请人提交了不完整的表格，其中三人错过了补交期限。
items.en: Several applicants submitted incomplete forms, three of whom missed the deadline for providing the missing information.
answers: Several applicants submitted incomplete forms, three of whom missed the deadline for providing the missing information.
items.notes: three of whom 表示整体中的一部分，不能用 three of them 接在逗号后。

items.zh: 报告提出了五项建议，其中最昂贵的一项涉及更换全部管道。
items.en: The report makes five recommendations, the most expensive of which involves replacing all the pipes.
answers: The report makes five recommendations, the most expensive of which involves replacing all the pipes.
items.notes: the most expensive of which 是部分整体结构。

items.zh: 缺少可靠网络连接的家庭更难使用线上公共服务。
items.en: Households that lack a reliable internet connection face greater difficulty in accessing public services online.
answers: Households that lack a reliable internet connection face greater difficulty in accessing public services online.
items.notes: that 作 lack 的主语；difficulty in 后接动名词。

items.zh: 我们采用的定义比上一版指南中的定义更窄。
items.en: The definition we have adopted is narrower than the one used in the previous guidance.
answers: The definition we have adopted is narrower than the one used in the previous guidance.
items.notes: 省略宾语关系词；the one 避免重复 definition。

items.zh: 该研究排除了数据无法独立核实的病例。
items.en: The study excluded cases for which the data could not be independently verified.
answers: The study excluded cases for which the data could not be independently verified.
items.notes: for which 对应 data for the cases，明确数据所属对象。

items.zh: 周末停运的两条线路服务于没有其他公共交通选择的社区。
items.en: The two routes that cease operating at weekends serve communities where no alternative public transport is available.
answers: The two routes that cease operating at weekends serve communities where no alternative public transport is available.
items.notes: that 限定线路，where 修饰 communities，形成两层信息。

items.zh: 去年安装的隔音板并没有减少住户最常抱怨的低频噪声。
items.en: The sound barriers installed last year have not reduced the low-frequency noise about which residents complain most often.
answers: The sound barriers installed last year have not reduced the low-frequency noise about which residents complain most often.
items.notes: 过去分词压缩被动定语；about which 保留 complain about 的介词。

items.zh: 调查期间离职的员工仍被计入最终样本。
items.en: Employees who left during the survey period were still included in the final sample.
answers: Employees who left during the survey period were still included in the final sample.
items.notes: who 从句限定员工范围；include in 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 公司撤回了那则声称产品能够预防感染的广告。
items.en: The company withdrew the advertisement that claimed the product could prevent infection.
answers: The company withdrew the advertisement that claimed the product could prevent infection.
items.notes: that 从句说明广告所作主张；claim 后的宾语从句省略 that。

items.zh: 评估所依据的数据来自各机构自行填报的记录。
items.en: The data on which the assessment was based came from records submitted by the agencies themselves.
answers: The data on which the assessment was based came from records submitted by the agencies themselves.
items.notes: on which 对应 be based on；submitted by 为过去分词短语。

items.zh: 在没有电梯的建筑中工作的护理人员必须用楼梯搬运设备。
items.en: Carers who work in buildings where there is no lift have to carry equipment up the stairs.
answers: Carers who work in buildings where there is no lift have to carry equipment up the stairs.
items.notes: who 和 where 从句分别修饰人员与建筑。

items.zh: 这项限制只适用于合同在七月之后续签的供应商。
items.en: The restriction applies only to suppliers whose contracts are renewed after July.
answers: The restriction applies only to suppliers whose contracts are renewed after July.
items.notes: whose contracts 表明合同属于供应商；only 限定适用范围。

items.zh: 委员会解释决定的信件直到表决两周后才寄出。
items.en: The letter in which the committee explained its decision was not sent until two weeks after the vote.
answers: The letter in which the committee explained its decision was not sent until two weeks after the vote.
items.notes: in which 对应 explain in the letter；not ... until 突出延迟。

items.zh: 该镇关闭了最后一家银行，这迫使一些老年居民前往邻镇办理业务。
items.en: The town closed its last bank, which forced some older residents to travel elsewhere for banking services.
answers: The town closed its last bank, which forced some older residents to travel elsewhere for banking services.
items.notes: which 回指关闭银行这一行动及其结果。

items.zh: 任何声称零风险的方案都应受到谨慎审查。
items.en: Any proposal that claims to eliminate all risk should be examined with caution.
answers: Any proposal that claims to eliminate all risk should be examined with caution.
items.notes: that 限定 proposal；claim to do 表示声称能做到。

items.zh: 档案中有一段时期的记录完全缺失，其原因至今不明。
items.en: There is a period for which the archive contains no records, although the reason for the gap remains unclear.
answers: There is a period for which the archive contains no records, although the reason for the gap remains unclear.
items.notes: for which 把记录与时期连接；although 补充缺口原因仍未知。

items.zh: 我们需要一种在低带宽条件下仍能正常运行的工具。
items.en: We need a tool that remains usable even when bandwidth is limited.
answers: We need a tool that remains usable even when bandwidth is limited.
items.notes: that 从句描述工具属性；even when 加入受限条件。

items.zh: 该城市过去依赖的水库目前只有一半蓄水量。
items.en: The reservoir on which the city once depended is now only half full.
answers: The reservoir on which the city once depended is now only half full.
items.notes: depend on 的介词前置；once 与 now 构成时间对照。

items.zh: 参与者收到了一份摘要，其措辞经过修改，以免透露个人身份。
items.en: Participants received a summary whose wording had been altered to avoid revealing anyone's identity.
answers: Participants received a summary whose wording had been altered to avoid revealing anyone's identity.
items.notes: whose 可修饰物；过去完成时说明修改先于收到。

items.zh: 最需要补贴的人，往往也是最难完成复杂申请程序的人。
items.en: Those who need the subsidy most are often the people for whom a complex application process is hardest to navigate.
answers: Those who need the subsidy most are often the people for whom a complex application process is hardest to navigate.
items.notes: those who 指特定人群；for whom 表示对谁而言最困难。

items.zh: 委员会尚未决定是否公开会议记录。
items.en: The committee has not yet decided whether the minutes should be made public.
answers: The committee has not yet decided whether the minutes should be made public.
items.notes: whether 引导宾语从句；make something public 表示公开。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 真正的问题不是价格是否上涨，而是谁将承担额外费用。
items.en: The real question is not whether prices will rise but who will bear the additional cost.
answers: The real question is not whether prices will rise but who will bear the additional cost.
items.notes: whether 与 who 从句在表语位置形成对照。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 我们需要知道申请被拒的具体原因，而不仅仅是知道它未获批准。
items.en: We need to know precisely why the application was rejected, not merely that it was unsuccessful.
answers: We need to know precisely why the application was rejected, not merely that it was unsuccessful.
items.notes: why 与 that 引导不同信息层次；间接问句不用倒装。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 很明显，较短的等待时间并不一定意味着较好的治疗效果。
items.en: It is clear that a shorter waiting time does not necessarily mean a better clinical outcome.
answers: It is clear that a shorter waiting time does not necessarily mean a better clinical outcome.
items.notes: it 作形式主语，that 从句承载判断内容；not necessarily 表示未必。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 报告没有说明样本为何缩小，也没有说明这是否影响结果。
items.en: The report does not explain why the sample became smaller or whether this affected the results.
answers: The report does not explain why the sample became smaller or whether this affected the results.
items.notes: why 和 whether 构成并列宾语从句。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 人们常忽略的一点是，便利程度对不同用户并不相同。
items.en: What is often overlooked is that convenience does not mean the same thing to every user.
answers: What is often overlooked is that convenience does not mean the same thing to every user.
items.notes: what 从句作主语，that 从句作表语。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 任何人都无法确定远程办公会如何改变市中心的长期需求。
items.en: No one can be certain how remote working will alter long-term demand in city centres.
answers: No one can be certain how remote working will alter long-term demand in city centres.
items.notes: how 引导间接疑问，采用陈述语序。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 该机构承认，它原本应该更早告知住户停水安排。
items.en: The agency acknowledged that it should have informed residents of the water outage earlier.
answers: The agency acknowledged that it should have informed residents of the water outage earlier.
items.notes: should have done 表示过去本应做而未做；inform someone of something。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 我们是否采用这项指标，取决于它能否在各地区保持一致。
items.en: Whether we adopt the measure depends on whether it can be applied consistently across regions.
answers: Whether we adopt the measure depends on whether it can be applied consistently across regions.
items.notes: 两个 whether 从句分别作主语和介词 on 的宾语。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 尚不清楚的是，有多少受访者把空白选项误解成了“没有意见”。
items.en: What remains unclear is how many respondents mistook the blank option for no opinion.
answers: What remains unclear is how many respondents mistook the blank option for no opinion.
items.notes: what 从句引出未知问题；mistake A for B 表示误认为。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 评审人员询问为何预算增加了，而覆盖范围却缩小了。
items.en: The reviewers asked why the budget had increased while the scope of the project had narrowed.
answers: The reviewers asked why the budget had increased while the scope of the project had narrowed.
items.notes: 间接问句使用陈述语序；过去完成时回溯变化。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 我们不能假定对专业人员显而易见的内容对公众也同样清楚。
items.en: We cannot assume that what is obvious to specialists is equally clear to the public.
answers: We cannot assume that what is obvious to specialists is equally clear to the public.
items.notes: that 从句中嵌入 what 主语从句；obvious to someone。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 关键不在于多少人下载了应用，而在于他们下载后是否继续使用。
items.en: What matters is not how many people downloaded the app but whether they continued to use it afterwards.
answers: What matters is not how many people downloaded the app but whether they continued to use it afterwards.
items.notes: what matters 引出评价标准；how many 与 whether 平行对照。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 证人记得门是开着的，却记不得是谁打开的。
items.en: The witness remembered that the door was open but could not recall who had opened it.
answers: The witness remembered that the door was open but could not recall who had opened it.
items.notes: that 陈述事实，who 引出未知施事者；过去完成时标明先行动作。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 政策能否成功，很大程度上取决于地方部门如何执行它。
items.en: Whether the policy succeeds will depend largely on how local departments implement it.
answers: Whether the policy succeeds will depend largely on how local departments implement it.
items.notes: whether 从句作主语；how 从句作 on 的宾语。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 调查发现的不是员工反对培训，而是他们不知道如何安排参加时间。
items.en: The survey found not that staff opposed the training but that they did not know how to fit it into their schedules.
answers: The survey found not that staff opposed the training but that they did not know how to fit it into their schedules.
items.notes: not that ... but that 对照真正发现；how to fit 是疑问词加不定式。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 请确认附件中的数字是否为最终版本，以及引用时应注明哪个日期。
items.en: Please confirm whether the figures in the attachment are final and which date should be cited with them.
answers: Please confirm whether the figures in the attachment are final and which date should be cited with them.
items.notes: whether 与 which date 并列；间接疑问采用陈述语序。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 问题在于，为短期访客设计的流程被当成了长期解决方案。
items.en: The problem is that a process designed for short-term visitors has been treated as a permanent solution.
answers: The problem is that a process designed for short-term visitors has been treated as a permanent solution.
items.notes: that 从句作表语；designed for 为压缩定语。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 谁负责更新网页，应在服务恢复前明确下来。
items.en: Who is responsible for updating the website should be clarified before the service resumes.
answers: Who is responsible for updating the website should be clarified before the service resumes.
items.notes: who 从句整体作主语；从句内部正常使用疑问词作主语。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 没有证据表明年龄本身决定了人们是否愿意使用数字服务。
items.en: There is no evidence that age alone determines whether people are willing to use digital services.
answers: There is no evidence that age alone determines whether people are willing to use digital services.
items.notes: that 引导 evidence 的同位语从句；whether 作 determines 的宾语。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 我们最担心的是，临时措施会在未经审查的情况下变成长期惯例。
items.en: Our main concern is that a temporary measure may become standard practice without being reviewed.
answers: Our main concern is that a temporary measure may become standard practice without being reviewed.
items.notes: that 从句说明 concern 内容；without being reviewed 表示缺失的程序。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 申请人有权知道哪些信息被保存、保存多久以及谁能访问。
items.en: Applicants are entitled to know what information is retained, for how long, and who can access it.
answers: Applicants are entitled to know what information is retained, for how long, and who can access it.
items.notes: 三个间接问题平行排列，省去重复谓语但不损失逻辑。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 不能仅凭投诉很少就断定服务运行良好。
items.en: The fact that few complaints were received does not by itself prove that the service operated well.
answers: The fact that few complaints were received does not by itself prove that the service operated well.
items.notes: the fact that 作主语；by itself 限定证据效力。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 报告应说明估计值建立在什么假设之上。
items.en: The report should state what assumptions the estimate is based on.
answers: The report should state what assumptions the estimate is based on.
items.notes: what assumptions 是介词 on 的逻辑宾语，介词保留在句末。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 不管最终选择哪种办法，都必须解释为何它比其他方案更合适。
items.en: Whichever approach is chosen, its advantages over the alternatives must be explained.
answers: Whichever approach is chosen, its advantages over the alternatives must be explained.
items.notes: whichever 引出无论哪一种；its 清楚回指所选方案。
tags: 名词性从句与间接问句

items.zh: 如果没有独立审查，公众可能会怀疑机构是在给自己打分。
items.en: If there is no independent review, the public may suspect that the organisation is marking its own work.
answers: If there is no independent review, the public may suspect that the organisation is marking its own work.
items.notes: if 给出风险条件；that 从句说明怀疑内容。

items.zh: 只要修改不会改变原意，编辑可以简化句子。
items.en: Editors may simplify a sentence provided that the revision does not alter its meaning.
answers: Editors may simplify a sentence provided that the revision does not alter its meaning.
items.notes: provided that 比 if 更明确地表示许可条件。

items.zh: 为了避免把相关性写成因果关系，作者删除了“导致”一词。
items.en: The author removed the word caused so that correlation would not be presented as causation.
answers: The author removed the word caused so that correlation would not be presented as causation.
items.notes: so that 表示修改目的；被动语态突出错误呈现。

items.zh: 由于大多数回复来自城市地区，结论不应直接推广到偏远社区。
items.en: Because most responses came from urban areas, the findings should not be generalised directly to remote communities.
answers: Because most responses came from urban areas, the findings should not be generalised directly to remote communities.
items.notes: because 提供证据限制；generalise findings to a group。

items.zh: 即使预算获得批准，工程也要等到土地调查完成后才能开工。
items.en: Even if the budget is approved, construction cannot begin until the land survey has been completed.
answers: Even if the budget is approved, construction cannot begin until the land survey has been completed.
items.notes: even if 与 not until 组合，区分必要但不充分的条件。

items.zh: 若要比较两个年份，分类方式必须保持一致。
items.en: If two years are to be compared, the categories must be defined consistently.
answers: If two years are to be compared, the categories must be defined consistently.
items.notes: if ... are to be compared 表示要实现的任务条件。

items.zh: 由于通知寄错了地址，住户没有机会在截止日前回应。
items.en: As the notice was sent to the wrong address, the resident had no opportunity to respond before the deadline.
answers: As the notice was sent to the wrong address, the resident had no opportunity to respond before the deadline.
items.notes: as 引出已知原因；opportunity to do 与 respond before。

items.zh: 系统会保留确认页面，以便用户在邮件未送达时仍有凭证。
items.en: The system retains the confirmation page so that users still have evidence if the email fails to arrive.
answers: The system retains the confirmation page so that users still have evidence if the email fails to arrive.
items.notes: so that 说明保留目的；if 引出目的场景中的故障条件。

items.zh: 除非问卷提供“不适用”选项，否则受访者可能被迫选择不准确的答案。
items.en: Unless the questionnaire offers a not applicable option, respondents may be forced to choose an inaccurate answer.
answers: Unless the questionnaire offers a not applicable option, respondents may be forced to choose an inaccurate answer.
items.notes: unless 表示若不满足条件将产生的偏差。

items.zh: 既然原始数据已经公开，其他研究者就能检查计算是否可重复。
items.en: Now that the raw data are public, other researchers can check whether the calculations are reproducible.
answers: Now that the raw data are public, other researchers can check whether the calculations are reproducible.
items.notes: now that 表示新情况带来的可能性；whether 引导检查内容。

items.zh: 如果早知道地下有旧管道，承包商就会采用不同的钻探路线。
items.en: Had the contractor known about the old pipes underground, it would have used a different drilling route.
answers: Had the contractor known about the old pipes underground, it would have used a different drilling route.
items.notes: 省略 if 的虚拟条件句用 had 倒装，表示与过去事实相反。

items.zh: 为了让低视力读者辨认图例，设计师提高了颜色之间的对比度。
items.en: The designer increased the contrast between the colours so that readers with low vision could distinguish the legend.
answers: The designer increased the contrast between the colours so that readers with low vision could distinguish the legend.
items.notes: so that 加 could 表示过去措施的目的。

items.zh: 如果租金继续以目前速度上涨，补贴增加额很快就会被抵消。
items.en: If rents continue to rise at the current rate, the increase in the allowance will soon be cancelled out.
answers: If rents continue to rise at the current rate, the increase in the allowance will soon be cancelled out.
items.notes: 真实条件句主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时。

items.zh: 因为样本只包括现有客户，该调查无法说明退出服务者的经历。
items.en: Since the sample includes only current customers, the survey cannot show what former users experienced.
answers: Since the sample includes only current customers, the survey cannot show what former users experienced.
items.notes: since 给出方法局限；what 从句作 show 的宾语。

items.zh: 表格设置了保存功能，以防申请人在完成前失去网络连接。
items.en: The form includes a save function in case applicants lose their connection before completing it.
answers: The form includes a save function in case applicants lose their connection before completing it.
items.notes: in case 表示预防；before completing it 省略与主句一致的主语。

items.zh: 倘若需求低于预测，空置房间可以改作社区办公空间。
items.en: Should demand fall below the forecast, empty rooms could be converted into community workspaces.
answers: Should demand fall below the forecast, empty rooms could be converted into community workspaces.
items.notes: should 倒装表达可能性较低的正式条件。

items.zh: 政府试行分阶段付款，是为了让小型机构不必预先垫付全部费用。
items.en: The government piloted staged payments so that small organisations would not have to cover the full cost upfront.
answers: The government piloted staged payments so that small organisations would not have to cover the full cost upfront.
items.notes: so that 表示政策目的；cover a cost 表示承担费用。

items.zh: 如果没有记录拒绝参与的人，研究人员就无法判断是否存在自我选择偏差。
items.en: Unless those who declined to participate are recorded, researchers cannot assess whether self-selection bias is present.
answers: Unless those who declined to participate are recorded, researchers cannot assess whether self-selection bias is present.
items.notes: unless 指必要记录条件；those who 准确指代拒绝者。

items.zh: 鉴于两组在实验前已有差异，结果应谨慎解释。
items.en: Given that the two groups differed before the experiment, the results should be interpreted cautiously.
answers: Given that the two groups differed before the experiment, the results should be interpreted cautiously.
items.notes: given that 引出解释结果所需考虑的前提。

items.zh: 只要材料能够回收，包装稍重一点可能是合理的取舍。
items.en: A slightly heavier package may be a reasonable trade-off as long as the material can be recycled.
answers: A slightly heavier package may be a reasonable trade-off as long as the material can be recycled.
items.notes: as long as 表示接受取舍的条件。

items.zh: 即便提醒邮件没有提高回复率，它也可能减少错过截止日期的情况。
items.en: Even if the reminder does not increase the response rate, it may reduce the number of missed deadlines.
answers: Even if the reminder does not increase the response rate, it may reduce the number of missed deadlines.
items.notes: even if 承认一种效果可能不存在，同时保留另一种作用。

items.zh: 维修安排在夜间进行，以尽量减少对日间服务的干扰。
items.en: The repairs were scheduled overnight in order to minimise disruption to daytime services.
answers: The repairs were scheduled overnight in order to minimise disruption to daytime services.
items.notes: in order to 明确目的；disruption to 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 如果所有缺失值都被当作零，平均数就会被人为压低。
items.en: If every missing value is treated as zero, the average will be artificially reduced.
answers: If every missing value is treated as zero, the average will be artificially reduced.
items.notes: if 从句说明错误处理方式，主句说明统计后果。

items.zh: 由于没有对照组，我们无法确定改善是否由该项目引起。
items.en: Because there was no control group, we cannot determine whether the improvement was caused by the programme.
answers: Because there was no control group, we cannot determine whether the improvement was caused by the programme.
items.notes: because 说明推断限制；whether 避免把因果写成事实。

items.zh: 若非志愿者主动翻译，许多家长当时无法理解学校的通知。
items.en: Had volunteers not provided translations, many parents would have been unable to understand the school's notices.
answers: Had volunteers not provided translations, many parents would have been unable to understand the school's notices.
items.notes: 过去虚拟条件的否定倒装，说明实际发生的帮助避免了后果。

items.zh: 虽然总体失业率下降了，青年人的就业状况却几乎没有改善。
items.en: Although unemployment fell overall, employment prospects for young people improved very little.
answers: Although unemployment fell overall, employment prospects for young people improved very little.
items.notes: although 对照总体与特定群体，避免用 but 重复连接。

items.zh: 无论候选人是否有行业经验，所有人都要完成同一项实际测试。
items.en: Whether or not candidates have industry experience, they must all complete the same practical test.
answers: Whether or not candidates have industry experience, they must all complete the same practical test.
items.notes: whether or not 表示两种情况不影响主句要求。

items.zh: 尽管线上咨询更便宜，它并不适合需要体检的患者。
items.en: While an online consultation is cheaper, it is not suitable for patients who require a physical examination.
answers: While an online consultation is cheaper, it is not suitable for patients who require a physical examination.
items.notes: while 表示让步；who 从句限定不适用人群。

items.zh: 成本估算看似精确，但它依赖的假设仍有很大不确定性。
items.en: Precise though the cost estimate appears, the assumptions on which it rests remain highly uncertain.
answers: Precise though the cost estimate appears, the assumptions on which it rests remain highly uncertain.
items.notes: 形容词 + though 倒装用于正式让步；rest on 表示以……为基础。

items.zh: 即使每个步骤单独看都合理，整个流程仍可能给申请人造成过重负担。
items.en: Even though each step appears reasonable in isolation, the process as a whole may place an excessive burden on applicants.
answers: Even though each step appears reasonable in isolation, the process as a whole may place an excessive burden on applicants.
items.notes: even though 引出事实让步；in isolation 与 as a whole 对照。

items.zh: 该指标适合比较趋势，却不适合估算实际人数。
items.en: The measure is useful for comparing trends, whereas it is unsuitable for estimating actual numbers.
answers: The measure is useful for comparing trends, whereas it is unsuitable for estimating actual numbers.
items.notes: whereas 对照同一指标的用途边界。

items.zh: 无论设备多么先进，都不能弥补采样设计中的根本缺陷。
items.en: However sophisticated the equipment may be, it cannot compensate for a fundamental flaw in the sampling design.
answers: However sophisticated the equipment may be, it cannot compensate for a fundamental flaw in the sampling design.
items.notes: however + 形容词引导无论程度多高的让步。

items.zh: 尽管居民支持建新诊所，他们对拟议地点仍有保留意见。
items.en: Although residents support the new clinic, they have reservations about the proposed location.
answers: Although residents support the new clinic, they have reservations about the proposed location.
items.notes: support 与 have reservations about 精确表达部分支持。

items.zh: 这份指南的目标读者是初学者，可其中一些例子需要专业知识才能理解。
items.en: The guidance is intended for beginners, yet some of its examples require specialist knowledge to understand.
answers: The guidance is intended for beginners, yet some of its examples require specialist knowledge to understand.
items.notes: yet 突出目标读者与实际难度间的反差。

items.zh: 即便结果在统计上显著，其实际影响也可能很小。
items.en: Even where a result is statistically significant, its practical effect may be small.
answers: Even where a result is statistically significant, its practical effect may be small.
items.notes: even where 表示即使在满足某情形时；区分统计显著与实际意义。

items.zh: 不论由谁运营服务，投诉程序都必须保持独立。
items.en: Regardless of who operates the service, the complaints process must remain independent.
answers: Regardless of who operates the service, the complaints process must remain independent.
items.notes: regardless of 后可接 who 名词性从句。

items.zh: 新规则减少了纸张使用，代价却是工作人员要重复录入部分信息。
items.en: The new rule reduces paper use, albeit at the cost of requiring staff to enter some information twice.
answers: The new rule reduces paper use, albeit at the cost of requiring staff to enter some information twice.
items.notes: albeit 引出有限让步；at the cost of 后接动名词。

items.zh: 虽然研究涵盖多个城市，但所有城市都位于同一地区。
items.en: Although the study covers several cities, they are all located within the same region.
answers: Although the study covers several cities, they are all located within the same region.
items.notes: although 承认表面覆盖范围，再指出地域局限。

items.zh: 政策可能在平均意义上有效，但这并不排除它使少数家庭处境恶化。
items.en: The policy may be effective on average, but this does not rule out the possibility that it leaves a minority of households worse off.
answers: The policy may be effective on average, but this does not rule out the possibility that it leaves a minority of households worse off.
items.notes: rule out the possibility that 精确保留例外可能。

items.zh: 再详细的说明也无法保证读者会以相同方式理解术语。
items.en: No matter how detailed the explanation is, it cannot guarantee that every reader will interpret the term in the same way.
answers: No matter how detailed the explanation is, it cannot guarantee that every reader will interpret the term in the same way.
items.notes: no matter how 引出程度让步；guarantee 后接 that 从句。

items.zh: 与大城市不同，小城镇无法通过增加班次来分散高峰客流。
items.en: Unlike large cities, small towns cannot spread peak demand by increasing the frequency of services.
answers: Unlike large cities, small towns cannot spread peak demand by increasing the frequency of services.
items.notes: unlike 后接名词对照对象；by doing 表示手段。

items.zh: 尽管材料可以回收，但若当地没有处理设施，这一优点就没有实际意义。
items.en: Although the material is recyclable, that advantage has little practical value where local processing facilities do not exist.
answers: Although the material is recyclable, that advantage has little practical value where local processing facilities do not exist.
items.notes: where 表示在缺少设施的地区，限定优势成立的环境。

items.zh: 项目规模虽小，却包含了大型推广可能遇到的大多数技术问题。
items.en: Small as the project was, it exposed most of the technical problems that a larger rollout might face.
answers: Small as the project was, it exposed most of the technical problems that a larger rollout might face.
items.notes: 形容词 + as 构成正式让步；that 从句限定 problems。

items.zh: 不管最终数字是多少，公布计算方法都能提高报告的可信度。
items.en: Whatever the final figure is, publishing the method of calculation will make the report more credible.
answers: Whatever the final figure is, publishing the method of calculation will make the report more credible.
items.notes: whatever 引出数值不影响的结论；动名词短语作主语。

items.zh: 这项措施对新用户很方便，对需要转移旧记录的人却很麻烦。
items.en: The measure is convenient for new users but cumbersome for those who need to transfer existing records.
answers: The measure is convenient for new users but cumbersome for those who need to transfer existing records.
items.notes: but 对照不同群体的体验；those who 避免重复 users。

items.zh: 诚然，回复率不高；不过，开放式回答提供了问卷数字无法呈现的细节。
items.en: Admittedly, the response rate was low; nevertheless, the open comments provided detail that the survey figures could not capture.
answers: Admittedly, the response rate was low; nevertheless, the open comments provided detail that the survey figures could not capture.
items.notes: admittedly 承认局限，nevertheless 引出仍有价值的证据。

items.zh: 无论错误是如何产生的，机构都应说明它将怎样防止错误再次发生。
items.en: However the error arose, the organisation should explain how it will prevent a recurrence.
answers: However the error arose, the organisation should explain how it will prevent a recurrence.
items.notes: however 在此表示无论以何种方式；how 引导说明内容。

items.zh: 虽然两组的平均得分相同，分数分布却明显不同。
items.en: While the two groups had the same mean score, the distribution of their scores differed markedly.
answers: While the two groups had the same mean score, the distribution of their scores differed markedly.
items.notes: while 对照平均值相同与分布不同。

items.zh: 即使投诉最终没有成立，调查过程也可能暴露程序上的薄弱环节。
items.en: Even when a complaint is not upheld, the investigation may reveal weaknesses in the procedure.
answers: Even when a complaint is not upheld, the investigation may reveal weaknesses in the procedure.
items.notes: even when 表示在某事实情形下仍可能有其他价值。

items.zh: 尽管自动化减少了常规工作，它也把更多判断责任转移给了少数高级员工。
items.en: Although automation reduced routine work, it also concentrated more responsibility for judgement among a small number of senior staff.
answers: Although automation reduced routine work, it also concentrated more responsibility for judgement among a small number of senior staff.
items.notes: although 让步后指出负担转移；responsibility for 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 考虑到维修成本，这座建筑更适合改造而不是拆除。
items.en: Given the maintenance costs, adapting the building would be preferable to demolishing it.
answers: Given the maintenance costs, adapting the building would be preferable to demolishing it.
items.notes: given 引出判断依据；preferable to 两端使用平行的动名词。

items.zh: 为减少测量误差，每台仪器在使用前都进行了校准。
items.en: To reduce measurement error, every instrument was calibrated before use.
answers: To reduce measurement error, every instrument was calibrated before use.
items.notes: 不定式表示目的；主句主语 instrument 是校准对象，不造成悬垂修饰。

items.zh: 从不同来源收集的数据必须先统一格式，才能合并分析。
items.en: Data collected from different sources must be put into a common format before being analysed together.
answers: Data collected from different sources must be put into a common format before being analysed together.
items.notes: collected 为后置被动修饰；before being analysed 保持被动关系。

items.zh: 在承认样本有限的同时，作者仍认为结果值得进一步验证。
items.en: Acknowledging the limited sample, the author nevertheless argues that the findings merit further testing.
answers: Acknowledging the limited sample, the author nevertheless argues that the findings merit further testing.
items.notes: 现在分词的逻辑主语是 author；nevertheless 表明让步关系。

items.zh: 若处理不当，匿名数据仍可能被重新识别。
items.en: If handled carelessly, anonymised data may still be linked back to individuals.
answers: If handled carelessly, anonymised data may still be linked back to individuals.
items.notes: if handled 是被动条件从句的省略形式，逻辑主语为 data。

items.zh: 完成现场检查后，工程师才批准重新开放大桥。
items.en: Having completed the site inspection, the engineers approved the reopening of the bridge.
answers: Having completed the site inspection, the engineers approved the reopening of the bridge.
items.notes: having done 强调检查先于批准，且两动作主语相同。

items.zh: 这项服务原本用于处理紧急请求，如今却被用来替代常规预约。
items.en: Originally intended for urgent requests, the service is now being used as a substitute for routine appointments.
answers: Originally intended for urgent requests, the service is now being used as a substitute for routine appointments.
items.notes: 过去分词短语修饰 service；be used as 表示被当作。

items.zh: 由于没有收到更新后的图纸，施工队按旧尺寸下了料。
items.en: Not having received the revised drawings, the construction team cut the materials to the old dimensions.
answers: Not having received the revised drawings, the construction team cut the materials to the old dimensions.
items.notes: not having received 表示先行的否定原因，逻辑主语明确。

items.zh: 把所有延误都归为技术问题，会掩盖培训不足造成的影响。
items.en: Classifying every delay as a technical issue would conceal the impact of inadequate training.
answers: Classifying every delay as a technical issue would conceal the impact of inadequate training.
items.notes: 动名词短语作主语；classify A as B 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 为了便于跨年比较，图表采用了经通胀调整后的价格。
items.en: To allow comparison across years, the chart uses prices adjusted for inflation.
answers: To allow comparison across years, the chart uses prices adjusted for inflation.
items.notes: adjusted for inflation 后置修饰 prices；to allow 表示方法目的。

items.zh: 入口被临时围栏挡住后，访客不得不绕到建筑后方。
items.en: With the entrance blocked by temporary fencing, visitors had to walk around to the rear of the building.
answers: With the entrance blocked by temporary fencing, visitors had to walk around to the rear of the building.
items.notes: with + 名词 + 过去分词构成独立结构，交代背景状态。

items.zh: 因担心问卷太长，团队删除了三个本可揭示重要差异的问题。
items.en: Concerned that the questionnaire was too long, the team removed three questions that might have revealed important differences.
answers: Concerned that the questionnaire was too long, the team removed three questions that might have revealed important differences.
items.notes: concerned 的逻辑主语是 team；might have revealed 表示失去的可能信息。

items.zh: 要被纳入审查，证据必须能够追溯到原始来源。
items.en: To be included in the review, evidence must be traceable to its original source.
answers: To be included in the review, evidence must be traceable to its original source.
items.notes: 被动不定式说明纳入条件；traceable to 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 报告没有把试点成本与后续推广成本区分开来，因此高估了长期支出。
items.en: Failing to distinguish pilot costs from rollout costs, the report overestimates long-term expenditure.
answers: Failing to distinguish pilot costs from rollout costs, the report overestimates long-term expenditure.
items.notes: failing to do 表示主句判断的原因；distinguish A from B。

items.zh: 相关人员均已离职，核实这段口头记录变得更加困难。
items.en: All the staff concerned having left, it became harder to verify the oral account.
answers: All the staff concerned having left, it became harder to verify the oral account.
items.notes: 名词 + having done 构成独立主格，说明主句背景。

items.zh: 与其假定沉默代表同意，不如主动询问未回复的人。
items.en: Rather than assuming that silence indicates consent, researchers should contact those who have not responded.
answers: Rather than assuming that silence indicates consent, researchers should contact those who have not responded.
items.notes: rather than doing 与主句建议配合；that 从句说明错误假设。

items.zh: 审批后才提出的证据不能用来证明当时的决定合理。
items.en: Evidence produced only after approval cannot be used to justify the decision made at the time.
answers: Evidence produced only after approval cannot be used to justify the decision made at the time.
items.notes: 两个过去分词短语分别限定 evidence 和 decision。

items.zh: 在不降低安全标准的前提下，流程可以缩短两天。
items.en: The process can be shortened by two days without lowering safety standards.
answers: The process can be shortened by two days without lowering safety standards.
items.notes: without doing 表示排除的代价；lower standards 是自然搭配。

items.zh: 工作人员需要接受培训，以识别何时应把个案转交专家。
items.en: Staff need training to recognise when a case should be referred to a specialist.
answers: Staff need training to recognise when a case should be referred to a specialist.
items.notes: to recognise 表示培训目的；when 引导识别内容。

items.zh: 这份摘要删去了技术细节，使主要结论更容易看清。
items.en: The summary omits technical detail, making the main findings easier to identify.
answers: The summary omits technical detail, making the main findings easier to identify.
items.notes: making 分词短语表示前句产生的结果。

items.zh: 如果把调查结果孤立地看，就容易忽略同期政策变化的影响。
items.en: Viewed in isolation, the survey results may obscure the effect of policy changes introduced during the same period.
answers: Viewed in isolation, the survey results may obscure the effect of policy changes introduced during the same period.
items.notes: viewed 的逻辑主语是 results；introduced 后置修饰 changes。

items.zh: 市政府聘请了一名顾问，负责评估此前被忽视的几个选址。
items.en: The council appointed a consultant to assess several locations previously overlooked.
answers: The council appointed a consultant to assess several locations previously overlooked.
items.notes: to assess 表示顾问任务；previously overlooked 压缩被动定语。

items.zh: 由于预计需求会上升，诊所把两间储藏室改成了诊室。
items.en: Anticipating higher demand, the clinic converted two storage rooms into consulting rooms.
answers: Anticipating higher demand, the clinic converted two storage rooms into consulting rooms.
items.notes: anticipating 的逻辑主语是 clinic；convert A into B。

items.zh: 没有明确的基线，就无法判断观察到的变化是否异常。
items.en: Without a clear baseline, it is impossible to judge whether the observed change is unusual.
answers: Without a clear baseline, it is impossible to judge whether the observed change is unusual.
items.notes: without 引出缺失的判断基准；whether 从句为判断对象。

items.zh: 除了降低费用，该方案还让申请人更容易追踪办理进度。
items.en: In addition to reducing the fee, the scheme makes it easier for applicants to track their progress.
answers: In addition to reducing the fee, the scheme makes it easier for applicants to track their progress.
items.notes: in addition to 后接动名词；it 为形式宾语结构的一部分。

items.zh: 新流程所需时间不到旧流程的一半，却要求更多人工核对。
items.en: The new process takes less than half as long as the old one, although it requires more manual checking.
answers: The new process takes less than half as long as the old one, although it requires more manual checking.
items.notes: half as long as 表示时间比例；although 引出代价。

items.zh: 道路离学校越近，限速措施带来的安全收益通常越大。
items.en: The closer a road is to a school, the greater the safety benefit of a lower speed limit tends to be.
answers: The closer a road is to a school, the greater the safety benefit of a lower speed limit tends to be.
items.notes: the + 比较级联动结构；benefit of 表示措施带来的收益。

items.zh: 与其说问题出在资金不足，不如说出在资金分配不均。
items.en: The problem is less a shortage of funding than an uneven distribution of it.
answers: The problem is less a shortage of funding than an uneven distribution of it.
items.notes: less A than B 表示与其说 A 不如说 B；it 指 funding。

items.zh: 该地区的住房存量增长速度是人口增长速度的两倍。
items.en: The housing stock in the area grew at twice the rate of the population.
answers: The housing stock in the area grew at twice the rate of the population.
items.notes: at twice the rate of 是正式的倍数表达，避免 twice faster。

items.zh: 结果远没有标题暗示的那么确定。
items.en: The results are far less conclusive than the headline suggests.
answers: The results are far less conclusive than the headline suggests.
items.notes: far 修饰比较级；conclusive 表示能得出明确结论。

items.zh: 等待时间略有缩短，但缩短幅度不足以让大多数患者察觉。
items.en: Waiting times fell slightly, but not enough for most patients to notice a difference.
answers: Waiting times fell slightly, but not enough for most patients to notice a difference.
items.notes: not enough for someone to do 表示结果未达到可感知程度。

items.zh: 受访者年龄越大，他们使用自动续费服务的可能性越低。
items.en: The older respondents were, the less likely they were to use automatic renewal services.
answers: The older respondents were, the less likely they were to use automatic renewal services.
items.notes: the older ..., the less likely ... 保持比较对象一致。

items.zh: 第二次估算比第一次高出近三成，主要因为纳入了维护费用。
items.en: The second estimate was nearly thirty per cent higher than the first, mainly because maintenance costs were included.
answers: The second estimate was nearly thirty per cent higher than the first, mainly because maintenance costs were included.
items.notes: 百分比 + higher than 表示相对差异；because 说明变化来源。

items.zh: 与总成本相比，节省的金额小得不成比例。
items.en: The amount saved is disproportionately small in relation to the total cost.
answers: The amount saved is disproportionately small in relation to the total cost.
items.notes: in relation to 提供比较基准；disproportionately 说明比例失衡。

items.zh: 这个解释太笼统，无法说明为什么只有一个地区出现下降。
items.en: The explanation is too general to account for why only one region experienced a decline.
answers: The explanation is too general to account for why only one region experienced a decline.
items.notes: too ... to 表示程度导致的不足；account for 后接 why 从句。

items.zh: 该设备的耗电量与普通冰箱相当，但购买价格高出四倍。
items.en: The device uses about as much electricity as a standard refrigerator but costs five times as much to buy.
answers: The device uses about as much electricity as a standard refrigerator but costs five times as much to buy.
items.notes: five times as much 表示总量为五倍，即高出四倍。

items.zh: 样本越小，个别极端值对平均数的影响就越大。
items.en: The smaller the sample, the more influence a single extreme value has on the mean.
answers: The smaller the sample, the more influence a single extreme value has on the mean.
items.notes: 联动比较结构说明样本量与极端值影响的关系。

items.zh: 公交车并没有火车快，但在偏远村庄覆盖得更广。
items.en: Buses are not as fast as trains, but they provide much wider coverage in remote villages.
answers: Buses are not as fast as trains, but they provide much wider coverage in remote villages.
items.notes: not as ... as 表示不及；wider coverage 比 cover more widely 更自然。

items.zh: 改善最明显的并不是起点最低的学校。
items.en: The schools that improved most were not necessarily those with the lowest starting points.
answers: The schools that improved most were not necessarily those with the lowest starting points.
items.notes: those 代替 schools；not necessarily 避免绝对化。

items.zh: 这一差异大到不能只用随机波动来解释。
items.en: The difference is too large to be explained by random variation alone.
answers: The difference is too large to be explained by random variation alone.
items.notes: too large to be explained 使用被动不定式；alone 限定解释因素。

items.zh: 今年申请人数与去年大致相同，但符合条件的比例更高。
items.en: The number of applications was broadly similar to last year's, but a higher proportion met the eligibility criteria.
answers: The number of applications was broadly similar to last year's, but a higher proportion met the eligibility criteria.
items.notes: similar to 而非 similar with；last year's 省略重复名词。

items.zh: 维修费用越拖越高，最终超过了更换设备的价格。
items.en: The cost of repair rose steadily until it exceeded the price of replacing the equipment.
answers: The cost of repair rose steadily until it exceeded the price of replacing the equipment.
items.notes: exceed 直接接宾语，不用 exceed than；until 表示达到结果点。

items.zh: 新增的十分钟并没有让测试更准确，反而使完成率下降。
items.en: The additional ten minutes made the test no more accurate and instead reduced the completion rate.
answers: The additional ten minutes made the test no more accurate and instead reduced the completion rate.
items.notes: no more accurate 表示并未提高；instead 引出相反后果。

items.zh: 社区中心的使用率是图书馆的三倍，但开放时间少得多。
items.en: The community centre was used three times as often as the library despite being open for far fewer hours.
answers: The community centre was used three times as often as the library despite being open for far fewer hours.
items.notes: three times as often as 比 three times more 准确；despite 后接动名词。

items.zh: 这项补贴规模虽小，却足以改变一些家庭的决定。
items.en: Although modest in size, the subsidy is large enough to influence the decisions of some households.
answers: Although modest in size, the subsidy is large enough to influence the decisions of some households.
items.notes: modest in size 与 large enough 分别表达规模和作用门槛。

items.zh: 需求增长得比预计快，因此候补名单比计划提前两个月启用。
items.en: Demand grew faster than expected, so the waiting list was introduced two months earlier than planned.
answers: Demand grew faster than expected, so the waiting list was introduced two months earlier than planned.
items.notes: 两个省略结构 expected 与 planned 避免重复完整从句。

items.zh: 两个群体之间的差异没有同一群体内部的差异大。
items.en: The difference between the two groups was smaller than the variation within each group.
answers: The difference between the two groups was smaller than the variation within each group.
items.notes: between 用于组间，within 用于组内，比较对象明确。

items.zh: 该方法不仅更便宜，而且在数据缺失时更不容易产生误导。
items.en: The method is not only cheaper but also less likely to mislead when data are missing.
answers: The method is not only cheaper but also less likely to mislead when data are missing.
items.notes: not only ... but also 连接两个比较性质；less likely to do。

items.zh: 警告写得如此含糊，以至于许多读者把建议当成了强制要求。
items.en: The warning was so vaguely worded that many readers mistook advice for a compulsory requirement.
answers: The warning was so vaguely worded that many readers mistook advice for a compulsory requirement.
items.notes: so ... that 表示程度结果；mistake A for B。

items.zh: 收入最低的五分之一家庭承担的交通费用比例最高。
items.en: The lowest-income fifth of households spent the largest proportion of their income on transport.
answers: The lowest-income fifth of households spent the largest proportion of their income on transport.
items.notes: the lowest-income fifth 表示最低五分位；spend ... on。

items.zh: 这项措施可以缓解交通拥堵，但不能彻底解决通勤时间过长的问题。
items.en: The measure may ease congestion, but it cannot completely solve the problem of lengthy commutes.
answers: The measure may ease congestion, but it cannot completely solve the problem of lengthy commutes.
items.notes: “缓解拥堵”用 ease congestion；不要直译为 relieve the traffic pressure。

items.zh: 政府应采取切实措施保护租户免遭非法驱逐。
items.en: The government should take practical steps to protect tenants from unlawful eviction.
answers: The government should take practical steps to protect tenants from unlawful eviction.
items.notes: take steps 比 take measures 更适合具体行动；protect A from B。

items.zh: 越来越多的毕业生选择在进入职场前积累实际经验。
items.en: A growing number of graduates choose to gain practical experience before entering the workforce.
answers: A growing number of graduates choose to gain practical experience before entering the workforce.
items.notes: gain experience 不用 learn experience；enter the workforce 不加 into。

items.zh: 这项政策引发了关于个人责任与公共支持界限的讨论。
items.en: The policy has prompted debate about the boundary between personal responsibility and public support.
answers: The policy has prompted debate about the boundary between personal responsibility and public support.
items.notes: prompt debate 比 cause people's discussion 自然。

items.zh: 学校不能只追求考试成绩而忽视学生的身心健康。
items.en: Schools should not pursue examination results at the expense of students' physical and mental well-being.
answers: Schools should not pursue examination results at the expense of students' physical and mental well-being.
items.notes: pursue results 与 at the expense of 构成自然论证表达。

items.zh: 这门课程帮助学生培养评估网络信息可靠性的能力。
items.en: The course helps students develop the ability to assess the reliability of information online.
answers: The course helps students develop the ability to assess the reliability of information online.
items.notes: develop the ability to do，不写 cultivate one's ability of doing。

items.zh: 城市需要应对人口老龄化带来的住房需求变化。
items.en: Cities need to respond to changes in housing demand caused by an ageing population.
answers: Cities need to respond to changes in housing demand caused by an ageing population.
items.notes: respond to changes；caused by 明确变化来源。

items.zh: 公司向客户作出了承诺，却没有履行。
items.en: The company made a promise to its customers but failed to keep it.
answers: The company made a promise to its customers but failed to keep it.
items.notes: make a promise 与 keep a promise 是固定搭配；不能 do a promise。

items.zh: 广告夸大了产品的好处，却淡化了持续使用的成本。
items.en: The advertisement exaggerated the product's benefits while downplaying the cost of continued use.
answers: The advertisement exaggerated the product's benefits while downplaying the cost of continued use.
items.notes: exaggerate benefits 与 downplay costs 形成自然对照。

items.zh: 仅仅增加罚款未必能阻止企业重复违规。
items.en: Simply increasing fines may not deter companies from repeating the offence.
answers: Simply increasing fines may not deter companies from repeating the offence.
items.notes: deter someone from doing 表示阻止；repeat an offence 比 make violations 自然。

items.zh: 地方政府应为居民参与规划提供真正的机会。
items.en: Local authorities should give residents a genuine opportunity to participate in planning.
answers: Local authorities should give residents a genuine opportunity to participate in planning.
items.notes: give someone an opportunity to do；participate in 后接活动。

items.zh: 这项发现对我们理解儿童如何形成阅读习惯作出了贡献。
items.en: The finding contributes to our understanding of how children develop reading habits.
answers: The finding contributes to our understanding of how children develop reading habits.
items.notes: contribute to 后接名词；develop a habit 比 form up a habit 正确。

items.zh: 博物馆推出夜间开放，以吸引平时因工作无法参观的人。
items.en: The museum introduced evening opening hours to attract people who are normally unable to visit because of work.
answers: The museum introduced evening opening hours to attract people who are normally unable to visit because of work.
items.notes: introduce opening hours 比 open a night service 自然。

items.zh: 这次故障给医院的预约安排造成了严重干扰。
