items.en: The failure caused serious disruption to the hospital's appointment schedule.
answers: The failure caused serious disruption to the hospital's appointment schedule.
items.notes: cause disruption to 是自然搭配，不用 bring inconvenience for。

items.zh: 我们不能因为一个案例引人注目，就得出普遍结论。
items.en: We should not draw a general conclusion from a single striking case.
answers: We should not draw a general conclusion from a single striking case.
items.notes: draw a conclusion from evidence，不用 get a conclusion。

items.zh: 新规定给小型慈善机构带来了额外的行政负担。
items.en: The new regulation places an additional administrative burden on small charities.
answers: The new regulation places an additional administrative burden on small charities.
items.notes: place a burden on 比 bring pressure to 更准确。

items.zh: 公共图书馆在缩小数字技能差距方面发挥着重要作用。
items.en: Public libraries play an important role in narrowing the digital skills gap.
answers: Public libraries play an important role in narrowing the digital skills gap.
items.notes: play a role in doing；narrow a gap 是自然搭配。

items.zh: 企业通过夸大原价，制造了折扣很大的假象。
items.en: The retailer created the impression of a large discount by inflating the original price.
answers: The retailer created the impression of a large discount by inflating the original price.
items.notes: create the impression of；inflate a price 表示人为抬高。

items.zh: 委员会最终采纳了居民提出的折中方案。
items.en: The committee eventually adopted the compromise proposed by residents.
answers: The committee eventually adopted the compromise proposed by residents.
items.notes: adopt a proposal 表示正式采纳，不用 accept to the plan。

items.zh: 缺乏维护会缩短设备的使用寿命。
items.en: Poor maintenance shortens the working life of the equipment.
answers: Poor maintenance shortens the working life of the equipment.
items.notes: shorten the working life 比 reduce the use age 自然。

items.zh: 这项研究提高了人们对室内空气质量的关注。
items.en: The study has raised awareness of indoor air quality.
answers: The study has raised awareness of indoor air quality.
items.notes: raise awareness of 是固定表达，不用 improve people's attention。

items.zh: 延长营业时间并没有带来预期中的销售增长。
items.en: Longer opening hours did not produce the expected increase in sales.
answers: Longer opening hours did not produce the expected increase in sales.
items.notes: produce an increase in 比 bring the sales growth 更自然。

items.zh: 管理层必须正视员工流失率上升的问题。
items.en: Management must address the rise in staff turnover.
answers: Management must address the rise in staff turnover.
items.notes: address a problem/rise 表示着手处理，不是 face to。

items.zh: 志愿者承担了联系偏远住户的任务。
items.en: Volunteers took responsibility for contacting residents in remote areas.
answers: Volunteers took responsibility for contacting residents in remote areas.
items.notes: take responsibility for doing，不用 undertake the responsibility to。

items.zh: 该应用会记录用户的选择，以便日后提供更相关的建议。
items.en: The app records users' choices so that it can offer more relevant suggestions later.
answers: The app records users' choices so that it can offer more relevant suggestions later.
items.notes: offer suggestions 比 provide advices 正确；advice 不可数。

items.zh: 这项研究提供了有关通勤方式变化的有用信息。
items.en: The study provides useful information about changes in commuting patterns.
answers: The study provides useful information about changes in commuting patterns.
items.notes: information 不可数，不写 informations；changes 为可数复数。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 委员会需要更多证据，而不是更多未经验证的观点。
items.en: The committee needs more evidence, not more unverified opinions.
answers: The committee needs more evidence, not more unverified opinions.
items.notes: evidence 通常不可数；opinion 在此指多条观点，可用复数。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 所有设备抵达后，工作人员会逐件检查。
items.en: When all the equipment arrives, staff will inspect each item separately.
answers: When all the equipment arrives, staff will inspect each item separately.
items.notes: equipment 不可数，谓语用单数；item 可数用于逐件表达。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 旅行者可以在网站上找到住宿和公共交通方面的建议。
items.en: Travellers can find advice on accommodation and public transport on the website.
answers: Travellers can find advice on accommodation and public transport on the website.
items.notes: advice 与 accommodation 在此均不可数；advice on 表示关于。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 我们开展了一项调查，而不是进行了一项泛泛的研究。
items.en: We conducted a survey rather than carrying out a broad piece of research.
answers: We conducted a survey rather than carrying out a broad piece of research.
items.notes: research 不可数；需要计数时可说 a piece of research。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 该地区经历了快速发展，但基础设施没有同步改善。
items.en: The area has experienced rapid development, but its infrastructure has not improved at the same pace.
answers: The area has experienced rapid development, but its infrastructure has not improved at the same pace.
items.notes: development 表示过程时不可数；infrastructure 通常不可数。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 这份工作需要耐心、良好的判断力和对细节的关注。
items.en: The role requires patience, sound judgement, and attention to detail.
answers: The role requires patience, sound judgement, and attention to detail.
items.notes: 三个抽象名词泛指品质时不用冠词；attention to detail 是固定表达。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 参与者完成了两项任务，并在每项任务后得到反馈。
items.en: Participants completed two tasks and received feedback after each one.
answers: Participants completed two tasks and received feedback after each one.
items.notes: feedback 不可数；one 回指可数名词 task。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 新的立法给雇主带来了几项具体义务。
items.en: The new legislation imposes several specific obligations on employers.
answers: The new legislation imposes several specific obligations on employers.
items.notes: legislation 不可数；obligation 可数；impose A on B。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 该方案需要额外资金和一支接受过专业培训的团队。
items.en: The scheme requires additional funding and a team with specialist training.
answers: The scheme requires additional funding and a team with specialist training.
items.notes: funding 与 training 在此不可数；team 前需要冠词。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 并非所有进步都能用单一指标衡量。
items.en: Not all progress can be measured by a single indicator.
answers: Not all progress can be measured by a single indicator.
items.notes: progress 不可数，不写 progresses；indicator 可数。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 我们比较了三种软件，但没有一种完全符合要求。
items.en: We compared three software packages, none of which fully met the requirements.
answers: We compared three software packages, none of which fully met the requirements.
items.notes: software 不可数；计数时使用 packages 或 applications。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 警方公布了一条新证据，但没有透露其来源。
items.en: The police disclosed a new piece of evidence but did not reveal its source.
answers: The police disclosed a new piece of evidence but did not reveal its source.
items.notes: 一条证据用 a piece of evidence，不能用 an evidence。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 繁重的工作量可能损害员工士气和服务质量。
items.en: A heavy workload can damage staff morale and the quality of service.
answers: A heavy workload can damage staff morale and the quality of service.
items.notes: workload 可数，morale 不可数；quality of service 表示整体质量。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 该报告对解决这一问题提出了三项建议。
items.en: The report makes three recommendations for addressing the problem.
answers: The report makes three recommendations for addressing the problem.
items.notes: recommendation 可数；recommendation for 后接动名词。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 我们需要一项长期战略，而不是一系列互不关联的短期行动。
items.en: We need a long-term strategy rather than a series of unrelated short-term actions.
answers: We need a long-term strategy rather than a series of unrelated short-term actions.
items.notes: strategy 可数需冠词；a series of 后接复数。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 委员会在作出决定前征求了法律意见。
items.en: The committee sought legal advice before reaching a decision.
answers: The committee sought legal advice before reaching a decision.
items.notes: seek advice 与 reach a decision 是自然搭配；advice 不加 an。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 农村地区缺少可靠的宽带连接，这是发展的一个障碍。
items.en: The lack of reliable broadband in rural areas is a barrier to development.
answers: The lack of reliable broadband in rural areas is a barrier to development.
items.notes: the lack of 指具体缺失；a barrier to 是固定搭配。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 图表显示了能源消费的总体下降和家庭支出的轻微上升。
items.en: The chart shows an overall fall in energy consumption and a slight rise in household expenditure.
answers: The chart shows an overall fall in energy consumption and a slight rise in household expenditure.
items.notes: a fall/rise in 表示一次变化；consumption、expenditure 在此不可数。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 我们收到的投诉很少，但每一项都涉及严重的安全问题。
items.en: We received few complaints, but each one concerned a serious safety issue.
answers: We received few complaints, but each one concerned a serious safety issue.
items.notes: few 修饰可数复数并表示数量少；each one 接单数谓语。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 这次咨询给公众提供了表达意见的机会。
items.en: The consultation gave the public an opportunity to express their views.
answers: The consultation gave the public an opportunity to express their views.
items.notes: the public 表示公众整体；an opportunity to do。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 该研究缺乏有关低收入家庭经历的数据。
items.en: The study lacks data on the experiences of low-income households.
answers: The study lacks data on the experiences of low-income households.
items.notes: data on 表示关于某主题的数据；experiences 指多种经历。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 一次培训无法解决多年积累的技能短缺。
items.en: A single training session cannot resolve a skills shortage that has developed over many years.
answers: A single training session cannot resolve a skills shortage that has developed over many years.
items.notes: training session 可数；skills shortage 是常见复合名词。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 交通拥堵会造成空气污染，也会给通勤者带来压力。
items.en: Traffic congestion causes air pollution and places stress on commuters.
answers: Traffic congestion causes air pollution and places stress on commuters.
items.notes: congestion、pollution、stress 在此均作不可数概念。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 作者引用了两项研究，但没有说明哪一项支持核心论点。
items.en: The author cites two studies but does not indicate which one supports the central argument.
answers: The author cites two studies but does not indicate which one supports the central argument.
items.notes: study 可数；which one 避免重复名词并要求单数谓语。
tags: 中式英语：名词冠词与可数性

items.zh: 使用共享单车可以减少短途驾车，但前提是城市有安全的自行车道。
items.en: Using shared bicycles can reduce short car journeys, provided that the city has safe cycle lanes.
answers: Using shared bicycles can reduce short car journeys, provided that the city has safe cycle lanes.
items.notes: 用动名词短语作行为主语；不能写 by using bicycles can reduce。

items.zh: 近年来，越来越多的人开始在家办公。
items.en: In recent years, a growing number of people have begun to work from home.
answers: In recent years, a growing number of people have begun to work from home.
items.notes: 不用 there have more people；a growing number of 作主语并用复数谓语。

items.zh: 从图表可以看出，最高收入组的储蓄率下降了。
items.en: The chart shows that the savings rate fell among the highest-income group.
answers: The chart shows that the savings rate fell among the highest-income group.
items.notes: 让 chart 作 show 的主语，比 according to the chart we can see 简洁。

items.zh: 许多城市面临的一个问题是，房价上涨速度超过了工资。
items.en: One problem facing many cities is that house prices are rising faster than wages.
answers: One problem facing many cities is that house prices are rising faster than wages.
items.notes: problem facing cities 避免 cities have a problem that；that 从句作表语。

items.zh: 天气恶劣导致航班取消，数百名乘客因此滞留。
items.en: Severe weather led to flight cancellations, leaving hundreds of passengers stranded.
answers: Severe weather led to flight cancellations, leaving hundreds of passengers stranded.
items.notes: weather 作原因主语；leaving 分词短语表达结果。

items.zh: 通过这项调查，我们发现老年用户更看重人工帮助。
items.en: The survey revealed that older users placed greater value on human assistance.
answers: The survey revealed that older users placed greater value on human assistance.
items.notes: 让 survey revealed 直接呈现证据，避免 through the survey lets us know。

items.zh: 这份报告的目的不是证明政策失败，而是识别需要改进的环节。
items.en: The purpose of the report is not to prove that the policy failed but to identify where improvement is needed.
answers: The purpose of the report is not to prove that the policy failed but to identify where improvement is needed.
items.notes: purpose 作主语；not to ... but to 保持结构平行。

items.zh: 学校附近缺少人行横道，使儿童过街更加危险。
items.en: The absence of a pedestrian crossing near the school makes it more dangerous for children to cross the road.
answers: The absence of a pedestrian crossing near the school makes it more dangerous for children to cross the road.
items.notes: absence 作因果主语；it 为形式宾语，for children to cross 为真正内容。

items.zh: 只有提供托儿服务，部分家长才能参加晚间课程。
items.en: Providing childcare would enable some parents to attend evening classes.
answers: Providing childcare would enable some parents to attend evening classes.
items.notes: 用 providing childcare 作主语并搭配 enable someone to do。

items.zh: 这个变化背后有两个原因：家庭规模缩小，以及更多年轻人延迟购房。
items.en: Two factors help explain the change: smaller households and the tendency of more young adults to delay buying a home.
answers: Two factors help explain the change: smaller households and the tendency of more young adults to delay buying a home.
items.notes: factor 作解释主语；避免 the reason is because。

items.zh: 道路拓宽后，穿过路口所需的时间反而增加了。
items.en: Widening the road increased the time needed to cross the junction.
answers: Widening the road increased the time needed to cross the junction.
items.notes: widening the road 作动作主语；needed to cross 后置修饰 time。

items.zh: 公众最关心的不是谁提出了计划，而是计划会影响哪些服务。
items.en: What concerns the public most is not who proposed the plan but which services it will affect.
answers: What concerns the public most is not who proposed the plan but which services it will affect.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；affect 直接接宾语，不用 affect to。

items.zh: 由于缺少明确说明，一些用户把可选项目当成了必填项目。
items.en: The lack of clear instructions led some users to treat an optional field as compulsory.
answers: The lack of clear instructions led some users to treat an optional field as compulsory.
items.notes: lack 作原因主语；lead someone to do；treat A as B。

items.zh: 如果只关注游客数量，就会忽略旅游业对当地生活成本的影响。
items.en: A focus on visitor numbers alone would overlook tourism's effect on the local cost of living.
answers: A focus on visitor numbers alone would overlook tourism's effect on the local cost of living.
items.notes: 名词短语 a focus 作主语，避免 if only focus 的无主句。

items.zh: 越来越依赖自动化，意味着系统故障的影响会更广。
items.en: Greater reliance on automation means that a system failure would have wider consequences.
answers: Greater reliance on automation means that a system failure would have wider consequences.
items.notes: reliance 作主语；means that 后接结果判断。

items.zh: 这并不意味着农村居民不愿使用线上服务。
items.en: This does not mean that rural residents are unwilling to use online services.
answers: This does not mean that rural residents are unwilling to use online services.
items.notes: 不用 it doesn't represent；mean that 表达推论含义。

items.zh: 有必要区分缺乏兴趣和缺乏参加条件。
items.en: It is necessary to distinguish a lack of interest from a lack of opportunity to participate.
answers: It is necessary to distinguish a lack of interest from a lack of opportunity to participate.
items.notes: it 作形式主语；distinguish A from B。

items.zh: 对独居者而言，附近有一家小商店可能比选择更多更重要。
items.en: For people who live alone, having a small shop nearby may matter more than having a wider choice.
answers: For people who live alone, having a small shop nearby may matter more than having a wider choice.
items.notes: 两个 having 短语形成平行比较；nearby 不需介词。

items.zh: 报告中的一个明显不足，是没有比较政策实施前后的情况。
items.en: An obvious weakness of the report is its failure to compare conditions before and after the policy was introduced.
answers: An obvious weakness of the report is its failure to compare conditions before and after the policy was introduced.
items.notes: failure to compare 作表语核心；before and after 对照明确。

items.zh: 把所有年轻人视为数字技术熟练者，会掩盖群体内部的差异。
items.en: Treating all young people as digitally confident obscures differences within the group.
answers: Treating all young people as digitally confident obscures differences within the group.
items.notes: treating 作主语；treat A as B；within 表示组内。

items.zh: 该数字上升，不一定说明实际行为发生了同等幅度的变化。
items.en: An increase in the figure does not necessarily indicate an equivalent change in actual behaviour.
answers: An increase in the figure does not necessarily indicate an equivalent change in actual behaviour.
items.notes: increase 作主语；not necessarily 防止推论过度。

items.zh: 对截止日期的误解造成的延误，比系统故障造成的还多。
items.en: Misunderstanding the deadline caused more delays than the system failure did.
answers: Misunderstanding the deadline caused more delays than the system failure did.
items.notes: 动名词短语作原因主语；did 代替重复 caused。

items.zh: 随着生活成本上升，固定金额的补贴实际价值会下降。
items.en: As the cost of living rises, a fixed cash allowance loses value in real terms.
answers: As the cost of living rises, a fixed cash allowance loses value in real terms.
items.notes: allowance 作主语并用 lose value；in real terms 表示实际价值。

items.zh: 设立新机构本身不会自动改善各部门之间的协调。
items.en: Creating a new agency will not in itself improve coordination between departments.
answers: Creating a new agency will not in itself improve coordination between departments.
items.notes: creating 作主语；in itself 表示行为本身不足以产生结果。

items.zh: 报告得出的结论是，问题出在执行不一致，而不是规则缺失。
items.en: The report concludes that the problem lies in inconsistent enforcement rather than an absence of rules.
answers: The report concludes that the problem lies in inconsistent enforcement rather than an absence of rules.
items.notes: report concludes 比 the conclusion of report thinks 正确；lie in 表示原因所在。

items.zh: 请告知目前预计的完成日期。
items.en: Could you please confirm the current expected completion date?
answers: Could you please confirm the current expected completion date?
items.notes: 正式询问用 could you please confirm，避免直接命令 tell me。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 很遗憾，我们无法在没有身份证明的情况下处理申请。
items.en: Unfortunately, we are unable to process the application without proof of identity.
answers: Unfortunately, we are unable to process the application without proof of identity.
items.notes: be unable to 比 cannot do it 更正式；proof of identity 是固定表达。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 感谢你提醒我们注意网页上的错误。
items.en: Thank you for bringing the error on the website to our attention.
answers: Thank you for bringing the error on the website to our attention.
items.notes: bring something to someone's attention 是正式致谢搭配。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 为免产生疑问，本次退款只涵盖票价，不包括预订费。
items.en: For the avoidance of doubt, the refund covers the ticket price only and excludes the booking fee.
answers: For the avoidance of doubt, the refund covers the ticket price only and excludes the booking fee.
items.notes: for the avoidance of doubt 用于正式澄清；cover 与 exclude 对照范围。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 如果附件无法打开，我很乐意换一种格式重新发送。
items.en: Should the attachment fail to open, I would be happy to resend it in a different format.
answers: Should the attachment fail to open, I would be happy to resend it in a different format.
items.notes: should 倒装使条件更正式礼貌；in a format 表示文件格式。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 烦请在方便时确认你是否仍计划出席。
items.en: At your convenience, please confirm whether you still intend to attend.
answers: At your convenience, please confirm whether you still intend to attend.
items.notes: at your convenience 表示时间礼貌；intend to attend 比 have plan to 更自然。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 我们理解延误造成了不便，并正在调查原因。
items.en: We recognise the inconvenience caused by the delay and are investigating its cause.
answers: We recognise the inconvenience caused by the delay and are investigating its cause.
items.notes: recognise the inconvenience 比 we are sorry to make you inconvenient 得体。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 你提出的问题超出了本团队的职责范围，我已将其转交相关部门。
items.en: Your query falls outside this team's remit, so I have referred it to the appropriate department.
answers: Your query falls outside this team's remit, so I have referred it to the appropriate department.
items.notes: fall outside a remit 与 refer something to 是正式办公表达。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 请注意，提交表格并不保证申请会获批。
items.en: Please note that submitting the form does not guarantee approval.
answers: Please note that submitting the form does not guarantee approval.
items.notes: please note that 用于重要提示；approval 不可数。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 为便于我们调查，请提供交易日期和参考编号。
items.en: To assist our investigation, please provide the date of the transaction and the reference number.
answers: To assist our investigation, please provide the date of the transaction and the reference number.
items.notes: to assist our investigation 说明请求理由，语气更合作。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 我们原则上支持该提议，但希望先澄清两项实际问题。
items.en: We support the proposal in principle but would like two practical issues to be clarified first.
answers: We support the proposal in principle but would like two practical issues to be clarified first.
items.notes: in principle 保留条件；would like 被动不定式使要求更礼貌。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 此次提醒并非催促立即回复，而是确保信息已送达。
items.en: This reminder is not intended to demand an immediate response but to ensure that the information has been received.
answers: This reminder is not intended to demand an immediate response but to ensure that the information has been received.
items.notes: be intended to；not ... but to 平行说明目的。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 如先前邮件所述，报价将在本周五失效。
items.en: As stated in our earlier email, the quotation will expire this Friday.
answers: As stated in our earlier email, the quotation will expire this Friday.
items.notes: as stated 比 according to what I said 更简洁正式；quotation 指正式报价。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 我们无法接受目前版本，因为它没有反映约定的修改。
items.en: We are unable to accept the current version because it does not reflect the agreed changes.
answers: We are unable to accept the current version because it does not reflect the agreed changes.
items.notes: reflect changes 表示体现修改；语气明确而不带人身指责。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 请放心，你提供的信息只会用于处理本次投诉。
items.en: Please be assured that the information you provide will be used solely to handle this complaint.
answers: Please be assured that the information you provide will be used solely to handle this complaint.
items.notes: please be assured that 用于正式安抚；solely 限定用途。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 如果我对你的要求理解有误，请予以指正。
items.en: Please correct me if I have misunderstood your request.
answers: Please correct me if I have misunderstood your request.
items.notes: 直接承担理解责任，比 if you didn't explain clearly 更得体。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 我们希望就修订后的时间安排征求你的意见。
items.en: We would welcome your views on the revised timetable.
answers: We would welcome your views on the revised timetable.
items.notes: would welcome your views 比 want to hear your ideas 更正式。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 该决定不会影响你对评估结果提出申诉的权利。
items.en: The decision does not affect your right to appeal against the outcome of the assessment.
answers: The decision does not affect your right to appeal against the outcome of the assessment.
items.notes: right to do；appeal against a decision/outcome。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 由于需求量异常高，回复可能比平时多花几个工作日。
items.en: Owing to exceptionally high demand, responses may take several working days longer than usual.
answers: Owing to exceptionally high demand, responses may take several working days longer than usual.
items.notes: owing to 适合正式说明原因；longer than usual 提供合理预期。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 若你愿意，我们可以安排一次简短通话来解决剩余问题。
items.en: If helpful, we can arrange a brief call to resolve the outstanding issues.
answers: If helpful, we can arrange a brief call to resolve the outstanding issues.
items.notes: if helpful 是克制的提议；outstanding 在此指尚未解决。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 我们注意到发票上的地址与登记信息不一致。
items.en: We note that the address on the invoice differs from the details held on file.
answers: We note that the address on the invoice differs from the details held on file.
items.notes: we note that 中性指出问题；differ from 而非 be different with。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 在采取进一步行动前，我们想给你一个回应的机会。
items.en: Before taking further action, we would like to give you an opportunity to respond.
answers: Before taking further action, we would like to give you an opportunity to respond.
items.notes: would like 与 give an opportunity to respond 兼顾程序和礼貌。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 感谢你的耐心等待，我们会在调查完成后立即更新情况。
items.en: Thank you for your patience; we will provide an update as soon as the investigation is complete.
answers: Thank you for your patience; we will provide an update as soon as the investigation is complete.
items.notes: thank you for your patience；provide an update 比 tell the newest situation 自然。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 请把这封邮件视为收到材料的确认，而不是批准通知。
items.en: Please treat this email as confirmation of receipt, not as notice of approval.
answers: Please treat this email as confirmation of receipt, not as notice of approval.
items.notes: treat A as B；confirmation of receipt 与 approval 区分程序阶段。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 我们对造成的混淆表示歉意，并已修改说明以防再次发生。
items.en: We apologise for the confusion and have revised the instructions to prevent it from recurring.
answers: We apologise for the confusion and have revised the instructions to prevent it from recurring.
items.notes: apologise for；prevent something from recurring 表示防止重现。
tags: 中式英语：正式语域与礼貌

items.zh: 该相关性值得进一步研究，但不足以证明税收变化导致了消费下降。
items.en: The correlation warrants further investigation, but it is insufficient to show that the tax change caused the fall in consumption.
answers: The correlation warrants further investigation, but it is insufficient to show that the tax change caused the fall in consumption.
items.notes: 区分相关与因果；insufficient to show 限定证据强度。

items.zh: 一个成功案例可以说明政策可行，却不能说明它在所有地区都有效。
items.en: A successful case can demonstrate that the policy is feasible, but not that it will work in every region.
answers: A successful case can demonstrate that the policy is feasible, but not that it will work in every region.
items.notes: 两个 that 从句对照可行性与普遍有效性。

items.zh: 受访者普遍表示满意，不过调查没有询问他们是否考虑过其他选择。
items.en: Respondents generally reported satisfaction, although the survey did not ask whether they had considered alternatives.
answers: Respondents generally reported satisfaction, although the survey did not ask whether they had considered alternatives.
items.notes: although 引出测量局限；reported satisfaction 不等于客观效果。

items.zh: 没有发现损害证据，并不等同于已经证明不存在损害。
items.en: A failure to find evidence of harm is not the same as evidence that no harm exists.
answers: A failure to find evidence of harm is not the same as evidence that no harm exists.
items.notes: 精确区分 absence of evidence 与 evidence of absence。

items.zh: 这项解释与现有数据相符，但其他解释同样可能成立。
items.en: This explanation is consistent with the available data, but alternative explanations remain plausible.
answers: This explanation is consistent with the available data, but alternative explanations remain plausible.
items.notes: be consistent with 只表示相容，不表示唯一证明。

items.zh: 平均收入上升掩盖了最低收入组购买力下降的事实。
items.en: The rise in average income conceals a decline in purchasing power among the lowest-income group.
answers: The rise in average income conceals a decline in purchasing power among the lowest-income group.
items.notes: 用分组证据限制平均数所呈现的总体结论。

items.zh: 该计划实施后犯罪率下降了，但同期还增加了街道照明。
items.en: Crime fell after the programme was introduced, but street lighting was also expanded during the same period.
answers: Crime fell after the programme was introduced, but street lighting was also expanded during the same period.
items.notes: 指出同期混杂因素，避免仅凭时间先后推断因果。

items.zh: 样本规模足以估计总体趋势，却不足以可靠比较样本量很小的子群体。
items.en: The sample is large enough to estimate the overall trend but too small to support reliable comparisons between small subgroups.
answers: The sample is large enough to estimate the overall trend but too small to support reliable comparisons between small subgroups.
items.notes: enough to 与 too small to 对照证据适用范围。

items.zh: 作者引用的是行业预测，而不是实际观察到的需求。
items.en: The author cites an industry forecast rather than observed demand.
answers: The author cites an industry forecast rather than observed demand.
items.notes: 明确证据类型，forecast 不应写成既成事实。

items.zh: 投诉减少可能反映服务改善，也可能反映投诉渠道更难使用。
items.en: Fewer complaints may indicate better service, but they may also reflect greater difficulty in using the complaints process.
answers: Fewer complaints may indicate better service, but they may also reflect greater difficulty in using the complaints process.
items.notes: 给出竞争性解释，防止单指标单向解读。

items.zh: 由于参与是自愿的，最不满意的人可能已经选择退出。
items.en: Because participation was voluntary, the least satisfied users may have chosen not to take part.
answers: Because participation was voluntary, the least satisfied users may have chosen not to take part.
items.notes: 指出自愿参与造成的选择偏差。

items.zh: 这一结论适用于接受调查的机构，未必适用于整个行业。
items.en: The conclusion applies to the organisations surveyed and should not automatically be extended to the sector as a whole.
answers: The conclusion applies to the organisations surveyed and should not automatically be extended to the sector as a whole.
items.notes: 限定外推范围；automatically 表明不能未经论证推广。

items.zh: 价格下降与销量增长同时发生，但报告没有排除季节因素。
items.en: The price fall coincided with higher sales, but the report does not rule out a seasonal effect.
answers: The price fall coincided with higher sales, but the report does not rule out a seasonal effect.
items.notes: coincide with 不暗示因果；rule out 表示排除解释。

items.zh: 结果支持提供试行资金，而不是立即在全国推广。
items.en: The findings support funding a further pilot rather than immediate nationwide implementation.
answers: The findings support funding a further pilot rather than immediate nationwide implementation.
items.notes: 证据支持的行动强度应与不确定性匹配。

items.zh: 官方记录低估了无家可归人数，因为它没有涵盖临时借住者。
items.en: The official count underestimates homelessness because it excludes people staying temporarily with others.
answers: The official count underestimates homelessness because it excludes people staying temporarily with others.
items.notes: 说明指标遗漏范围及偏差方向。

items.zh: 两组起点不同，因此仅比较最终得分可能产生误导。
items.en: The groups had different starting points, so comparing final scores alone may be misleading.
answers: The groups had different starting points, so comparing final scores alone may be misleading.
items.notes: 说明比较需要控制基线；动名词短语作主语。

items.zh: 该调查记录的是自我报告的行为，而不是经过核实的交易。
items.en: The survey records self-reported behaviour rather than verified transactions.
answers: The survey records self-reported behaviour rather than verified transactions.
items.notes: 明确自报数据与客观记录的证据差异。

items.zh: 误差范围重叠，意味着名次差异可能并不稳定。
items.en: The overlapping margins of error mean that the difference in ranking may not be stable.
answers: The overlapping margins of error mean that the difference in ranking may not be stable.
items.notes: 用误差范围限制对名次的过度解读。

items.zh: 报告显示接受培训者表现更好，但表现较强的人也更可能主动报名。
items.en: The report shows that trainees performed better, but stronger performers may also have been more likely to volunteer.
answers: The report shows that trainees performed better, but stronger performers may also have been more likely to volunteer.
items.notes: 指出反向选择可能，避免把组间差异全归于培训。

items.zh: 即使估计值准确，它也只回答成本问题，并未回答方案是否公平。
items.en: Even if the estimate is accurate, it addresses only the question of cost, not whether the scheme is fair.
answers: Even if the estimate is accurate, it addresses only the question of cost, not whether the scheme is fair.
items.notes: 区分事实问题与价值判断；whether 引出公平性问题。

items.zh: 短期改善可能是新鲜感造成的，长期效果仍有待观察。
items.en: The short-term improvement may reflect a novelty effect; the longer-term outcome remains to be seen.
answers: The short-term improvement may reflect a novelty effect; the longer-term outcome remains to be seen.
items.notes: 用 may reflect 保留解释空间；分号连接当前发现与未知后续。

items.zh: 删除异常值后效果变强，但必须说明删除标准是否事先确定。
items.en: The effect became stronger after outliers were removed, but it matters whether the exclusion rule was specified in advance.
answers: The effect became stronger after outliers were removed, but it matters whether the exclusion rule was specified in advance.
items.notes: 事后删值可能影响可信度；whether 从句作 matters 的真正内容。

items.zh: 研究没有发现显著差异，可能是因为实际没有差异，也可能是样本太小。
items.en: The study found no significant difference, either because none existed or because the sample was too small to detect it.
answers: The study found no significant difference, either because none existed or because the sample was too small to detect it.
items.notes: 给出零结果的两种解释，避免把未显著等同于完全相同。

items.zh: 数据支持风险有所降低，却无法确定降低了多少。
items.en: The data support a reduction in risk but do not establish the size of that reduction.
answers: The data support a reduction in risk but do not establish the size of that reduction.
items.notes: 区分方向证据与效应量证据。

items.zh: 该主张依赖一项尚未经过同行评审的分析。
items.en: The claim rests on an analysis that has not yet undergone peer review.
answers: The claim rests on an analysis that has not yet undergone peer review.
items.notes: rest on 表示依据；说明证据审查状态而非直接否定。

items.zh: 反对者担心该政策成本过高，但这一批评忽略了不采取行动的成本。
items.en: Critics argue that the policy is too expensive, but this objection overlooks the cost of inaction.
answers: Critics argue that the policy is too expensive, but this objection overlooks the cost of inaction.
items.notes: 先准确呈现反方观点，再指出其遗漏的比较项。

items.zh: 免费服务可能增加需求，不过需求增加并不意味着所有新增使用都没有必要。
items.en: A free service may increase demand, but higher use does not imply that every additional visit is unnecessary.
answers: A free service may increase demand, but higher use does not imply that every additional visit is unnecessary.
items.notes: 反驳时限制结论范围，避免把部分浪费扩大为全部无效。

items.zh: 有人认为远程办公会削弱合作，但这一影响取决于团队如何共享信息。
items.en: Some argue that remote working weakens collaboration, yet its effect depends on how teams share information.
answers: Some argue that remote working weakens collaboration, yet its effect depends on how teams share information.
items.notes: 承认担忧并引入条件变量；how 从句作 depends on 的宾语。

items.zh: 提高标准可能减少合格申请者，但降低标准也会把成本转嫁给使用者。
items.en: Higher standards may reduce the pool of eligible applicants, whereas lower standards may shift costs onto users.
answers: Higher standards may reduce the pool of eligible applicants, whereas lower standards may shift costs onto users.
items.notes: whereas 对照两种方案各自代价。

items.zh: 短期补贴无法解决结构性问题，但可以防止家庭在改革期间陷入困境。
items.en: A temporary subsidy cannot solve a structural problem, but it can prevent hardship during the transition.
answers: A temporary subsidy cannot solve a structural problem, but it can prevent hardship during the transition.
items.notes: 区分临时措施的有限功能与结构性解决。

items.zh: 个人选择确实重要，不过选择是在住房和收入限制之内作出的。
items.en: Individual choice matters, but it is exercised within constraints imposed by housing and income.
answers: Individual choice matters, but it is exercised within constraints imposed by housing and income.
items.notes: 承认个人能动性，同时说明结构约束。

items.zh: 建设更多道路或许能暂时缓解拥堵，却也可能诱发更多驾车出行。
items.en: Building more roads may relieve congestion temporarily, but it may also induce additional car travel.
answers: Building more roads may relieve congestion temporarily, but it may also induce additional car travel.
items.notes: 同一措施的短期收益与行为反馈并列。

items.zh: 统一规则更容易执行，但未必能适应差异很大的地方条件。
items.en: Uniform rules are easier to administer, although they may not suit widely differing local conditions.
answers: Uniform rules are easier to administer, although they may not suit widely differing local conditions.
items.notes: 对照行政简便与地方适配。

items.zh: 技术可以减少人工错误，但若设计有偏差，它也会大规模复制错误。
items.en: Technology can reduce human error, yet a biased design can reproduce mistakes on a much larger scale.
answers: Technology can reduce human error, yet a biased design can reproduce mistakes on a much larger scale.
items.notes: 不是简单支持或反对技术，而是比较错误类型与规模。

items.zh: 要求提供更多证明可以减少欺诈，同时也会阻碍最难取得文件的人。
items.en: Requiring more evidence may reduce fraud while also deterring those who find it hardest to obtain documents.
answers: Requiring more evidence may reduce fraud while also deterring those who find it hardest to obtain documents.
items.notes: while also 表示同一措施的双重后果。

items.zh: 游客税可能损害价格竞争力，但收入若用于维护景点，也可能提升体验。
items.en: A visitor tax may weaken price competitiveness, but it may improve the experience if the revenue funds site maintenance.
answers: A visitor tax may weaken price competitiveness, but it may improve the experience if the revenue funds site maintenance.
items.notes: 用 if 明确潜在收益成立的条件。

items.zh: 考试提供统一比较，却只能衡量课程目标的一部分。
items.en: Examinations provide a common basis for comparison, but they measure only part of what a course is intended to achieve.
answers: Examinations provide a common basis for comparison, but they measure only part of what a course is intended to achieve.
items.notes: 承认可比性，同时限定测量覆盖范围。

items.zh: 延迟退休能增加劳动力供给，但对从事高强度体力劳动者未必公平。
items.en: Later retirement can increase labour supply, but it may be inequitable for people in physically demanding jobs.
answers: Later retirement can increase labour supply, but it may be inequitable for people in physically demanding jobs.
items.notes: 把总体经济收益与群体公平问题并置。

items.zh: 公开排名可能推动改进，也可能鼓励机构把精力放在容易量化的指标上。
items.en: Public rankings may encourage improvement, but they may also lead institutions to focus on what is easiest to measure.
answers: Public rankings may encourage improvement, but they may also lead institutions to focus on what is easiest to measure.
items.notes: 用 may ... but may also 呈现激励的两面性。

items.zh: 保留旧建筑通常更环保，除非改造所需能源远高于重建。
items.en: Retaining an old building is often greener unless renovation requires substantially more energy than rebuilding.
answers: Retaining an old building is often greener unless renovation requires substantially more energy than rebuilding.
items.notes: often 保留一般性，unless 引出可能推翻结论的条件。

items.zh: 较小的班级可能有帮助，但教师如何使用额外时间同样关键。
items.en: Smaller classes may help, but how teachers use the additional time is equally important.
answers: Smaller classes may help, but how teachers use the additional time is equally important.
items.notes: how 从句作主语，引入机制而非停留在规模相关性。

items.zh: 禁止某种产品容易传达立场，却可能把交易推向监管更少的市场。
items.en: Banning a product sends a clear signal, but it may drive trade into less regulated markets.
answers: Banning a product sends a clear signal, but it may drive trade into less regulated markets.
items.notes: 对照象征效果与替代市场风险。

items.zh: 让数据开放有助于审查，但隐私保护会合理地限制开放程度。
items.en: Open data facilitate scrutiny, although privacy concerns legitimately limit how much can be released.
answers: Open data facilitate scrutiny, although privacy concerns legitimately limit how much can be released.
items.notes: although 引入正当限制；how much 从句说明开放程度。

items.zh: 惩罚违规者很重要，然而清除导致违规的障碍可能更有效。
items.en: Penalising non-compliance matters; however, removing the barriers that cause it may be more effective.
answers: Penalising non-compliance matters; however, removing the barriers that cause it may be more effective.
items.notes: 区分事后惩罚与预防性措施；that 限定 barriers。

items.zh: 文化活动未必盈利，却能创造商业指标忽略的公共价值。
items.en: Cultural activities may not be profitable, yet they can create public value that commercial measures overlook.
answers: Cultural activities may not be profitable, yet they can create public value that commercial measures overlook.
items.notes: 盈利能力不是唯一评价尺度；that 从句说明被忽略的价值。

items.zh: 给予地方更多自主权能促进创新，但也会造成服务水平不一致。
items.en: Greater local autonomy can foster innovation, but it can also produce uneven standards of service.
answers: Greater local autonomy can foster innovation, but it can also produce uneven standards of service.
items.notes: 同一制度安排的创新收益与一致性成本。

items.zh: 严格的截止日期有助于计划，却可能不成比例地影响照护者。
items.en: Firm deadlines aid planning, but they may have a disproportionate effect on people with caring responsibilities.
answers: Firm deadlines aid planning, but they may have a disproportionate effect on people with caring responsibilities.
items.notes: 指出普遍规则的差异化影响。

items.zh: 资助热门课程能惠及更多人，但小众课程可能具有无法由人数体现的价值。
items.en: Funding popular courses benefits more people, but specialist courses may have value that enrolment figures do not capture.
answers: Funding popular courses benefits more people, but specialist courses may have value that enrolment figures do not capture.
items.notes: 对照覆盖人数与难以量化的专业价值。

items.zh: 减少包装体积能降低运输排放，但脆弱商品可能因此更易损坏。
items.en: Reducing packaging volume can cut transport emissions, although fragile goods may then be more vulnerable to damage.
answers: Reducing packaging volume can cut transport emissions, although fragile goods may then be more vulnerable to damage.
items.notes: 将环境收益与产品损耗风险纳入同一权衡。

items.zh: 一个简单规则容易理解，可边缘情况往往需要酌情处理。
items.en: A simple rule is easy to understand, whereas borderline cases often require discretion.
answers: A simple rule is easy to understand, whereas borderline cases often require discretion.
items.notes: whereas 对照规则清晰度与个案判断需要。

items.zh: 例如，一条夜间公交线路即使乘客不多，也可能让轮班工人保住工作。
items.en: For example, a night bus route may enable shift workers to keep their jobs even if passenger numbers are modest.
answers: For example, a night bus route may enable shift workers to keep their jobs even if passenger numbers are modest.
items.notes: 例子应说明机制：交通可达性如何影响就业，而非只重复观点。

items.zh: 以公共长椅为例，它们的价值不仅在于提供座位，还在于让行动不便者能分段完成路程。
items.en: Consider public benches: their value lies not only in providing seats but also in enabling people with limited mobility to break up a journey.
answers: Consider public benches: their value lies not only in providing seats but also in enabling people with limited mobility to break up a journey.
items.notes: consider 引出具体例证；not only ... but also 解释两层价值。

items.zh: 一所学校的经验不能代表全国，却能揭示新制度在实践中可能遇到的问题。
items.en: The experience of one school cannot represent the whole country, but it can reveal problems that the new system may encounter in practice.
answers: The experience of one school cannot represent the whole country, but it can reveal problems that the new system may encounter in practice.
items.notes: 明确案例不能证明普遍性，但可用于识别机制和问题。

items.zh: 如果更短的表格提高了完成率，这可能是因为它减少了理解负担，而不只是节省了时间。
items.en: If a shorter form improves completion, this may be because it reduces cognitive effort rather than merely saving time.
answers: If a shorter form improves completion, this may be because it reduces cognitive effort rather than merely saving time.
items.notes: 从观察结果进一步解释可能机制，并用 may 保留不确定性。

items.zh: 偏远诊所说明了这一点：全国统一采购价并不能消除更高的配送成本。
items.en: Remote clinics illustrate the point: a uniform national purchase price does not remove their higher delivery costs.
answers: Remote clinics illustrate the point: a uniform national purchase price does not remove their higher delivery costs.
items.notes: 冒号后的案例直接说明统一价格与实际成本的差距。

items.zh: 一个家庭减少用电可能是节约意识增强，也可能只是因为付不起电费。
items.en: A household may use less electricity because it has become more efficient or simply because it can no longer afford the same level of consumption.
answers: A household may use less electricity because it has become more efficient or simply because it can no longer afford the same level of consumption.
items.notes: 同一结果可能对应积极或消极机制，例证帮助避免价值误判。

items.zh: 图书馆不仅借书；它提供网络、安静空间以及无法在家打印文件者所需的设备。
items.en: A library does more than lend books: it provides internet access, quiet space, and equipment for people who cannot print documents at home.
answers: A library does more than lend books: it provides internet access, quiet space, and equipment for people who cannot print documents at home.
items.notes: 具体列举支持公共服务具有多重功能的论点。

items.zh: 例如，安装电梯改善了通行条件，却不能解决标识难懂的问题。
items.en: Installing a lift, for instance, improves physical access but does not address confusing signage.
answers: Installing a lift, for instance, improves physical access but does not address confusing signage.
items.notes: 例子区分无障碍的不同维度，避免用单一措施代表全部改善。

items.zh: 某个应用下载量很高，可能源于强制安装，而不是用户真正喜欢它。
items.en: A high number of downloads may result from compulsory installation rather than genuine user preference.
answers: A high number of downloads may result from compulsory installation rather than genuine user preference.
items.notes: 例证说明指标与所声称概念可能不一致。

items.zh: 当一名照护者错过预约时，原因可能不是粗心，而是替代照护临时取消。
items.en: When a carer misses an appointment, the reason may be the loss of replacement care rather than carelessness.
answers: When a carer misses an appointment, the reason may be the loss of replacement care rather than carelessness.
items.notes: 用具体情境挑战对个人行为的简单归因。

items.zh: 小企业也许买得起软件许可，却负担不起迁移旧数据所需的停工时间。
items.en: A small business may be able to afford a software licence but not the downtime required to migrate its existing data.
answers: A small business may be able to afford a software licence but not the downtime required to migrate its existing data.
items.notes: 例子把购买成本与转换成本区分开。

items.zh: 以雨水花园为例，它既能减少积水，又能为昆虫提供栖息地。
items.en: Rain gardens, for example, can both reduce surface flooding and provide habitat for insects.
answers: Rain gardens, for example, can both reduce surface flooding and provide habitat for insects.
items.notes: both ... and 展示一项措施的双重收益。

items.zh: 如果居民只在试用期使用健身中心，注册人数就会夸大持续参与程度。
items.en: If residents use the fitness centre only during a free trial, registration figures will overstate sustained participation.
answers: If residents use the fitness centre only during a free trial, registration figures will overstate sustained participation.
items.notes: 具体说明代理指标为何可能高估长期行为。

items.zh: 一次停电足以暴露备用系统的缺陷，却不足以估计故障发生的频率。
items.en: A single power cut may expose a weakness in the backup system, but it cannot establish how frequently failures occur.
answers: A single power cut may expose a weakness in the backup system, but it cannot establish how frequently failures occur.
items.notes: 同一事件可证明系统存在弱点，却不能提供频率证据。

items.zh: 例如，免费的在线课程对没有稳定网络的人仍然不可及。
items.en: A free online course, for example, remains inaccessible to someone without a stable internet connection.
answers: A free online course, for example, remains inaccessible to someone without a stable internet connection.
items.notes: 例子区分价格可及性与技术可及性。

items.zh: 如果两家医院使用不同的出院定义，直接比较住院天数就会误导。
items.en: If two hospitals define discharge differently, a direct comparison of length of stay will be misleading.
answers: If two hospitals define discharge differently, a direct comparison of length of stay will be misleading.
items.notes: 具体说明定义不一致如何破坏指标可比性。

items.zh: 社区花园面积不大，却可以成为新居民结识邻居的固定场所。
items.en: A community garden may occupy little space, yet it can provide a regular setting in which new residents meet their neighbours.
answers: A community garden may occupy little space, yet it can provide a regular setting in which new residents meet their neighbours.
items.notes: 用机制解释小型空间如何产生社会价值。

items.zh: 例如，把说明翻译成多种语言，只有在译文也及时更新时才有用。
items.en: Translating instructions into several languages is useful only if the translated versions are updated promptly as well.
answers: Translating instructions into several languages is useful only if the translated versions are updated promptly as well.
items.notes: 例证加入维护条件，避免把一次翻译当作永久解决。

items.zh: 一条自行车道在地图上连贯，若关键路口不安全，实际使用仍会受限。
items.en: A cycle route may appear continuous on a map, but unsafe junctions can still limit its practical use.
answers: A cycle route may appear continuous on a map, but unsafe junctions can still limit its practical use.
items.notes: 用具体瓶颈说明整体体验由最薄弱环节限制。

items.zh: 如果培训只让成绩最好的员工参加，培训后的高分就不能完全归因于课程。
items.en: If training is offered only to the strongest employees, their later performance cannot be attributed entirely to the course.
answers: If training is offered only to the strongest employees, their later performance cannot be attributed entirely to the course.
items.notes: 具体呈现选择偏差如何影响因果解释。

items.zh: 老旧住宅说明了统一标准的局限：住户可能无法进行租赁合同禁止的改造。
items.en: Older rented homes show the limits of a uniform standard: tenants may be unable to make alterations prohibited by their leases.
answers: Older rented homes show the limits of a uniform standard: tenants may be unable to make alterations prohibited by their leases.
items.notes: 案例说明形式权利与实际控制权之间的差异。

items.zh: 例如，延长诊疗时间若没有增加交通班次，偏远患者仍然无法到达。
items.en: Longer clinic hours will not help remote patients, for example, if no transport is available at those times.
answers: Longer clinic hours will not help remote patients, for example, if no transport is available at those times.
items.notes: 把配套条件纳入例证，说明单项改革的依赖关系。

items.zh: 一家商店减少塑料袋，却增加预包装商品，整体塑料用量仍可能上升。
items.en: A shop may distribute fewer plastic bags yet use more plastic overall if it increases the number of pre-packaged goods.
answers: A shop may distribute fewer plastic bags yet use more plastic overall if it increases the number of pre-packaged goods.
items.notes: 例子提醒读者评价总影响而非单一可见指标。

items.zh: 数字支付速度快，但手机没电的旅客可能因此完全无法付款。
items.en: Digital payment is fast, but a traveller whose phone has run out of power may be unable to pay at all.
answers: Digital payment is fast, but a traveller whose phone has run out of power may be unable to pay at all.
items.notes: 具体边缘情况检验只保留一种支付方式的风险。

items.zh: 把树种得更密并不总能增加存活数量，因为幼树会竞争水分和光照。
items.en: Planting trees more densely does not always increase the number that survive, because young trees compete for water and light.
answers: Planting trees more densely does not always increase the number that survive, because young trees compete for water and light.
items.notes: 例子揭示投入数量与最终结果之间的非线性关系。

items.zh: 该市先增加了停车费。此举并未减少购物人数，却缩短了平均停车时间。
items.en: The city first increased parking charges. This change did not reduce the number of shoppers, but it shortened the average stay.
answers: The city first increased parking charges. This change did not reduce the number of shoppers, but it shortened the average stay.
items.notes: this change 明确回指政策，避免用 this 单独造成指代模糊。

items.zh: 早期评估只关注成本。相比之下，后续评估还考察了公平性。
items.en: The initial evaluation considered cost alone. By contrast, the later review also examined fairness.
answers: The initial evaluation considered cost alone. By contrast, the later review also examined fairness.
items.notes: by contrast 建立两个评估维度之间的明确对照。

items.zh: 一些居民担心施工噪声，另一些则担心租金上涨。后者更可能反对长期改造。
items.en: Some residents were concerned about construction noise, whereas others feared higher rents. The latter group was more likely to oppose long-term redevelopment.
answers: Some residents were concerned about construction noise, whereas others feared higher rents. The latter group was more likely to oppose long-term redevelopment.
items.notes: the latter group 清楚回指第二类居民。

items.zh: 项目在预算内完成，也按时开放。然而，这两个事实都不能说明服务质量。
items.en: The project stayed within budget and opened on time. Neither fact, however, tells us anything about service quality.
answers: The project stayed within budget and opened on time. Neither fact, however, tells us anything about service quality.
items.notes: neither fact 概括前句两项事实；however 插入位置自然。

items.zh: 委员会拒绝了原方案，并要求进行新的评估。作出这一决定，是因为成本数据已经过时。
items.en: The committee rejected the original plan and requested a new assessment. It did so because the cost data were outdated.
answers: The committee rejected the original plan and requested a new assessment. It did so because the cost data were outdated.
items.notes: did so 回指拒绝并要求重评这一行动，避免重复整句。

items.zh: 该报告分别讨论了价格、质量和可及性。最后一个因素受到的关注最少。
items.en: The report discusses price, quality, and accessibility in turn. The final factor receives the least attention.
answers: The report discusses price, quality, and accessibility in turn. The final factor receives the least attention.
items.notes: the final factor 精确回指列举中的第三项。

items.zh: 新平台减少了纸质表格的使用。此外，它让申请人可以保存未完成的申请。
items.en: The new platform reduces the use of paper forms. In addition, it allows applicants to save an incomplete application.
answers: The new platform reduces the use of paper forms. In addition, it allows applicants to save an incomplete application.
items.notes: in addition 添加不同收益，而非误用 moreover 连接因果。

items.zh: 居民并不反对建房本身。相反，他们要求修改入口位置。
items.en: Residents do not oppose the housing itself. Rather, they are asking for the entrance to be moved.
answers: Residents do not oppose the housing itself. Rather, they are asking for the entrance to be moved.
items.notes: rather 修正对前句立场的可能误解。

items.zh: 调查发现等待时间缩短了。因此，报告建议保留预约分流制度。
items.en: The survey found that waiting times had fallen. On that basis, the report recommends retaining the appointment triage system.
answers: The survey found that waiting times had fallen. On that basis, the report recommends retaining the appointment triage system.
items.notes: on that basis 明确建议所依据的证据，强度比 therefore 更可审查。

items.zh: 补贴提高了设备购买量。即便如此，偏远地区的使用率仍然较低。
items.en: The subsidy increased equipment purchases. Even so, usage remained low in remote areas.
answers: The subsidy increased equipment purchases. Even so, usage remained low in remote areas.
items.notes: even so 表示前句有利条件未带来预期结果。

items.zh: 第一项研究测量态度，第二项研究观察行为。两者回答的问题并不相同。
items.en: The first study measures attitudes, whereas the second observes behaviour. The two therefore answer different questions.
answers: The first study measures attitudes, whereas the second observes behaviour. The two therefore answer different questions.
items.notes: the two 回指两项研究；therefore 给出方法差异的推论。

items.zh: 方案甲建设成本较低。另一方面，方案乙的长期维护费用更少。
items.en: Option A has a lower construction cost. On the other hand, Option B is cheaper to maintain over the long term.
answers: Option A has a lower construction cost. On the other hand, Option B is cheaper to maintain over the long term.
items.notes: on the other hand 用于同一选择中的另一比较维度。

items.zh: 报告使用了全国平均数。这样做掩盖了沿海与内陆地区的差异。
items.en: The report uses a national average. Doing so conceals the difference between coastal and inland areas.
answers: The report uses a national average. Doing so conceals the difference between coastal and inland areas.
items.notes: doing so 回指使用平均数的做法，避免 it 指代不清。

items.zh: 药品价格下降了，获得治疗的人数也增加了。这两项变化未必具有因果关系。
items.en: Medicine prices fell, and the number of people receiving treatment rose. These two changes are not necessarily causally related.
answers: Medicine prices fell, and the number of people receiving treatment rose. These two changes are not necessarily causally related.
items.notes: these two changes 精确概括前句并限制因果推断。

items.zh: 新规则保护全职员工，却没有涵盖零工。正是这一遗漏引发了批评。
items.en: The new rule protects full-time employees but does not cover gig workers. It is this omission that has attracted criticism.
answers: The new rule protects full-time employees but does not cover gig workers. It is this omission that has attracted criticism.
items.notes: this omission 回指具体遗漏；强调结构突出批评焦点。

items.zh: 先导项目招募困难。为此，团队增加了周末场次。
items.en: The pilot struggled to recruit participants. In response, the team added weekend sessions.
answers: The pilot struggled to recruit participants. In response, the team added weekend sessions.
items.notes: in response 清楚表示后一句是针对前述问题的措施。

items.zh: 需求最初急剧上升，随后趋于稳定。这一变化模式在三个地区都出现了。
items.en: Demand rose sharply at first and then levelled off. This pattern occurred in all three regions.
answers: Demand rose sharply at first and then levelled off. This pattern occurred in all three regions.
items.notes: this pattern 回指完整变化轨迹，而不是单个数值。

items.zh: 审查发现了记录错误，但没有发现资金被挪用。后一个结论应与前一个问题分开处理。
items.en: The review found errors in the records but no misuse of funds. The latter finding should be considered separately from the former problem.
answers: The review found errors in the records but no misuse of funds. The latter finding should be considered separately from the former problem.
items.notes: latter 与 former 回指两个性质不同的发现。

items.zh: 建议包括缩短表格和增加热线服务。其中，前者成本较低。
items.en: The recommendations include shortening the form and expanding the helpline. Of these, the former would cost less.
answers: The recommendations include shortening the form and expanding the helpline. Of these, the former would cost less.
items.notes: of these 与 the former 明确在两项建议中比较。

items.zh: 该政策在城市地区效果较好。这并不令人意外，因为那些地区的服务密度更高。
items.en: The policy worked better in urban areas. This is unsurprising, given that services are denser there.
answers: The policy worked better in urban areas. This is unsurprising, given that services are denser there.
items.notes: this 回指前句完整事实；there 回指 urban areas。

items.zh: 报告先描述问题，然后评估三个方案。这样的结构让建议与证据容易对应。
items.en: The report first defines the problem and then evaluates three options. This structure makes it easy to relate each recommendation to the evidence.
answers: The report first defines the problem and then evaluates three options. This structure makes it easy to relate each recommendation to the evidence.
items.notes: this structure 回指段落组织方式，并解释其作用。

items.zh: 有些数据来自行政记录，其余来自访谈。后者提供了前者无法解释的背景。
items.en: Some data come from administrative records, while the rest come from interviews. The latter provide context that the former cannot supply.
answers: Some data come from administrative records, while the rest come from interviews. The latter provide context that the former cannot supply.
items.notes: latter 和 former 指代清楚；谓语与复数 interviews/records 呼应。

items.zh: 委员会推迟了决定。因此，原许可证自动延长了三个月。
items.en: The committee postponed its decision. Consequently, the existing licence was extended automatically for three months.
answers: The committee postponed its decision. Consequently, the existing licence was extended automatically for three months.
items.notes: consequently 表示制度性结果，不只是时间上的随后。

items.zh: 在线服务最初是一个补充渠道。如今，它已成为多数用户的主要入口。
items.en: The online service began as an additional channel. It has since become the main point of access for most users.
answers: The online service began as an additional channel. It has since become the main point of access for most users.
items.notes: since 作为副词连接过去起点与当前状态。

items.zh: 本节不会评价政策目标，而只考察实施过程。这一区分有助于限定结论。
items.en: This section does not assess the policy's aims; it examines implementation only. That distinction helps to define the scope of the conclusion.
answers: This section does not assess the policy's aims; it examines implementation only. That distinction helps to define the scope of the conclusion.
items.notes: that distinction 回指目标与实施的区分，说明段落范围。

items.zh: 2018年至2022年间，线上申请比例从四分之一稳步升至近三分之二。
items.en: Between 2018 and 2022, the proportion of applications made online rose steadily from one quarter to nearly two thirds.
answers: Between 2018 and 2022, the proportion of applications made online rose steadily from one quarter to nearly two thirds.
items.notes: proportion of；from ... to 报告起止值，steadily 描述过程。

items.zh: 总支出保持大致稳定，但其构成明显转向了维护。
items.en: Total expenditure remained broadly stable, but its composition shifted markedly towards maintenance.
answers: Total expenditure remained broadly stable, but its composition shifted markedly towards maintenance.
items.notes: 区分总量不变与内部构成变化。

items.zh: 农村地区的增幅更大，不过起点远低于城市地区。
items.en: The increase was larger in rural areas, although their starting level was far below that of urban areas.
answers: The increase was larger in rural areas, although their starting level was far below that of urban areas.
items.notes: that of 代替 starting level；避免只比较增幅不提基数。

items.zh: 失业率在第二季度达到峰值，随后连续三个季度下降。
items.en: The unemployment rate peaked in the second quarter and then fell for three consecutive quarters.
answers: The unemployment rate peaked in the second quarter and then fell for three consecutive quarters.
items.notes: peak 作动词不需 reach to；for 表示持续季度数。

items.zh: 两条曲线在六月交叉，此后甲组一直高于乙组。
items.en: The two lines crossed in June, after which Group A remained above Group B.
answers: The two lines crossed in June, after which Group A remained above Group B.
items.notes: after which 连接交叉时间与后续持续关系。

items.zh: 增长主要集中在最高年龄组，其他组几乎没有变化。
items.en: Growth was concentrated in the oldest age group, with little change in the others.
answers: Growth was concentrated in the oldest age group, with little change in the others.
items.notes: with 结构简洁补充其他组情况；the others 指其余各组。

items.zh: 该数值先降至不足一千，年底又恢复到接近初始水平。
items.en: The figure first fell below one thousand and recovered to almost its initial level by the end of the year.
answers: The figure first fell below one thousand and recovered to almost its initial level by the end of the year.
items.notes: below 表示越过阈值；by the end 表示截止时点。

items.zh: 虽然女性人数更多，但男女两组的完成率几乎相同。
items.en: Although more women participated, completion rates were almost identical for the two sexes.
answers: Although more women participated, completion rates were almost identical for the two sexes.
items.notes: 区分人数与比例，避免由样本量推断完成率。

items.zh: 图中最显著的变化是现金支付迅速被刷卡支付取代。
items.en: The most striking change in the chart is the rapid replacement of cash payments by card payments.
answers: The most striking change in the chart is the rapid replacement of cash payments by card payments.
items.notes: replacement of A by B 准确表示替代方向。

items.zh: 2019年的短暂下降打断了长期上升趋势，但没有逆转它。
items.en: A temporary decline in 2019 interrupted the long-term upward trend without reversing it.
answers: A temporary decline in 2019 interrupted the long-term upward trend without reversing it.
items.notes: interrupt 与 reverse 区分短期波动和趋势逆转。

items.zh: 甲地区的平均值最高，但其年度波动也最大。
items.en: Region A had the highest average as well as the greatest year-to-year variation.
answers: Region A had the highest average as well as the greatest year-to-year variation.
items.notes: as well as 连接水平与波动两个不同特征。

items.zh: 不到一半的受访者选择第一项，而选择第三项的略多于五分之一。
items.en: Fewer than half of respondents chose the first option, compared with just over one fifth who selected the third.
answers: Fewer than half of respondents chose the first option, compared with just over one fifth who selected the third.
items.notes: fewer than 用于人数比例；compared with 引出另一组。

items.zh: 三个地区都出现增长，但只有北部超过了全国目标。
items.en: All three regions recorded growth, but only the north exceeded the national target.
answers: All three regions recorded growth, but only the north exceeded the national target.
items.notes: record growth 与 exceed a target 是图表写作常用准确搭配。

items.zh: 产量翻了一番，而每单位能耗下降了约百分之十五。
items.en: Output doubled, while energy use per unit fell by approximately fifteen per cent.
answers: Output doubled, while energy use per unit fell by approximately fifteen per cent.
items.notes: double 不用 doubled by 100% 以外的重复表达；fall by 表示变化幅度。

items.zh: 最大类别所占比例与其余三类合计大致相当。
items.en: The largest category accounted for roughly the same share as the other three combined.
answers: The largest category accounted for roughly the same share as the other three combined.
items.notes: account for a share；combined 表示合计比较。

items.zh: 数据在四月出现异常高点，注释将其归因于一次性活动。
items.en: The data show an unusually high value in April, which the note attributes to a one-off event.
answers: The data show an unusually high value in April, which the note attributes to a one-off event.
items.notes: which 指异常高值；attribute A to B 表示解释来源。

items.zh: 中位数上升而平均数下降，表明分布顶端发生了变化。
items.en: The median rose while the mean fell, suggesting a change at the upper end of the distribution.
answers: The median rose while the mean fell, suggesting a change at the upper end of the distribution.
items.notes: suggesting 表示合理推论而非确证；区分 median 与 mean。

items.zh: 两组之间的差距在前期扩大，后期则逐渐缩小。
items.en: The gap between the groups widened during the first half of the period and narrowed gradually thereafter.
answers: The gap between the groups widened during the first half of the period and narrowed gradually thereafter.
items.notes: widen/narrow a gap；thereafter 指此后时期。

items.zh: 参与率在五个年龄组中呈倒U形，中间组最高。
items.en: Participation followed an inverted U-shaped pattern across the five age groups, peaking in the middle group.
answers: Participation followed an inverted U-shaped pattern across the five age groups, peaking in the middle group.
items.notes: 用 pattern 概括非线性分布；peaking 补充最高点。

items.zh: 实际数字始终低于预测值，第三季度的差距最大。
items.en: The actual figure remained below the forecast throughout, with the widest gap occurring in the third quarter.
answers: The actual figure remained below the forecast throughout, with the widest gap occurring in the third quarter.
items.notes: throughout 作副词表示全期；with 结构指出最大差距。

items.zh: 在总体下降的背景下，只有维修类支出有所上升。
items.en: Against an overall decline, maintenance was the only category in which spending increased.
answers: Against an overall decline, maintenance was the only category in which spending increased.
items.notes: against 表示与总体趋势对照；in which 修饰 category。

items.zh: 第二年新增用户较少，但留存率明显高于第一年。
items.en: Fewer new users joined in the second year, but the retention rate was substantially higher than in the first.
answers: Fewer new users joined in the second year, but the retention rate was substantially higher than in the first.
items.notes: 比较 retention rate 时用 than in the first，避免比较对象错位。

items.zh: 大约每八名参与者中有一人没有完成最后一次评估。
items.en: Approximately one in eight participants did not complete the final assessment.
answers: Approximately one in eight participants did not complete the final assessment.
items.notes: one in eight 是自然比例表达，谓语可按 one 用单数概念。

items.zh: 该图展示的是相对变化，因此不能据此判断哪个地区的绝对人数最多。
items.en: The chart shows relative change, so it cannot tell us which region had the largest absolute number.
answers: The chart shows relative change, so it cannot tell us which region had the largest absolute number.
items.notes: 区分相对变化与绝对规模；which 从句用陈述语序。

items.zh: 置信区间在多数年份重叠，只有最后一年明显分开。
items.en: The confidence intervals overlap in most years and separate clearly only in the final year.
answers: The confidence intervals overlap in most years and separate clearly only in the final year.
items.notes: overlap 与 separate 描述区间关系；only 精确限定年份。

items.zh: 原句说“他们”同意了，但没有说明是居民还是开发商。
items.en: The original sentence states that they agreed, but it does not make clear whether the pronoun refers to the residents or the developer.
answers: The original sentence states that they agreed, but it does not make clear whether the pronoun refers to the residents or the developer.
items.notes: whether 明确列出代词的两种可能指代。

items.zh: 把“只”放在动词前，可能让人误以为限制的是行动而不是金额。
items.en: Placing only before the verb may suggest that the action, rather than the amount, is being limited.
answers: Placing only before the verb may suggest that the action, rather than the amount, is being limited.
items.notes: only 的位置改变焦点；rather than 明确被排除的解释。

items.zh: “快速完成调查的员工”既可能指员工动作快，也可能指调查耗时短。
items.en: Saying that employees completed a survey quickly may refer either to their speed or to the short duration of the survey.
answers: Saying that employees completed a survey quickly may refer either to their speed or to the short duration of the survey.
items.notes: 指出 quickly 的附着歧义，并列出两种读法。

items.zh: 为避免歧义，应把截止日期直接放在它所限定的任务之后。
items.en: To avoid ambiguity, place the deadline immediately after the task to which it applies.
answers: To avoid ambiguity, place the deadline immediately after the task to which it applies.
items.notes: to which it applies 精确连接日期和对应任务。

items.zh: “大部分旧建筑”与“大部分建筑都很旧”表达的范围不同。
items.en: Using most before old buildings makes a different claim from saying that most buildings are old.
answers: Using most before old buildings makes a different claim from saying that most buildings are old.
items.notes: 前者在旧建筑集合中取多数，后者声称多数建筑具有旧这一属性。

items.zh: 删去“非常”不会削弱论点，反而会让“显著”这一判断更精确。
items.en: Removing the word very would not weaken the argument; instead, it would make the claim of significance more precise.
answers: Removing the word very would not weaken the argument; instead, it would make the claim of significance more precise.
items.notes: 避免堆叠程度副词；分号连接修改与效果。

items.zh: “每名经理与员工都必须签字”不清楚“每名”是否同时限定两类人。
items.en: Saying that every manager and employee must sign leaves it unclear whether every applies to both groups.
answers: Saying that every manager and employee must sign leaves it unclear whether every applies to both groups.
items.notes: 用 whether 解释限定词 every 的管辖范围歧义。

items.zh: 将原因移到句首，可以让读者在看到结论前先理解条件。
items.en: Moving the reason to the beginning allows readers to understand the condition before they encounter the conclusion.
answers: Moving the reason to the beginning allows readers to understand the condition before they encounter the conclusion.
items.notes: moving 作主语；before 从句说明信息顺序的作用。

items.zh: 不要用“这证明了”连接只能支持一种可能解释的数据。
items.en: Do not claim that the data prove a point when they support only one possible explanation among several.
answers: Do not claim that the data prove a point when they support only one possible explanation among several.
items.notes: proves 强度过高；support an explanation 更符合有限证据。

items.zh: 把两个否定词放在同一分句中，会让责任范围难以判断。
items.en: Using two negatives in the same clause can make the scope of responsibility difficult to determine.
answers: Using two negatives in the same clause can make the scope of responsibility difficult to determine.
items.notes: scope of responsibility 指责任适用范围；避免不必要的双重否定。

items.zh: “几乎所有人都没有回复”应改写，以说明是少数回复还是几乎无人回复。
items.en: The sentence about almost everyone not responding should be rewritten to show whether few people responded or almost no one did.
answers: The sentence about almost everyone not responding should be rewritten to show whether few people responded or almost no one did.
items.notes: almost 与否定词的作用域会产生两种不同含义。

items.zh: 用具体动词替换“产生影响”，能让读者知道影响是增加、减少还是延迟。
items.en: Using a specific verb instead of a vague reference to impact tells the reader whether something increased, reduced, or delayed the outcome.
answers: Using a specific verb instead of a vague reference to impact tells the reader whether something increased, reduced, or delayed the outcome.
items.notes: 具体动词揭示方向，比空泛名词化更清楚。

items.zh: 如果上一句提到两个计划，“这个方案”就必须重新点明名称。
items.en: If the previous sentence mentions two plans, this scheme must be replaced with the name of the intended plan.
answers: If the previous sentence mentions two plans, this scheme must be replaced with the name of the intended plan.
items.notes: 当候选先行词不唯一时，重复名词比模糊指代更清楚。

items.zh: 如果维修本身费用很高，就不应写成“昂贵设备的维修”。
items.en: If the repairs themselves are costly, describe them as costly repairs to the equipment rather than repairs to expensive equipment.
answers: If the repairs themselves are costly, describe them as costly repairs to the equipment rather than repairs to expensive equipment.
items.notes: 调整修饰语位置，区分维修费用与设备价格。

items.zh: 把长主语后的插入信息移到句末，可以让主语和谓语靠得更近。
items.en: Moving parenthetical detail from a long subject to the end can bring the subject closer to its verb.
answers: Moving parenthetical detail from a long subject to the end can bring the subject closer to its verb.
items.notes: 减少主语与谓语之间的距离，提高可读性。

items.zh: “可能不需要”与“不可能需要”含义不同，不能混用。
items.en: Saying that something may not be necessary differs from saying that it cannot be necessary; the two are not interchangeable.
answers: Saying that something may not be necessary differs from saying that it cannot be necessary; the two are not interchangeable.
items.notes: may not 表示或许无需，cannot 表示逻辑上不可能需要。

items.zh: 若“分别”没有紧跟对应的两组数据，读者可能无法正确配对。
items.en: If the word respectively is separated from the paired data, readers may be unable to match the figures correctly.
answers: If the word respectively is separated from the paired data, readers may be unable to match the figures correctly.
items.notes: respectively 应靠近清晰的平行序列。

items.zh: 将“由于”从第二个原因前删去，可避免读者误以为两个原因属于不同层级。
items.en: Removing the repeated because before the second reason makes clear that both reasons operate at the same level.
answers: Removing the repeated because before the second reason makes clear that both reasons operate at the same level.
items.notes: 并列原因共享一个 because 可突出平行关系。

items.zh: “无法完全排除”比“可以忽略”保留了更准确的不确定性。
items.en: Saying that a factor cannot be ruled out entirely preserves uncertainty more accurately than saying that it can be ignored.
answers: Saying that a factor cannot be ruled out entirely preserves uncertainty more accurately than saying that it can be ignored.
items.notes: 两种表达的证据立场不同，不能为了简洁而互换。

items.zh: 一句话同时包含三个转折时，应拆开以突出最重要的对比。
items.en: When a sentence contains three separate contrasts, divide it so that the most important one remains prominent.
answers: When a sentence contains three separate contrasts, divide it so that the most important one remains prominent.
items.notes: 拆句服务于逻辑层次，不只是缩短字数。

items.zh: 当“报告使用了旧数据”是主要判断时，不应把它压缩成生硬的分词短语。
items.en: When that point is the main claim, write that the report used outdated data rather than compressing the idea into a participial phrase.
answers: When that point is the main claim, write that the report used outdated data rather than compressing the idea into a participial phrase.
items.notes: 主要判断用完整谓语，避免用分词短语承担核心信息。

items.zh: 如果“去年”既可能修饰调查也可能修饰发表，就应补上具体日期或调整位置。
items.en: If last year could refer either to the survey or to its publication, add a specific date or move the time phrase.
answers: If last year could refer either to the survey or to its publication, add a specific date or move the time phrase.
items.notes: 时间状语应靠近所修饰事件，防止附着歧义。

items.zh: 将“为了安全”改为具体措施，才能说明安全目标是如何实现的。
items.en: State the actual precaution instead of writing only that it is for safety, so readers know how the objective will be achieved.
answers: State the actual precaution instead of writing only that it is for safety, so readers know how the objective will be achieved.
items.notes: 抽象目的不能代替措施和机制。

items.zh: “该结果很有意义”应说明是统计显著、实际重要，还是与决策相关。
items.en: A meaningful result should be identified as statistically significant, practically important, or relevant to a decision.
answers: A meaningful result should be identified as statistically significant, practically important, or relevant to a decision.
items.notes: meaningful 含义过宽，应选择可核查的评价维度。

items.zh: 精简不是删除所有限定词；像“通常”和“在本样本中”这样的词保护结论边界。
items.en: Concise writing does not remove every qualifier; terms such as usually and in this sample protect the boundaries of a claim.
answers: Concise writing does not remove every qualifier; terms such as usually and in this sample protect the boundaries of a claim.
items.notes: 保留必要限定能防止简洁演变为绝对化。

items.zh: 真正限制项目规模的不是需求不足，而是缺少合格的培训人员。
items.en: What limits the scale of the programme is not a lack of demand but a shortage of qualified trainers.
answers: What limits the scale of the programme is not a lack of demand but a shortage of qualified trainers.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；not A but B 准确突出真正限制因素。

items.zh: 只有在公布评估标准后，申请人才知道应提供哪些证据。
items.en: Only after the assessment criteria were published did applicants know what evidence to provide.
answers: Only after the assessment criteria were published did applicants know what evidence to provide.
items.notes: only + 状语置于句首引起主句部分倒装。

items.zh: 直到第一次洪水发生，委员会才重新考虑排水标准。
items.en: Not until the first flood occurred did the committee reconsider the drainage standard.
answers: Not until the first flood occurred did the committee reconsider the drainage standard.
items.notes: not until 位于句首时，主句使用 did 倒装。

items.zh: 这项改革之所以重要，不仅因为它节省资金，还因为它改变了决策方式。
items.en: The reform matters not only because it saves money but also because it changes how decisions are made.
answers: The reform matters not only because it saves money but also because it changes how decisions are made.
items.notes: not only ... but also 连接两个原因从句；how 引导宾语从句。

items.zh: 正是缺少连续的数据，而不是结果本身，使长期趋势难以判断。
items.en: It is the lack of continuous data, rather than the result itself, that makes the long-term trend difficult to assess.
answers: It is the lack of continuous data, rather than the result itself, that makes the long-term trend difficult to assess.
items.notes: it is ... that 强调结构突出判断困难的原因。

items.zh: 该建议既没有说明谁负责执行，也没有估计执行需要多少时间。
items.en: The recommendation states neither who is responsible for implementation nor how long implementation would take.
answers: The recommendation states neither who is responsible for implementation nor how long implementation would take.
items.notes: neither ... nor 连接两个间接疑问，结构保持平行。

items.zh: 新规则一经实施，就暴露出此前指南未曾预料的边缘情况。
items.en: No sooner had the new rule been introduced than edge cases emerged that the earlier guidance had not anticipated.
answers: No sooner had the new rule been introduced than edge cases emerged that the earlier guidance had not anticipated.
items.notes: no sooner ... than 使用过去完成时倒装，表示紧接发生。

items.zh: 无论报告写得多清楚，若关键数据不公开，结论仍无法核实。
items.en: However clearly the report is written, its conclusions remain unverifiable if the key data are withheld.
answers: However clearly the report is written, its conclusions remain unverifiable if the key data are withheld.
items.notes: however + 副词引导程度让步；if 从句补充核实条件。

items.zh: 该措施不仅没有缩短队伍，反而让办理最简单业务的人等得更久。
items.en: Far from shortening the queue, the measure made people with the simplest requests wait longer.
answers: Far from shortening the queue, the measure made people with the simplest requests wait longer.
items.notes: far from doing 表示结果与目标相反；make someone do 不带 to。

items.zh: 如果当时设有备用线路，整个网络就不会因一个故障而停摆。
items.en: Had a backup route been available, a single failure would not have brought the entire network to a halt.
answers: Had a backup route been available, a single failure would not have brought the entire network to a halt.
items.notes: had 倒装表达与过去事实相反的条件。

items.zh: 我们不应因为建议听起来合理，就忽视它建立在未经检验的假设上。
items.en: We should not overlook the fact that the recommendation rests on an untested assumption merely because it sounds reasonable.
answers: We should not overlook the fact that the recommendation rests on an untested assumption merely because it sounds reasonable.
items.notes: the fact that 承载被忽视内容；merely because 限制错误理由。

items.zh: 报告最有价值之处，在于它解释了相似结果如何由不同过程产生。
items.en: What makes the report valuable is its explanation of how similar outcomes can arise from different processes.
answers: What makes the report valuable is its explanation of how similar outcomes can arise from different processes.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；how 从句作介词 of 的宾语。

items.zh: 在任何情况下，工作人员都不得为加快处理而跳过身份核验。
items.en: Under no circumstances may staff skip identity checks in order to speed up processing.
answers: Under no circumstances may staff skip identity checks in order to speed up processing.
items.notes: 否定介词短语置于句首引起情态动词倒装。

items.zh: 该方案成本高是一方面，更严重的是它把维护责任留给了资金不足的社区。
items.en: The scheme is expensive; more seriously, it leaves responsibility for maintenance with underfunded communities.
answers: The scheme is expensive; more seriously, it leaves responsibility for maintenance with underfunded communities.
items.notes: 分号分开两项批评；more seriously 建立重要性层级。

items.zh: 无论委员会选择降低费用还是简化表格，都必须监测谁仍被排除在外。
items.en: Whether the committee reduces the fee or simplifies the form, it must monitor who remains excluded.
answers: Whether the committee reduces the fee or simplifies the form, it must monitor who remains excluded.
items.notes: whether ... or 表示两种方案共享的后续责任。

items.zh: 很少有政策能同时降低成本、提高质量并扩大覆盖范围。
items.en: Rarely does a policy reduce costs, improve quality, and widen access at the same time.
answers: Rarely does a policy reduce costs, improve quality, and widen access at the same time.
items.notes: rarely 位于句首引起部分倒装；三个谓语并列。

items.zh: 问题并非居民不知道规则，而是规则在不同网页上的表述不一致。
items.en: The problem is not that residents are unaware of the rule but that it is described inconsistently across different web pages.
answers: The problem is not that residents are unaware of the rule but that it is described inconsistently across different web pages.
items.notes: not that ... but that 对照错误解释与实际问题。

items.zh: 只有把缺失回复也记录下来，调查结果才可能被正确解释。
items.en: Only if missing responses are recorded can the survey findings be interpreted correctly.
answers: Only if missing responses are recorded can the survey findings be interpreted correctly.
items.notes: only if 置于句首引起主句倒装。

items.zh: 这项服务是否免费固然重要，但人们能否在需要时使用它同样重要。
items.en: Whether the service is free matters, but so does whether people can access it when they need it.
answers: Whether the service is free matters, but so does whether people can access it when they need it.
items.notes: so does 倒装避免重复 matters；两个 whether 从句平行。

items.zh: 并不是技术本身失败了，而是机构没有调整配套流程。
items.en: It was not the technology itself that failed; rather, the organisation failed to adapt the surrounding process.
answers: It was not the technology itself that failed; rather, the organisation failed to adapt the surrounding process.
items.notes: 强调结构纠正归因；rather 引出真正失败之处。

items.zh: 我们越依赖单一供应商，服务中断时可用的替代方案就越少。
items.en: The more heavily we depend on a single supplier, the fewer alternatives remain when the service is disrupted.
answers: The more heavily we depend on a single supplier, the fewer alternatives remain when the service is disrupted.
items.notes: the more ..., the fewer ... 表达依赖程度与韧性的联动。

items.zh: 评估不仅要问目标是否实现，还要问哪些群体承担了实现目标的成本。
items.en: An evaluation should ask not only whether the goal was achieved but also which groups bore the cost of achieving it.
answers: An evaluation should ask not only whether the goal was achieved but also which groups bore the cost of achieving it.
items.notes: 两个间接问句形成结果与分配影响的平行评价。

items.zh: 如果不是当地组织提供场地，咨询活动根本无法覆盖这些村庄。
items.en: Were it not for local organisations providing venues, the consultation could not reach these villages.
answers: Were it not for local organisations providing venues, the consultation could not reach these villages.
