items.notes: were it not for 是正式虚拟条件，表示实际存在的支持。

items.zh: 报告一方面承认数据有限，另一方面却给出了毫无限定的结论。
items.en: While the report acknowledges the limited data, it nevertheless presents an entirely unqualified conclusion.
answers: While the report acknowledges the limited data, it nevertheless presents an entirely unqualified conclusion.
items.notes: while 与 nevertheless 共同突出承认局限和结论绝对之间的矛盾。

items.zh: 最需要解释的不是结果为何不同，而是为何在定义改变后仍把它们直接比较。
items.en: What requires explanation is not why the results differ but why they are still compared directly after the definition changed.
answers: What requires explanation is not why the results differ but why they are still compared directly after the definition changed.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；两个 why 从句并列为真正解释对象。

items.zh: 鉴于施工期间学校仍需开放，最嘈杂的工作被安排在假期。
items.en: In view of the need to keep the school open during construction, the noisiest work was scheduled for the holidays.
answers: In view of the need to keep the school open during construction, the noisiest work was scheduled for the holidays.
items.notes: in view of 引出决策依据；during 与 for 分别表示过程期间和安排时段。

items.zh: 除定期维护外，合同还涵盖紧急上门服务。
items.en: In addition to routine maintenance, the contract covers emergency call-outs.
answers: In addition to routine maintenance, the contract covers emergency call-outs.
items.notes: in addition to 后接名词；cover 直接表示合同范围。

items.zh: 代表租户发言的机构要求延长咨询期。
items.en: The organisation acting on behalf of tenants requested an extension to the consultation period.
answers: The organisation acting on behalf of tenants requested an extension to the consultation period.
items.notes: on behalf of 表示代表；an extension to 表示期限延长。

items.zh: 由于现行规定，任何退款都必须退回原付款账户。
items.en: By virtue of the current regulations, any refund must be returned to the original payment account.
answers: By virtue of the current regulations, any refund must be returned to the original payment account.
items.notes: by virtue of 表示依据规则而产生的结果。

items.zh: 与邻近地区相比，该镇每名居民拥有的绿地较少。
items.en: In comparison with neighbouring areas, the town has less green space per resident.
answers: In comparison with neighbouring areas, the town has less green space per resident.
items.notes: in comparison with 引出比较对象；per 表示按每人计算。

items.zh: 尽管预算受限，团队仍优先修复了存在安全风险的部分。
items.en: Despite constraints on the budget, the team gave priority to repairs involving a safety risk.
answers: Despite constraints on the budget, the team gave priority to repairs involving a safety risk.
items.notes: constraints on、priority to、risk involving 构成不同关系。

items.zh: 关于谁拥有原始数据，合同没有作出明确规定。
items.en: With regard to ownership of the raw data, the contract contains no explicit provision.
answers: With regard to ownership of the raw data, the contract contains no explicit provision.
items.notes: with regard to 引出议题；provision 表示合同条款。

items.zh: 该项目在五年期结束前一直依赖临时资金。
items.en: The project remained dependent on temporary funding throughout the five-year period.
answers: The project remained dependent on temporary funding throughout the five-year period.
items.notes: dependent on 是固定搭配；throughout 表示覆盖完整期间。

items.zh: 为回应公众意见，入口从主街移到了建筑侧面。
items.en: In response to public feedback, the entrance was moved from the main street to the side of the building.
answers: In response to public feedback, the entrance was moved from the main street to the side of the building.
items.notes: in response to 表示回应；from ... to 表示位置变化。

items.zh: 该规则对小型机构造成的负担与其风险水平不成比例。
items.en: The burden that the rule places on small organisations is disproportionate to the level of risk involved.
answers: The burden that the rule places on small organisations is disproportionate to the level of risk involved.
items.notes: place a burden on；be disproportionate to 表示不成比例。

items.zh: 在没有正式协议的情况下，两个部门一直依据非正式惯例共享信息。
items.en: In the absence of a formal agreement, the two departments have shared information on the basis of an informal practice.
answers: In the absence of a formal agreement, the two departments have shared information on the basis of an informal practice.
items.notes: in the absence of 与 on the basis of 分别表达缺失条件和行动依据。

items.zh: 所有申请均须按照收到完整材料的先后顺序处理。
items.en: All applications must be processed in accordance with the order in which complete documentation is received.
answers: All applications must be processed in accordance with the order in which complete documentation is received.
items.notes: in accordance with 表示遵照；in which 修饰 order。

items.zh: 该补贴是在现有福利之外提供的，不会替代原有支持。
items.en: The grant is provided over and above existing benefits and does not replace them.
answers: The grant is provided over and above existing benefits and does not replace them.
items.notes: over and above 表示在原有基础上额外增加。

items.zh: 为了保护隐私，公开文件中的姓名均以编号代替。
items.en: For the sake of privacy, names in the public document are replaced with reference numbers.
answers: For the sake of privacy, names in the public document are replaced with reference numbers.
items.notes: for the sake of 表示目的；replace A with B。

items.zh: 除了一个计数错误，表格中的数字与审计记录一致。
items.en: With the exception of one counting error, the figures in the table agree with the audit record.
answers: With the exception of one counting error, the figures in the table agree with the audit record.
items.notes: with the exception of 明确唯一例外；agree with 表示数据一致。

items.zh: 根据申请人提供的信息，住房补贴暂定为每周八十英镑。
items.en: On the basis of the information supplied by the applicant, the housing allowance has been provisionally set at eighty pounds per week.
answers: On the basis of the information supplied by the applicant, the housing allowance has been provisionally set at eighty pounds per week.
items.notes: on the basis of 表示计算依据；set at 表示数额。

items.zh: 这项收费与提供服务的实际成本无关。
items.en: The charge bears no relation to the actual cost of providing the service.
answers: The charge bears no relation to the actual cost of providing the service.
items.notes: bear no relation to 是正式表达，表示两者无关联。

items.zh: 为防止利益冲突，评审人员不得参与与自己有关的决定。
items.en: To guard against conflicts of interest, reviewers must take no part in decisions concerning themselves.
answers: To guard against conflicts of interest, reviewers must take no part in decisions concerning themselves.
items.notes: guard against 表示防范；take part in 表示参与。

items.zh: 在紧急维修方面，房东仍负有责任，无论损坏由谁报告。
items.en: In respect of emergency repairs, the landlord remains responsible regardless of who reports the damage.
answers: In respect of emergency repairs, the landlord remains responsible regardless of who reports the damage.
items.notes: in respect of 引出事项；regardless of 后接 who 从句。

items.zh: 道路关闭期间，居民可以经由工业区进入停车场。
items.en: For the duration of the road closure, residents can reach the car park via the industrial estate.
answers: For the duration of the road closure, residents can reach the car park via the industrial estate.
items.notes: for the duration of 表示整个持续期；via 表示经由路线。

items.zh: 考虑到建筑的历史价值，任何改动都必须与原有外观相协调。
items.en: In light of the building's historic value, any alteration must be compatible with its original appearance.
answers: In light of the building's historic value, any alteration must be compatible with its original appearance.
items.notes: in light of 表示考虑到；compatible with 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 就能源效率而言，新窗户的表现明显优于旧窗户。
items.en: In terms of energy efficiency, the new windows perform substantially better than the old ones.
answers: In terms of energy efficiency, the new windows perform substantially better than the old ones.
items.notes: in terms of 限定评价维度；ones 避免重复 windows。

items.zh: 与预期相反，新增座位并没有缩短高峰期的排队时间。
items.en: Contrary to expectations, the additional seats did not shorten queues at peak times.
answers: Contrary to expectations, the additional seats did not shorten queues at peak times.
items.notes: contrary to 表示与预期相反；at peak times 是时间搭配。

items.zh: 本次调整不会影响你在原协议下享有的权利。
items.en: The adjustment will not affect the rights you hold under the original agreement.
answers: The adjustment will not affect the rights you hold under the original agreement.
items.notes: under an agreement 表示依据协议享有权利。

items.zh: 鉴于近期的系统故障，机构暂时恢复了纸质申请渠道。
items.en: In the wake of the recent system failure, the agency temporarily restored a paper application route.
answers: In the wake of the recent system failure, the agency temporarily restored a paper application route.
items.notes: in the wake of 表示在某事件之后并因其影响。

items.zh: 委员会采用了顾问认为最容易在一年内实施的方案。
items.en: The committee adopted the option that the consultant considered easiest to implement within a year.
answers: The committee adopted the option that the consultant considered easiest to implement within a year.
items.notes: that 作 considered 的宾语；easiest 是宾语补足语。

items.zh: 收到错误账单的人可以联系信件底部所列的团队。
items.en: Anyone who received an incorrect bill can contact the team whose details appear at the bottom of the letter.
answers: Anyone who received an incorrect bill can contact the team whose details appear at the bottom of the letter.
items.notes: who 与 whose 从句分别限定收件人和团队。

items.zh: 这次审查发现了一些标准在不同地区含义不同的术语。
items.en: The review identified terms whose meanings varied across regions despite the use of common standards.
answers: The review identified terms whose meanings varied across regions despite the use of common standards.
items.notes: whose 可表示术语与含义的所属关系。

items.zh: 租户投诉的那个房间位于测量显示湿度最高的楼层。
items.en: The room about which the tenant complained is on the floor where the measurements showed the highest humidity.
answers: The room about which the tenant complained is on the floor where the measurements showed the highest humidity.
items.notes: about which 保留 complain about；where 修饰 floor。

items.zh: 有两个日期之后提交的申请仍被系统标记为按时。
items.en: Applications submitted after either of two dates were still marked by the system as being on time.
answers: Applications submitted after either of two dates were still marked by the system as being on time.
items.notes: submitted after 后置修饰；either of two dates 避免关系从句歧义。

items.zh: 该公司关闭了维修中心，而许多农村客户正是依赖该中心获得备件。
items.en: The company closed the repair centre on which many rural customers relied for spare parts.
answers: The company closed the repair centre on which many rural customers relied for spare parts.
items.notes: on which 对应 rely on；for spare parts 说明依赖目的。

items.zh: 该计划最初针对的家庭并不是后来从中受益最多的家庭。
items.en: The households for which the scheme was originally designed were not those that later benefited most from it.
answers: The households for which the scheme was originally designed were not those that later benefited most from it.
items.notes: for which 表示设计对象；those that 避免重复 households。

items.zh: 调查使用的类别把自雇者和没有固定工时的雇员归在了一起。
items.en: The categories used by the survey grouped self-employed workers with employees whose hours were not fixed.
answers: The categories used by the survey grouped self-employed workers with employees whose hours were not fixed.
items.notes: used by 压缩被动定语；whose hours 限定第二类人员。

items.zh: 这是一项连专家也无法就其长期影响达成一致的技术。
items.en: This is a technology about whose long-term effects even specialists cannot agree.
answers: This is a technology about whose long-term effects even specialists cannot agree.
items.notes: about whose 同时保留 agree about 并表示技术与影响的关系。

items.zh: 价格受到监管的药品供应量反而下降了。
items.en: The supply of the medicine whose price was regulated actually declined.
answers: The supply of the medicine whose price was regulated actually declined.
items.notes: whose price 限定药品；actually 突出反预期结果。

items.zh: 项目所服务的村庄中，有一半没有每日公共交通。
items.en: Half of the villages that the programme serves have no daily public transport.
answers: Half of the villages that the programme serves have no daily public transport.
items.notes: that 在从句中作 serves 的宾语，可省略但此处保留以清晰。

items.zh: 我们需要区分由政策引起的变化与本来就会发生的变化。
items.en: We need to distinguish changes caused by the policy from those that would have occurred anyway.
answers: We need to distinguish changes caused by the policy from those that would have occurred anyway.
items.notes: those 代替 changes；would have occurred 表示反事实基线。

items.zh: 更新后失效的链接都指向由外部机构管理的页面。
items.en: The links that failed after the update all led to pages managed by an external organisation.
answers: The links that failed after the update all led to pages managed by an external organisation.
items.notes: that 从句限定失效链接；managed by 后置修饰 pages。

items.zh: 在场的十名成员中，有四人后来对记录中的决定提出异议。
items.en: Of the ten members who were present, four later disputed the decision recorded in the minutes.
answers: Of the ten members who were present, four later disputed the decision recorded in the minutes.
items.notes: who 限定在场成员；recorded in 压缩被动定语。

items.zh: 委员会收到了一封没有署名、内容也无法核实的信。
items.en: The committee received an unsigned letter whose contents could not be verified.
answers: The committee received an unsigned letter whose contents could not be verified.
items.notes: unsigned 与 whose 从句提供两类独立特征。

items.zh: 新系统取代的纸质流程曾允许工作人员解释特殊情况。
items.en: The paper process that the new system replaced had allowed staff to explain exceptional circumstances.
answers: The paper process that the new system replaced had allowed staff to explain exceptional circumstances.
items.notes: that 作 replaced 的宾语；过去完成时说明被取代前的功能。

items.zh: 该研究排除了母语不在问卷语言之列的参与者。
items.en: The study excluded participants whose first language was not among those in which the questionnaire was available.
answers: The study excluded participants whose first language was not among those in which the questionnaire was available.
items.notes: whose 与 in which 嵌套，分别表示参与者语言和问卷可用语言。

items.zh: 几项成本尚未量化，因此最终预算可能超出当前估计。
items.en: Several costs have yet to be quantified and may push the final budget above the current estimate.
answers: Several costs have yet to be quantified and may push the final budget above the current estimate.
items.notes: have yet to be quantified 表示数额尚未确定；and 连接未知成本与预算风险。

items.zh: 我们参观的中心使用了当地团队在洪水后开发的登记方法。
items.en: The centre we visited uses a registration method that a local team developed after the flood.
answers: The centre we visited uses a registration method that a local team developed after the flood.
items.notes: 两个宾语关系从句使用不同先行词，避免重复主语。

items.zh: 该倡议吸引了原本不会参加正式会议的居民。
items.en: The initiative attracted residents who would not otherwise have attended a formal meeting.
answers: The initiative attracted residents who would not otherwise have attended a formal meeting.
items.notes: would not otherwise have done 表示若无该倡议的反事实结果。

items.zh: 补贴计算所依据的收入年份比申请年份早两年。
items.en: The income year on which the subsidy calculation is based precedes the application year by two years.
answers: The income year on which the subsidy calculation is based precedes the application year by two years.
items.notes: on which 对应 be based on；precede A by 表示早多少。

items.zh: 事故发生的路段没有安装新标准要求的护栏。
items.en: The stretch of road where the accident occurred lacked the barrier required by the new standard.
answers: The stretch of road where the accident occurred lacked the barrier required by the new standard.
items.notes: where 修饰地点；required by 后置限定 barrier。

items.zh: 这项调整影响的是工时每周都有变化的员工。
items.en: The adjustment affects employees whose working hours vary from week to week.
answers: The adjustment affects employees whose working hours vary from week to week.
items.notes: whose 表示员工与工时的关系；from week to week 表示持续变化。

items.zh: 作者引用了一份其数据后来被撤回的报告。
items.en: The author cited a report the data from which were later withdrawn.
answers: The author cited a report the data from which were later withdrawn.
items.notes: the data from which 是正式关系结构，明确撤回的是数据。

items.zh: 我们无法找到最初提出这一限制的会议记录。
items.en: We could not locate the minutes of the meeting at which the restriction was first proposed.
answers: We could not locate the minutes of the meeting at which the restriction was first proposed.
items.notes: at which 对应 propose at the meeting，定位信息来源。

items.zh: 审计员指出，缺少收据并不一定意味着费用不当。
items.en: The auditor noted that the absence of a receipt did not necessarily mean that the expense was improper.
answers: The auditor noted that the absence of a receipt did not necessarily mean that the expense was improper.
items.notes: note that 中性报告发现；第二个 that 从句说明 mean 的内容。

items.zh: 居民声称他们没有收到通知，但记录显示邮件已经送达。
items.en: Residents claimed that they had not received the notice, whereas the records indicated that the email had been delivered.
answers: Residents claimed that they had not received the notice, whereas the records indicated that the email had been delivered.
items.notes: claim 与 indicate 区分主张和记录所示证据。

items.zh: 委员会承认，它低估了完成无障碍改造所需的时间。
items.en: The committee acknowledged that it had underestimated how long the accessibility work would take.
answers: The committee acknowledged that it had underestimated how long the accessibility work would take.
items.notes: acknowledge 表示承认；how long 使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 研究结果暗示睡眠可能是一个因素，却没有证明它是唯一原因。
items.en: The findings suggest that sleep may be a factor but do not establish that it is the sole cause.
answers: The findings suggest that sleep may be a factor but do not establish that it is the sole cause.
items.notes: suggest 表示提示，establish 表示更强证明，证据语气不同。

items.zh: 供应商保证更新不会删除现有记录。
items.en: The supplier gave an assurance that the update would not delete existing records.
answers: The supplier gave an assurance that the update would not delete existing records.
items.notes: assurance 后用 that 同位语从句说明保证内容。

items.zh: 警方证实道路已经开放，但提醒司机仍有积水。
items.en: The police confirmed that the road had reopened but warned drivers that surface water remained.
answers: The police confirmed that the road had reopened but warned drivers that surface water remained.
items.notes: confirm 与 warn 接不同宾语结构；过去完成时回溯开放。

items.zh: 作者假定所有未回复者都对服务满意，却没有为此提供理由。
items.en: The author assumes that all non-respondents were satisfied with the service but offers no justification for doing so.
answers: The author assumes that all non-respondents were satisfied with the service but offers no justification for doing so.
items.notes: assume that 表示假设；doing so 回指作出该假设。

items.zh: 顾问建议先修复屋顶，再讨论内部翻新。
items.en: The consultant recommended that the roof be repaired before any internal renovation was considered.
answers: The consultant recommended that the roof be repaired before any internal renovation was considered.
items.notes: recommend that 后用原形被动 be repaired，正式虚拟式。

items.zh: 报告质疑增长是否会在补贴结束后持续。
items.en: The report questions whether the growth will continue after the subsidy ends.
answers: The report questions whether the growth will continue after the subsidy ends.
items.notes: question whether 表示对持续性提出疑问，不等于否认。

items.zh: 部门否认曾要求员工修改投诉日期。
items.en: The department denied having asked staff to alter the dates of complaints.
answers: The department denied having asked staff to alter the dates of complaints.
items.notes: deny having done 表示否认过去行为。

items.zh: 评审小组得出结论，现有证据不足以支持全国推广。
items.en: The review panel concluded that the available evidence was insufficient to support a national rollout.
answers: The review panel concluded that the available evidence was insufficient to support a national rollout.
items.notes: conclude that 报告结论；insufficient to 限定证据水平。

items.zh: 申请人被告知，延迟提供材料可能导致案件结案。
items.en: Applicants were advised that a delay in providing documents might result in their cases being closed.
answers: Applicants were advised that a delay in providing documents might result in their cases being closed.
items.notes: advise someone that；result in 后接动名词被动结构。

items.zh: 经理解释说，数字变化是因为统计口径调整，而不是服务量下降。
items.en: The manager explained that the figures had changed because the counting method had been revised, not because service use had fallen.
answers: The manager explained that the figures had changed because the counting method had been revised, not because service use had fallen.
items.notes: 两个 because 从句对照真正原因和被否定原因。

items.zh: 研究人员预计需求会增长，却没有说明预测基于何种模型。
items.en: The researchers predict that demand will grow but do not state which model the forecast is based on.
answers: The researchers predict that demand will grow but do not state which model the forecast is based on.
items.notes: predict that 与 state which 分别表达预测和方法披露。

items.zh: 该机构承诺会公布结果，无论结果是否支持原方案。
items.en: The agency has undertaken to publish the results whether or not they support the original proposal.
answers: The agency has undertaken to publish the results whether or not they support the original proposal.
items.notes: undertake to do 表示正式承诺；whether or not 表示不受结果影响。

items.zh: 证人回忆门口有人等候，但不能确定那人何时到达。
items.en: The witness recalled that someone had been waiting by the entrance but could not say when that person had arrived.
answers: The witness recalled that someone had been waiting by the entrance but could not say when that person had arrived.
items.notes: recall that 报告记忆；when 间接问句保留不确定时间。

items.zh: 制造商提醒用户，不按说明充电会缩短电池寿命。
items.en: The manufacturer cautions users that charging the device contrary to the instructions will shorten battery life.
answers: The manufacturer cautions users that charging the device contrary to the instructions will shorten battery life.
items.notes: caution someone that 表示警示；contrary to 表示违反说明。

items.zh: 委员会重申，临时许可不会自动变成永久许可。
items.en: The committee reiterated that a temporary licence would not automatically become permanent.
answers: The committee reiterated that a temporary licence would not automatically become permanent.
items.notes: reiterate that 表示重申既有立场；automatically 限制转化方式。

items.zh: 调查估计约有十分之一的住户没有登记。
items.en: The survey estimates that approximately one in ten households is not registered.
answers: The survey estimates that approximately one in ten households is not registered.
items.notes: estimate that 表示估计；one in ten 可按 one 使用单数谓语。

items.zh: 双方同意由独立专家决定设备是否达到标准。
items.en: The parties agreed that an independent expert should determine whether the equipment met the standard.
answers: The parties agreed that an independent expert should determine whether the equipment met the standard.
items.notes: agree that 引出安排；whether 引出专家要判断的内容。

items.zh: 审稿人反驳了样本能够代表所有年龄层的说法。
items.en: The reviewer disputes the claim that the sample represents every age group.
answers: The reviewer disputes the claim that the sample represents every age group.
items.notes: claim 后的 that 为同位语从句，说明被质疑的主张。

items.zh: 报告预测成本会先上升，随后随着培训需求下降而回落。
items.en: The report projects that costs will rise initially and then fall as the need for training declines.
answers: The report projects that costs will rise initially and then fall as the need for training declines.
items.notes: project that 用于预测；as 引出后期下降的伴随原因。

items.zh: 医生强调，线上建议不能替代面对面检查。
items.en: The doctor emphasised that online advice was not a substitute for an examination in person.
answers: The doctor emphasised that online advice was not a substitute for an examination in person.
items.notes: emphasise that 突出重要限制；a substitute for 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 该组织澄清，它支持调查问题，但不认可所建议的处罚。
items.en: The organisation clarified that it supported an investigation into the problem but not the proposed penalty.
answers: The organisation clarified that it supported an investigation into the problem but not the proposed penalty.
items.notes: clarify that 引出立场；support A but not B 简洁限定支持范围。

items.zh: 专家提醒说，如果定义改变，前后年份的数字将不再可比。
items.en: The expert cautioned that figures from different years would cease to be comparable if the definition changed.
answers: The expert cautioned that figures from different years would cease to be comparable if the definition changed.
items.notes: caution that 报告风险；if 从句说明可比性条件。

items.zh: 只要检查安排在同一天完成，施工就不必停两次。
items.en: As long as both inspections are completed on the same day, construction will not have to stop twice.
answers: As long as both inspections are completed on the same day, construction will not have to stop twice.
items.notes: as long as 表示满足即可的条件；both 限定两次检查。

items.zh: 如果资金按季度拨付，机构就必须先垫付前几个月的工资。
items.en: If funding is released quarterly, organisations must cover the first few months of wages in advance.
answers: If funding is released quarterly, organisations must cover the first few months of wages in advance.
items.notes: if 引出拨款安排造成的现金流后果。

items.zh: 由于旧记录没有统一编号，团队无法确定两份表格是否属于同一人。
items.en: Because the old records lack a common identifier, the team cannot determine whether two forms belong to the same person.
answers: Because the old records lack a common identifier, the team cannot determine whether two forms belong to the same person.
items.notes: because 说明识别困难的原因；whether 引出待判断内容。

items.zh: 一旦投诉转交外部审查，原部门就不能单方面结案。
items.en: Once a complaint has been referred for external review, the original department cannot close it unilaterally.
answers: Once a complaint has been referred for external review, the original department cannot close it unilaterally.
items.notes: once 表示程序节点；现在完成时强调转交后的状态。

items.zh: 除非价格包含长期维护，否则最低报价不一定是最便宜的方案。
items.en: Unless the price includes long-term maintenance, the lowest bid is not necessarily the cheapest option.
answers: Unless the price includes long-term maintenance, the lowest bid is not necessarily the cheapest option.
items.notes: unless 引出比较总成本所需条件；not necessarily 防止绝对化。

items.zh: 如果每次更新都要求重新登录，用户很可能推迟安装安全补丁。
items.en: If every update requires users to sign in again, they are likely to postpone installing security patches.
answers: If every update requires users to sign in again, they are likely to postpone installing security patches.
items.notes: require someone to do；postpone 后接动名词。

items.zh: 只要不把估计值当成精确预测，它仍可用于比较方案。
items.en: Provided that it is not treated as a precise forecast, the estimate can still be used to compare options.
answers: Provided that it is not treated as a precise forecast, the estimate can still be used to compare options.
items.notes: provided that 限定估计值的合理用途。

items.zh: 因为招募广告只在网上发布，样本中缺少不常上网的人并不奇怪。
items.en: Since recruitment was advertised only online, it is unsurprising that infrequent internet users are under-represented in the sample.
answers: Since recruitment was advertised only online, it is unsurprising that infrequent internet users are under-represented in the sample.
items.notes: since 说明抽样偏差来源；it 形式主语承载 that 从句。

items.zh: 假如房东及时修复了漏水，墙体本不会受到如此严重的损坏。
items.en: Had the landlord repaired the leak promptly, the wall would not have been damaged so extensively.
answers: Had the landlord repaired the leak promptly, the wall would not have been damaged so extensively.
items.notes: 过去虚拟条件倒装，说明实际未及时维修。

items.zh: 若要让规则容易执行，例外情况就必须定义清楚。
items.en: If the rule is to be enforceable, its exceptions must be defined clearly.
answers: If the rule is to be enforceable, its exceptions must be defined clearly.
items.notes: if ... is to be 表示要达到的目标条件。

items.zh: 由于两个数据库使用不同的地址格式，自动匹配漏掉了许多重复记录。
items.en: As the two databases used different address formats, the automated match missed many duplicate records.
answers: As the two databases used different address formats, the automated match missed many duplicate records.
items.notes: as 引出技术原因；miss records 表示未识别到。

items.zh: 一旦临时员工也纳入计算，平均工时就明显下降。
items.en: When temporary staff are included in the calculation, average working hours fall noticeably.
answers: When temporary staff are included in the calculation, average working hours fall noticeably.
items.notes: when 表示定义改变时出现的规律性结果。

items.zh: 为了避免给出虚假精度，百分比被四舍五入到最接近的整数。
items.en: Percentages were rounded to the nearest whole number so as not to imply false precision.
answers: Percentages were rounded to the nearest whole number so as not to imply false precision.
items.notes: so as not to 表示避免某结果的目的。

items.zh: 如果没有同期比较组，我们就无法排除整体经济复苏的影响。
items.en: Without a comparison group observed over the same period, we cannot rule out the effect of the wider economic recovery.
answers: Without a comparison group observed over the same period, we cannot rule out the effect of the wider economic recovery.
items.notes: without 引出方法缺失；observed 说明比较组需同期观察。

items.zh: 既然用户已经同意保存草稿，系统就不应在没有警告的情况下删除它。
items.en: Given that users have agreed to save a draft, the system should not delete it without warning.
answers: Given that users have agreed to save a draft, the system should not delete it without warning.
items.notes: given that 提供规范判断的前提；without warning 表示缺失通知。

items.zh: 即使新的收入来源暂时填补缺口，反复出现的赤字仍需结构性解决。
items.en: Even if the new revenue temporarily fills the gap, the recurring deficit still requires a structural solution.
answers: Even if the new revenue temporarily fills the gap, the recurring deficit still requires a structural solution.
items.notes: even if 承认短期缓解不改变长期需要。

items.zh: 若设备再次过热，传感器会自动关闭电源，以免造成永久损坏。
items.en: Should the equipment overheat again, a sensor will cut the power to prevent permanent damage.
answers: Should the equipment overheat again, a sensor will cut the power to prevent permanent damage.
items.notes: should 倒装表示可能条件；to prevent 表示保护目的。

items.zh: 由于服务按先到先得分配，无法在工作日排队的人处于不利地位。
items.en: Because the service is allocated on a first-come, first-served basis, people unable to queue on weekdays are disadvantaged.
answers: Because the service is allocated on a first-come, first-served basis, people unable to queue on weekdays are disadvantaged.
items.notes: because 连接分配机制和差异化影响。

items.zh: 如果目标是减少总排放，就必须把生产和运输都计算在内。
items.en: If the aim is to reduce total emissions, both production and transport must be included in the calculation.
answers: If the aim is to reduce total emissions, both production and transport must be included in the calculation.
items.notes: if 明确评价目标；both ... and 界定计算范围。

items.zh: 等到所有申诉处理完毕，最终名单才会公布。
items.en: The final list will not be published until every appeal has been resolved.
answers: The final list will not be published until every appeal has been resolved.
items.notes: not ... until 表示公布依赖所有申诉完成。

items.zh: 若非地图标注错误，救援队本可以更早到达。
items.en: But for the error on the map, the rescue team could have arrived earlier.
answers: But for the error on the map, the rescue team could have arrived earlier.
items.notes: but for 表示若非某事实，主句使用过去虚拟结果。

items.zh: 由于租户不知道维修属于谁的责任，小问题最终发展成了大故障。
items.en: Minor defects became serious because tenants did not know who was responsible for repairs.
answers: Minor defects became serious because tenants did not know who was responsible for repairs.
items.notes: because 解释升级机制；who 从句使用陈述语序。

items.zh: 只在用户主动退出时才停止提醒，可以减少无意中错过续期的情况。
items.en: Continuing reminders unless users opt out can reduce accidental failures to renew.
answers: Continuing reminders unless users opt out can reduce accidental failures to renew.
items.notes: unless 等同 if not；动名词短语作主语。

items.zh: 如果结果只在一个模型设定下成立，报告就应说明这一点。
items.en: Where a result holds only under one model specification, the report should say so explicitly.
answers: Where a result holds only under one model specification, the report should say so explicitly.
items.notes: where 表示在某种分析情形下；say so 回指结果受限。

items.zh: 为了让未来的审查者重现决定过程，每次人工修改都必须留下记录。
items.en: Every manual change must be logged so that future reviewers can reconstruct how the decision was made.
answers: Every manual change must be logged so that future reviewers can reconstruct how the decision was made.
items.notes: so that 表示可追溯目的；how 从句为重现内容。

items.zh: 通知写得足够具体，住户无需致电就能知道哪一天停水。
items.en: The notice was specific enough for residents to know which day the water would be turned off without calling.
answers: The notice was specific enough for residents to know which day the water would be turned off without calling.
items.notes: enough for someone to do 表示信息达到自助判断程度。

items.zh: 团队把问题拆成几个步骤，以便每项风险都能单独评估。
items.en: The team divided the problem into stages so that each risk could be assessed separately.
answers: The team divided the problem into stages so that each risk could be assessed separately.
items.notes: so that 加 could 表示过去行动的目的。

items.zh: 旧表格如此依赖技术术语，以至于许多申请人需要别人帮助填写。
items.en: The old form relied so heavily on technical language that many applicants needed help to complete it.
answers: The old form relied so heavily on technical language that many applicants needed help to complete it.
items.notes: so + 副词 + that 表示程度导致的结果。

items.zh: 请按原样保存原始文件，以便日后检查任何编辑。
items.en: Keep the original file unchanged so that any later edits can be checked against it.
answers: Keep the original file unchanged so that any later edits can be checked against it.
items.notes: so that 表示保留原件的目的；check A against B。

items.zh: 该网站会根据用户选择的语言调整导航方式。
items.en: The website adapts its navigation according to the language that a user selects.
answers: The website adapts its navigation according to the language that a user selects.
items.notes: according to 表示依据；that 从句限定 language。

items.zh: 委员会缩小了提案范围，从而能在现有预算内完成试点。
items.en: The committee narrowed the proposal, thereby making it possible to complete the pilot within the existing budget.
answers: The committee narrowed the proposal, thereby making it possible to complete the pilot within the existing budget.
items.notes: thereby doing 表示前一行动直接带来的方式或结果。

items.zh: 地址必须完全按账单所示填写，否则自动核验可能失败。
items.en: The address must be entered exactly as it appears on the bill, or the automated check may fail.
answers: The address must be entered exactly as it appears on the bill, or the automated check may fail.
items.notes: as 引导方式从句；or 表示不遵守时的结果。

items.zh: 工作人员用普通语言重述问题，以免受访者误解专业术语。
items.en: Staff restated the question in plain language lest respondents misunderstand the technical term.
answers: Staff restated the question in plain language lest respondents misunderstand the technical term.
items.notes: lest 引导正式的预防目的从句，后接动词原形。

items.zh: 新泵的噪声低到附近教室几乎听不见。
items.en: The new pump is quiet enough to be barely audible in the nearby classroom.
answers: The new pump is quiet enough to be barely audible in the nearby classroom.
items.notes: 形容词 + enough to 表示结果程度；audible 描述可听见性。

items.zh: 软件以用户完成各步骤的顺序记录操作，而不是按页面排列顺序记录。
items.en: The software records actions in the order in which users complete them rather than the order in which pages appear.
answers: The software records actions in the order in which users complete them rather than the order in which pages appear.
items.notes: 两个 in which 从句建立方式对照。

items.zh: 项目扩大得太快，培训能力无法跟上。
items.en: The programme expanded too rapidly for training capacity to keep pace.
answers: The programme expanded too rapidly for training capacity to keep pace.
items.notes: too + 副词 + for someone to do 表示结果超出承受能力。

items.zh: 报告将数字按人口规模调整，使不同城市能够公平比较。
items.en: The report adjusts the figures for population size, allowing cities of different sizes to be compared fairly.
answers: The report adjusts the figures for population size, allowing cities of different sizes to be compared fairly.
items.notes: allowing 分词短语说明调整后的结果。

items.zh: 申请人可以选择接收短信，这样即使邮件进入垃圾箱也不会错过通知。
items.en: Applicants can opt to receive text messages so that they do not miss a notice if an email is filtered as spam.
answers: Applicants can opt to receive text messages so that they do not miss a notice if an email is filtered as spam.
items.notes: so that 表示选择短信的目的；if 加入邮件失败条件。

items.zh: 调查问题应使用普通读者能够理解的措辞。
items.en: Survey questions should be phrased in terms that ordinary readers can understand.
answers: Survey questions should be phrased in terms that ordinary readers can understand.
items.notes: in terms that 用定语从句限定措辞的可理解性。

items.zh: 通道加宽后，两辆轮椅可以并排通过。
items.en: The passage was widened sufficiently for two wheelchairs to pass side by side.
answers: The passage was widened sufficiently for two wheelchairs to pass side by side.
items.notes: sufficiently for ... to 表示宽度达到的实际结果。

items.zh: 每个决定都附有简短理由，从而降低了申诉人误解结果的可能性。
items.en: A brief reason accompanies each decision, thereby reducing the likelihood that appellants will misunderstand the outcome.
answers: A brief reason accompanies each decision, thereby reducing the likelihood that appellants will misunderstand the outcome.
items.notes: thereby reducing 表示机制；that 从句说明 likelihood 内容。

items.zh: 提醒频率被限制，以免频繁通知反而让用户忽略重要信息。
items.en: The frequency of reminders is limited so that repeated notifications do not cause users to ignore important information.
answers: The frequency of reminders is limited so that repeated notifications do not cause users to ignore important information.
items.notes: so that 表示避免反效果；cause someone to do。

items.zh: 数据采用与上一轮相同的方法加权，以保持结果可比。
items.en: The data were weighted in the same way as in the previous round to keep the results comparable.
answers: The data were weighted in the same way as in the previous round to keep the results comparable.
items.notes: in the same way as 表示方法一致；to keep 表示目的。

items.zh: 机构把决定写成临时决定，避免它被误读为最终裁决。
items.en: The agency labelled the decision as provisional to prevent it from being read as a final ruling.
answers: The agency labelled the decision as provisional to prevent it from being read as a final ruling.
items.notes: label A as B；prevent A from being done。

items.zh: 新指示牌的位置太高，坐轮椅的人很难读到。
items.en: The new sign is positioned too high for wheelchair users to read comfortably.
answers: The new sign is positioned too high for wheelchair users to read comfortably.
items.notes: too high for someone to do 表示位置造成的可读性问题。

items.zh: 每个版本都标注日期，因此读者可以判断自己看到的是否最新。
items.en: Each version is dated so that readers can tell whether the copy they see is current.
answers: Each version is dated so that readers can tell whether the copy they see is current.
items.notes: so that 表示标注目的；whether 从句为判断内容。

items.zh: 结论被改写得更谨慎，以反映样本量带来的不确定性。
items.en: The conclusion was worded more cautiously to reflect the uncertainty arising from the sample size.
answers: The conclusion was worded more cautiously to reflect the uncertainty arising from the sample size.
items.notes: to reflect 表示改写目的；arising from 后置修饰 uncertainty。

items.zh: 供水系统的设计方式使单个阀门故障不会切断整栋楼的供水。
items.en: The water system is designed so that the failure of one valve does not cut off the whole building.
answers: The water system is designed so that the failure of one valve does not cut off the whole building.
items.notes: be designed so that 说明系统设计达到的功能结果。

items.zh: 问卷先询问经历，再询问满意度，以减少后一个答案受前一个评价影响。
items.en: The questionnaire asks about experience before satisfaction so as to reduce the influence of general opinion on the later answer.
answers: The questionnaire asks about experience before satisfaction so as to reduce the influence of general opinion on the later answer.
items.notes: so as to 表示题序安排的测量目的。

items.zh: 解释应写得让不熟悉项目的人也能理解，而不只是让内部团队看得懂。
items.en: The explanation should be understandable to people unfamiliar with the project, rather than only to the internal team.
answers: The explanation should be understandable to people unfamiliar with the project, rather than only to the internal team.
items.notes: understandable to 界定目标读者；rather than only 扩大适用范围。

items.zh: 地方政府出台了新指南，以规范短租住房的管理。
items.en: The local authority issued new guidance to regulate the management of short-term rentals.
answers: The local authority issued new guidance to regulate the management of short-term rentals.
items.notes: issue guidance 比 publish a policy 更准确；guidance 不可数。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 该研究揭示了收入不稳定如何影响家庭的长期规划。
items.en: The study sheds light on how income insecurity affects households' long-term planning.
answers: The study sheds light on how income insecurity affects households' long-term planning.
items.notes: shed light on 表示揭示；affect 直接接宾语。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 临时拨款只能弥补今年的缺口，无法维持长期服务。
items.en: Temporary funding can bridge this year's gap but cannot sustain the service over the long term.
answers: Temporary funding can bridge this year's gap but cannot sustain the service over the long term.
items.notes: bridge a gap 与 sustain a service 是自然搭配。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 新平台整合了原本分散在三个部门的信息。
items.en: The new platform brings together information previously scattered across three departments.
answers: The new platform brings together information previously scattered across three departments.
items.notes: bring together information 比 collect all informations 自然。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 工作人员应核实申请人的身份，而不是仅凭邮件地址作判断。
items.en: Staff should verify an applicant's identity rather than rely solely on an email address.
answers: Staff should verify an applicant's identity rather than rely solely on an email address.
items.notes: verify identity；rely on 是固定搭配。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 这项改革减轻了医院的行政负担，却增加了家庭医生的工作量。
items.en: The reform eased the administrative burden on hospitals but increased the workload of general practitioners.
answers: The reform eased the administrative burden on hospitals but increased the workload of general practitioners.
items.notes: ease a burden on；increase a workload。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 机构必须维护公众对申诉程序独立性的信任。
items.en: The agency must maintain public confidence in the independence of the appeals process.
answers: The agency must maintain public confidence in the independence of the appeals process.
items.notes: maintain confidence in 比 keep people's trust to 更自然。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 短暂的宣传活动很难改变已经根深蒂固的出行习惯。
items.en: A brief publicity campaign is unlikely to change deeply ingrained travel habits.
answers: A brief publicity campaign is unlikely to change deeply ingrained travel habits.
items.notes: change habits；deeply ingrained 表示习惯已经牢固形成。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 新的证据削弱了原先支持关闭中心的理由。
items.en: The new evidence weakens the original case for closing the centre.
answers: The new evidence weakens the original case for closing the centre.
items.notes: weaken the case for 表示削弱支持某行动的论据。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 委员会暂缓作出决定，等待独立检测结果。
items.en: The committee deferred its decision pending the results of independent testing.
answers: The committee deferred its decision pending the results of independent testing.
items.notes: defer a decision；pending 表示等待某结果。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 这项措施旨在消除阻碍残障人士求职的实际障碍。
items.en: The measure seeks to remove practical barriers that prevent disabled people from applying for work.
answers: The measure seeks to remove practical barriers that prevent disabled people from applying for work.
items.notes: remove barriers；prevent someone from doing。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 过于复杂的退款程序会打击消费者提出合理申请的积极性。
items.en: An overly complex refund process discourages consumers from making legitimate claims.
answers: An overly complex refund process discourages consumers from making legitimate claims.
items.notes: discourage someone from doing；make a claim。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 这份指南明确了学校在网络欺凌事件中的责任。
items.en: The guidance clarifies schools' responsibilities in cases of online bullying.
answers: The guidance clarifies schools' responsibilities in cases of online bullying.
items.notes: clarify responsibilities；in cases of 表示在某类事件中。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 租金上限可能抑制价格上涨，却也可能限制新住房供应。
items.en: A rent cap may curb price increases but may also constrain the supply of new housing.
answers: A rent cap may curb price increases but may also constrain the supply of new housing.
items.notes: curb an increase；constrain supply，搭配各自自然。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 企业应披露可能影响客户选择的商业关系。
items.en: Companies should disclose commercial relationships that may influence customer choice.
answers: Companies should disclose commercial relationships that may influence customer choice.
items.notes: disclose information/relationships；influence choice 直接接宾语。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 项目未能吸引目标人群，因此组织方调整了招募策略。
items.en: The programme failed to reach its intended audience, so its organisers revised the recruitment strategy.
answers: The programme failed to reach its intended audience, so its organisers revised the recruitment strategy.
items.notes: reach an audience；revise a strategy，并明确由组织方采取行动。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 政府拨出专款，帮助学校升级供暖系统。
items.en: The government allocated dedicated funding to help schools upgrade their heating systems.
answers: The government allocated dedicated funding to help schools upgrade their heating systems.
items.notes: allocate funding；help someone do 不带 to 也可。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 此次咨询收集了意见，却没有解决居民最关心的问题。
items.en: The consultation gathered views but did not address residents' main concern.
answers: The consultation gathered views but did not address residents' main concern.
items.notes: gather views 与 address a concern 是正式搭配。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 该协议赋予监管机构检查原始记录的权力。
items.en: The agreement grants the regulator authority to inspect the original records.
answers: The agreement grants the regulator authority to inspect the original records.
items.notes: grant someone authority to do，比 give the right for doing 准确。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 反复延期会侵蚀公众对项目管理能力的信心。
items.en: Repeated delays erode public confidence in the project's management.
answers: Repeated delays erode public confidence in the project's management.
items.notes: erode confidence in 表示逐渐削弱信心。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 新证据促使审查小组重新评估事故原因。
items.en: The new evidence prompted the review panel to reassess the cause of the incident.
answers: The new evidence prompted the review panel to reassess the cause of the incident.
items.notes: prompt someone to do；reassess 直接接宾语。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 医院实施了分流制度，把非紧急病例引导至基层诊所。
items.en: The hospital introduced a triage system that directs non-urgent cases to primary care clinics.
answers: The hospital introduced a triage system that directs non-urgent cases to primary care clinics.
items.notes: introduce a system；direct A to B。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 维修记录证实，故障发生前设备已经出现异常。
items.en: Maintenance records confirm that the equipment had shown signs of abnormal operation before it failed.
answers: Maintenance records confirm that the equipment had shown signs of abnormal operation before it failed.
items.notes: show signs of；过去完成时标明异常先于故障。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 精简审批层级可以加快决策，但必须保留问责机制。
items.en: Streamlining approval levels can speed up decisions, but mechanisms for accountability must be retained.
answers: Streamlining approval levels can speed up decisions, but mechanisms for accountability must be retained.
items.notes: streamline a process/levels；mechanisms for accountability。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 该提案低估了培训新员工所需的持续投入。
items.en: The proposal underestimates the continuing investment required to train new staff.
answers: The proposal underestimates the continuing investment required to train new staff.
items.notes: underestimate investment；required to train 后置修饰。
tags: 中式英语：动词搭配进阶

items.zh: 随着人口增加，对基层医疗的需求也在上升。
items.en: As the population grows, demand for primary care is also rising.
answers: As the population grows, demand for primary care is also rising.
items.notes: 不用 with population increasing, the demand also increases 的生硬结构；as 从句主语完整。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 通过比较两个地区，可以发现交通条件是关键差异。
items.en: A comparison of the two regions shows that transport provision is the key difference.
answers: A comparison of the two regions shows that transport provision is the key difference.
items.notes: 让 comparison 作主语，避免 through comparing we can find。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 在制定政策时，必须考虑没有固定地址的人。
items.en: Policy makers must take account of people who have no fixed address.
answers: Policy makers must take account of people who have no fixed address.
items.notes: 补出具体施事者 policy makers，避免悬空的 when making policy。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 有必要为无法使用智能手机的人保留其他渠道。
items.en: An alternative channel is needed for people who cannot use a smartphone.
answers: An alternative channel is needed for people who cannot use a smartphone.
items.notes: 用具体主语 channel 表达必要性，比 it has necessity 更自然。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 对于这个问题，不同年龄组有不同看法。
items.en: Views on this issue vary across age groups.
answers: Views on this issue vary across age groups.
items.notes: 让 views 作主语并用 vary，避免 different people have different opinions 的重复。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 在过去几年中，该地区发生了显著变化。
items.en: The area has changed considerably over the past few years.
answers: The area has changed considerably over the past few years.
items.notes: 用 area 作主语和 change 作动词，比 there have great changes 简洁。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 仅靠个人努力，很难克服结构性的住房短缺。
items.en: Individual effort alone cannot easily overcome a structural shortage of housing.
answers: Individual effort alone cannot easily overcome a structural shortage of housing.
items.notes: 让 effort 作主语；alone 准确限定个人努力。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 在这种情况下，继续比较百分比没有意义。
items.en: Under these circumstances, comparing percentages further would serve little purpose.
answers: Under these circumstances, comparing percentages further would serve little purpose.
items.notes: 动名词短语作主语；serve little purpose 比 have no meaning 自然。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 从长期来看，预防通常比事后修复成本低。
items.en: Over the long term, prevention is usually less costly than remedial action.
answers: Over the long term, prevention is usually less costly than remedial action.
items.notes: 用抽象名词平行比较 prevention 与 remedial action。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 对许多家庭而言，最大障碍不是费用，而是缺少时间。
items.en: For many households, the greatest barrier is a lack of time rather than cost.
answers: For many households, the greatest barrier is a lack of time rather than cost.
items.notes: barrier 作主语；rather than 清晰对照两项障碍。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 从调查结果来看，不能认为不回复就代表没有意见。
items.en: The survey results do not justify treating non-response as an absence of opinion.
answers: The survey results do not justify treating non-response as an absence of opinion.
items.notes: 让 results 作证据主语；justify doing 表示不足以支持做法。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 在资源有限的情况下，应优先处理风险最高的建筑。
items.en: Where resources are limited, the buildings presenting the greatest risk should take priority.
answers: Where resources are limited, the buildings presenting the greatest risk should take priority.
items.notes: 建筑作主语；take priority 表示应优先处理。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 经过多次讨论，双方终于达成了妥协。
items.en: After several rounds of discussion, the two sides finally reached a compromise.
answers: After several rounds of discussion, the two sides finally reached a compromise.
items.notes: 补出双方为主语；reach a compromise 是固定搭配。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 对于是否扩大项目，目前还没有一致意见。
items.en: There is currently no consensus on whether the programme should be expanded.
answers: There is currently no consensus on whether the programme should be expanded.
items.notes: consensus on whether 表达对某问题无共识。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 调查中出现的一个现象是，满意度高的人未必使用得更多。
items.en: One pattern in the survey is that satisfied users do not necessarily use the service more often.
answers: One pattern in the survey is that satisfied users do not necessarily use the service more often.
items.notes: 用 pattern 指可观察规律；not necessarily 限制推论。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 在缺少完整记录时，只能给出暂时判断。
items.en: Incomplete records allow only a provisional judgement.
answers: Incomplete records allow only a provisional judgement.
items.notes: 让 incomplete records 作限制条件主语，避免无主句。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 关于这一变化，可以从两个方面解释。
items.en: Two factors may account for this change.
answers: Two factors may account for this change.
items.notes: 直接用 factors 作主语并搭配 account for，避免 this change can be explained from。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 随着自动化程度提高，人工判断并没有消失，而是转移到了异常情况。
items.en: As automation increases, human judgement does not disappear but shifts to exceptional cases.
answers: As automation increases, human judgement does not disappear but shifts to exceptional cases.
items.notes: judgement 作主语；not ... but 对照消失与转移。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 在无法核实身份时，申请会暂时搁置。
items.en: An application is placed on hold when the applicant's identity cannot be verified.
answers: An application is placed on hold when the applicant's identity cannot be verified.
items.notes: 申请作主语并用被动；place on hold 是固定表达。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 总体来说，这种方法更快，但不一定更公平。
items.en: Overall, the method is faster but not necessarily fairer.
answers: Overall, the method is faster but not necessarily fairer.
items.notes: 用比较级保持两个评价维度平行；not necessarily 限定。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 在这个阶段，讨论具体预算还为时过早。
items.en: At this stage, it is too early to discuss a detailed budget.
answers: At this stage, it is too early to discuss a detailed budget.
items.notes: it 作形式主语；too early to do 是自然表达。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 通过增加窗口数量，并不能自动解决人员不足。
items.en: Adding more service windows will not by itself solve the staffing shortage.
answers: Adding more service windows will not by itself solve the staffing shortage.
items.notes: 动名词短语作主语；by itself 表明单一措施不足。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 在交通不便的地区，线上服务也许是唯一可行选择。
items.en: In areas with poor transport links, an online service may be the only viable option.
answers: In areas with poor transport links, an online service may be the only viable option.
items.notes: 补出 service 为主语；with 表示地区具有的条件。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 从这些数字无法看出人们为什么改变行为。
items.en: These figures do not reveal why people changed their behaviour.
answers: These figures do not reveal why people changed their behaviour.
items.notes: figures 作主语并用 reveal；why 从句说明无法得知的内容。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 面对需求突然上升，现有系统显得准备不足。
items.en: The existing system proved ill-prepared for the sudden rise in demand.
answers: The existing system proved ill-prepared for the sudden rise in demand.
items.notes: system 作主语；be ill-prepared for 是自然搭配。
tags: 中式英语：无主句与逻辑转换

items.zh: 委员会获得了评估该计划所需的全部许可。
items.en: The committee obtained all the permission needed to evaluate the scheme.
answers: The committee obtained all the permission needed to evaluate the scheme.
items.notes: permission 通常不可数；needed 后置限定具体许可范围。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 我们没有足够的工作人员逐一核实每项资料。
items.en: We do not have enough staff to verify every piece of information individually.
answers: We do not have enough staff to verify every piece of information individually.
items.notes: staff 可作集合名词；information 用 piece 计数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 新设备占用的空间比旧设备少，却需要更多电力。
items.en: The new equipment takes up less space than the old machinery but requires more electricity.
answers: The new equipment takes up less space than the old machinery but requires more electricity.
items.notes: equipment、machinery、space、electricity 在此均不可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 报告提出了一个论点，并用三类证据加以支持。
items.en: The report advances an argument and supports it with three types of evidence.
answers: The report advances an argument and supports it with three types of evidence.
items.notes: argument 可数；evidence 不可数，计数时说 types of evidence。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 参加者得到了一项任务、一些背景资料和两条具体指示。
items.en: Participants received a task, some background material, and two specific instructions.
answers: Participants received a task, some background material, and two specific instructions.
items.notes: material 作资料时可不可数；instruction 指具体指示时可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 这项工程需要专门设备，而不是一台普通机器就能完成。
items.en: The work requires specialist equipment rather than a standard machine.
answers: The work requires specialist equipment rather than a standard machine.
items.notes: equipment 不可数不加 an；machine 是可数具体物件。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 我们掌握的知识有限，但现有事实足以排除一种解释。
items.en: Our knowledge is limited, but the available facts are sufficient to rule out one explanation.
answers: Our knowledge is limited, but the available facts are sufficient to rule out one explanation.
items.notes: knowledge 不可数；fact 和 explanation 可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 该机构发表了一份指导文件，而不是新的法律。
items.en: The agency issued a guidance document rather than a new law.
answers: The agency issued a guidance document rather than a new law.
items.notes: guidance 本身不可数，guidance document 可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 一次良好体验不能代表服务始终可靠。
items.en: One positive experience is not evidence that the service is consistently reliable.
answers: One positive experience is not evidence that the service is consistently reliable.
items.notes: experience 指一次经历时可数；evidence 不可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 我们需要更少的表格和更少的重复信息。
items.en: We need fewer forms and less duplicated information.
answers: We need fewer forms and less duplicated information.
items.notes: fewer 修饰可数 forms，less 修饰不可数 information。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 该项目提供就业，却没有创造足够多的稳定岗位。
items.en: The project provides employment but does not create enough secure jobs.
answers: The project provides employment but does not create enough secure jobs.
items.notes: employment 不可数表示就业；job 可数表示岗位。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 研究人员进行了两项分析，每项都使用了相同的数据集。
items.en: The researchers conducted two analyses, each using the same data set.
answers: The researchers conducted two analyses, each using the same data set.
items.notes: analysis 的复数是 analyses；data set 可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 设备受损的程度不同，因此不是每一件都需要更换。
items.en: The equipment sustained varying degrees of damage, so not every item needs to be replaced.
answers: The equipment sustained varying degrees of damage, so not every item needs to be replaced.
items.notes: damage 不可数；degree 和 item 用于区分程度及单件设备。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 政策变化带来了一些不确定性，但没有造成普遍混乱。
items.en: The policy change created some uncertainty but did not cause widespread confusion.
answers: The policy change created some uncertainty but did not cause widespread confusion.
items.notes: uncertainty 与 confusion 在此表示状态，通常不可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 委员会听取了专家证词和居民的多项陈述。
items.en: The committee heard expert testimony and several statements from residents.
answers: The committee heard expert testimony and several statements from residents.
items.notes: testimony 常作不可数整体；statement 是可数陈述。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 只有少量研究考察了这类家庭的长期经历。
items.en: Only a small body of research examines the long-term experiences of such households.
answers: Only a small body of research examines the long-term experiences of such households.
items.notes: a body of research 表示一批研究；research 不加复数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 维修产生了大量灰尘，却只造成了很少几次服务中断。
items.en: The repairs produced a great deal of dust but caused only a few service interruptions.
answers: The repairs produced a great deal of dust but caused only a few service interruptions.
items.notes: a great deal of 修饰不可数 dust；a few 修饰可数 interruptions。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 报告包含一项实用建议和若干背景信息。
items.en: The report contains one practical recommendation and some background information.
answers: The report contains one practical recommendation and some background information.
items.notes: recommendation 可数，information 不可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 并非每种交通工具都适合这条狭窄道路。
items.en: Not every form of transport is suitable for the narrow road.
answers: Not every form of transport is suitable for the narrow road.
items.notes: transport 通常不可数；form of transport 可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 调查得到的反馈很有价值，但回复数量太少。
items.en: The feedback from the survey is valuable, but the number of responses is too small.
answers: The feedback from the survey is valuable, but the number of responses is too small.
items.notes: feedback 不可数用 is；number of responses 用 small 而非 little。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 工作人员接受了有关设备使用的培训，并拿到一份操作手册。
items.en: Staff received training in the use of the equipment and were given an operating manual.
answers: Staff received training in the use of the equipment and were given an operating manual.
items.notes: training 不可数；manual 可数需冠词。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 该决定造成的损失不仅是金钱上的，还包括公众信任。
items.en: The loss caused by the decision is not merely financial; it also includes public trust.
answers: The loss caused by the decision is not merely financial; it also includes public trust.
items.notes: loss 此处作为总体损失用单数；trust 不可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 需要多少资金取决于建筑的状况，而不是房间数量。
items.en: The amount of funding required depends on the condition of the building, not the number of rooms.
answers: The amount of funding required depends on the condition of the building, not the number of rooms.
items.notes: amount of 修饰不可数 funding；number of 修饰可数 rooms。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 没有一项单独的统计数据能够概括整个社区的福祉。
items.en: No single statistic can capture the well-being of an entire community.
answers: No single statistic can capture the well-being of an entire community.
items.notes: statistic 指单项统计量可数；well-being 多作不可数。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 该市购置了三件大型设备和大量安全装备。
items.en: The city purchased three large pieces of machinery and a substantial amount of safety equipment.
answers: The city purchased three large pieces of machinery and a substantial amount of safety equipment.
items.notes: machinery 与 equipment 均不可数，分别用 pieces 和 amount 计量。
tags: 冠词可数性与数量精度

items.zh: 委员会“注意到”问题，并不表示它已经“解决”了问题。
items.en: The committee's noting of the problem does not mean that it has addressed it.
answers: The committee's noting of the problem does not mean that it has addressed it.
items.notes: note 表示注意或记录；address 才表示着手处理。

items.zh: 费用是“经济上可承担”，不等于价格“便宜”。
items.en: A service can be affordable without being cheap.
answers: A service can be affordable without being cheap.
items.notes: affordable 取决于支付能力；cheap 只描述价格低且可能带负面色彩。

items.zh: “效率提高”应说明是使用更少时间、资金还是人力。
items.en: A claim of greater efficiency should specify whether less time, money, or labour is required.
answers: A claim of greater efficiency should specify whether less time, money, or labour is required.
items.notes: efficiency 需有投入与产出的明确参照。

items.zh: 该地区人口“减少”，不能写成它已经“消失”。
items.en: The population of the area has declined; it has not disappeared.
answers: The population of the area has declined; it has not disappeared.
items.notes: decline 表示下降，disappear 表示完全不复存在，程度不同。

items.zh: 政策可能“影响”选择，却未必“决定”选择。
items.en: A policy may influence a choice without determining it.
answers: A policy may influence a choice without determining it.
items.notes: influence 表示部分作用，determine 暗示决定性作用。

items.zh: “经典”设计强调历久不衰的吸引力，“传统”设计强调沿袭习惯。
items.en: A classic design has lasting appeal, whereas a traditional design follows an established custom.
answers: A classic design has lasting appeal, whereas a traditional design follows an established custom.
items.notes: classic 与 traditional 的评价角度不同。

items.zh: 报告“估计”人数，而不是在没有不确定性的情况下“确定”人数。
items.en: The report estimates the number; it does not establish it with certainty.
answers: The report estimates the number; it does not establish it with certainty.
items.notes: estimate 保留不确定性，establish with certainty 表示确证。

items.zh: 一次政策变化可能“引起”反应，却不能自动“迫使”所有人采取同一行动。
items.en: A policy change may prompt a response, but it does not necessarily compel everyone to act in the same way.
answers: A policy change may prompt a response, but it does not necessarily compel everyone to act in the same way.
items.notes: prompt 与 compel 的强制程度不同。

items.zh: 该系统是“复杂的”，并不一定是“难用的”。
items.en: A system may be complex without being difficult to use.
answers: A system may be complex without being difficult to use.
items.notes: complex 描述组成或关系多，difficult to use 描述用户体验。

items.zh: “持续”增长强调没有中断，“稳定”增长强调速度变化不大。
items.en: Continuous growth has no interruption, whereas steady growth proceeds at a fairly even rate.
answers: Continuous growth has no interruption, whereas steady growth proceeds at a fairly even rate.
items.notes: continuous 与 steady 描述趋势的不同性质。

items.zh: 居民“质疑”决定，不表示他们完全“拒绝”决定。
items.en: Residents may question a decision without rejecting it outright.
answers: Residents may question a decision without rejecting it outright.
items.notes: question 表示要求解释或怀疑；reject 表示不接受。

items.zh: 一个结果可以“显著”，却未必“重要”。
items.en: A result can be statistically significant without being practically important.
answers: A result can be statistically significant without being practically important.
items.notes: significant 在统计语境和日常语境含义不同。

items.zh: “替代”旧服务意味着取而代之，“补充”则意味着两者并存。
items.en: Replacing an existing service removes it, whereas supplementing the service adds to what is already available.
answers: Replacing an existing service removes it, whereas supplementing the service adds to what is already available.
items.notes: replace 与 supplement 的结果相反。

items.zh: 材料具有“耐久性”，不代表它在所有条件下都“可靠”。
items.en: A durable material is not necessarily reliable under every operating condition.
answers: A durable material is not necessarily reliable under every operating condition.
items.notes: durable 强调耐用，reliable 强调稳定达到预期功能。

items.zh: 机构可以“修订”指南，而不是每次改一个词都说“改革”指南。
items.en: An agency revises guidance when it makes textual changes; it does not reform it whenever one word is altered.
answers: An agency revises guidance when it makes textual changes; it does not reform it whenever one word is altered.
items.notes: revise 适合文本修改，reform 适合制度性变革。

items.zh: “敏感”数据需要保护，“明智”决定则体现良好判断。
items.en: Sensitive data require protection, whereas a sensible decision reflects sound judgement.
answers: Sensitive data require protection, whereas a sensible decision reflects sound judgement.
items.notes: sensitive 与 sensible 是常见形近词，含义不同。

items.zh: “实际”成本指真实发生的成本，“实用”方案指容易实施的方案。
items.en: Actual costs are costs that were incurred, whereas a practical solution is one that can be implemented readily.
answers: Actual costs are costs that were incurred, whereas a practical solution is one that can be implemented readily.
items.notes: actual 与 practical 不可因中文都含“实际”而混用。

items.zh: 服务“可获得”不代表每个人都“负担得起”。
items.en: A service may be available without being affordable to everyone.
answers: A service may be available without being affordable to everyone.
items.notes: available 描述供应，affordable 描述支付能力。

items.zh: 证据可以“暗示”一种解释，却未必“证明”它。
items.en: Evidence may imply an explanation without proving it.
answers: Evidence may imply an explanation without proving it.
items.notes: imply 强度低于 prove，写作时需匹配证据。

items.zh: “保留”记录意味着继续保存，“保存”文件也可能只是防止丢失。
items.en: Retaining a record means continuing to hold it, while saving a file may simply prevent its loss.
answers: Retaining a record means continuing to hold it, while saving a file may simply prevent its loss.
items.notes: retain 与 save 在数据治理语境中的功能不同。

items.zh: “监管”市场不是由政府亲自“经营”市场。
items.en: Regulating a market is different from operating it directly.
answers: Regulating a market is different from operating it directly.
items.notes: regulate 制定并执行规则，operate 表示直接运营。

items.zh: “减少风险”不等于“消除风险”。
items.en: Reducing a risk is not the same as eliminating it.
answers: Reducing a risk is not the same as eliminating it.
items.notes: reduce 表示程度降低，eliminate 表示降至不存在。

items.zh: “有争议的”决定引发争议，“爱争论的”人则喜欢争辩。
items.en: A controversial decision causes disagreement, whereas an argumentative person is inclined to dispute things.
answers: A controversial decision causes disagreement, whereas an argumentative person is inclined to dispute things.
items.notes: controversial 与 argumentative 的修饰对象和含义不同。

items.zh: 报告可以“引用”研究，也可以“引证”数据来支持具体观点。
items.en: A report may cite a study and use data from it to substantiate a particular claim.
answers: A report may cite a study and use data from it to substantiate a particular claim.
items.notes: cite 表示注明来源，substantiate 表示用证据支持。

items.zh: “公平”程序强调规则公正，“相等”结果强调数量一致。
items.en: A fair process follows just rules, whereas an equal outcome gives the same amount to each party.
answers: A fair process follows just rules, whereas an equal outcome gives the same amount to each party.
items.notes: fair 与 equal 评价维度不同。

items.zh: 有人认为城市应限制私家车，而另一些人更支持改善公共交通。本文将论证两种措施需要同时推进。
items.en: Some argue that cities should restrict private cars, while others favour better public transport; this essay argues that both measures are necessary.
answers: Some argue that cities should restrict private cars, while others favour better public transport; this essay argues that both measures are necessary.
items.notes: 引言呈现争议并给出明确立场，不用空泛的 this is controversial。

items.zh: 远程办公是否改善生活质量，取决于自主性增加能否抵消社交隔离。
items.en: Whether remote working improves quality of life depends on whether greater autonomy outweighs social isolation.
answers: Whether remote working improves quality of life depends on whether greater autonomy outweighs social isolation.
items.notes: 两个 whether 从句构成问题和判断标准。

items.zh: 关于大学教育应由谁付费的争论，实质上涉及个人收益与公共收益的分配。
items.en: The debate over who should fund university education concerns the distribution of private and public benefits.
answers: The debate over who should fund university education concerns the distribution of private and public benefits.
items.notes: who 从句嵌入 debate over；直接界定核心矛盾。

items.zh: 本文认为，惩罚可以约束浪费，但基础设施和价格机制更能带来持久改变。
items.en: This essay argues that penalties can discourage waste, but infrastructure and pricing are more likely to produce lasting change.
answers: This essay argues that penalties can discourage waste, but infrastructure and pricing are more likely to produce lasting change.
items.notes: 立场句同时承认有限作用并提出主次判断。

items.zh: 人口老龄化常被描述为负担，然而寿命延长也是公共健康进步的结果。
items.en: Population ageing is often described as a burden, yet longer lives are also an outcome of improved public health.
answers: Population ageing is often described as a burden, yet longer lives are also an outcome of improved public health.
items.notes: 用 yet 在引言中重构问题，避免单面设题。

items.zh: 学校是否应教授理财，不应只看课程表是否拥挤，还应看错误决定的长期代价。
items.en: Whether schools should teach financial literacy should be judged not only by timetable pressure but also by the long-term cost of poor decisions.
answers: Whether schools should teach financial literacy should be judged not only by timetable pressure but also by the long-term cost of poor decisions.
items.notes: not only ... but also 给出两个评价维度。

items.zh: 虽然旅游业创造就业，本文认为其发展速度必须与当地住房和环境承载力相适应。
items.en: Although tourism creates jobs, this essay argues that its growth must be matched to local housing and environmental capacity.
answers: Although tourism creates jobs, this essay argues that its growth must be matched to local housing and environmental capacity.
items.notes: 让步开头后给出受条件限制的立场。

items.zh: 讨论人工智能取代工作之前，有必要区分任务自动化与整个职业消失。
items.en: Before discussing whether artificial intelligence will replace jobs, it is necessary to distinguish automated tasks from disappearing occupations.
answers: Before discussing whether artificial intelligence will replace jobs, it is necessary to distinguish automated tasks from disappearing occupations.
items.notes: 先界定概念，避免把任务与职业混为一谈。

items.zh: 提高退休年龄看似能缓解财政压力，但统一年龄忽略了职业和健康差异。
items.en: Raising the retirement age may ease fiscal pressure, but a uniform threshold overlooks differences in occupation and health.
answers: Raising the retirement age may ease fiscal pressure, but a uniform threshold overlooks differences in occupation and health.
items.notes: 引言用具体反面限制表明立场方向。

items.zh: 本文不主张完全禁止广告，而主张对针对儿童的内容实施更严格限制。
items.en: This essay does not advocate a total ban on advertising; it supports tighter restrictions on content aimed at children.
answers: This essay does not advocate a total ban on advertising; it supports tighter restrictions on content aimed at children.
items.notes: 用分号和对照立场避免假二选一。

items.zh: 在家学习能否替代课堂，不能脱离学生年龄、家庭环境和课程类型来回答。
items.en: Whether home learning can replace the classroom cannot be answered without considering students' ages, home environments, and the subjects involved.
answers: Whether home learning can replace the classroom cannot be answered without considering students' ages, home environments, and the subjects involved.
items.notes: 立场强调条件差异，而非简单同意或反对。

items.zh: 经济增长仍然重要，但将其作为唯一进步指标会忽略健康、时间和环境质量。
items.en: Economic growth remains important, but treating it as the sole measure of progress neglects health, time, and environmental quality.
answers: Economic growth remains important, but treating it as the sole measure of progress neglects health, time, and environmental quality.
items.notes: 承认价值后批评唯一指标，立场更精确。

items.zh: 是否资助艺术，关键不在于艺术能否立即盈利，而在于公共价值是否值得共同承担成本。
items.en: The case for funding the arts depends less on immediate profit than on whether their public value justifies shared expenditure.
answers: The case for funding the arts depends less on immediate profit than on whether their public value justifies shared expenditure.
items.notes: less on A than on B 重设评价标准。

items.zh: 本文认为，考试应继续发挥作用，但不应单独决定学生的未来。
items.en: This essay maintains that examinations should retain a role but should not determine a student's future on their own.
answers: This essay maintains that examinations should retain a role but should not determine a student's future on their own.
items.notes: retain a role but not determine 表达有限支持。

items.zh: 城市绿地与住房并非必然冲突，问题在于规划是否允许更高效地使用土地。
items.en: Urban green space and housing are not inherently incompatible; the issue is whether planning enables land to be used more efficiently.
answers: Urban green space and housing are not inherently incompatible; the issue is whether planning enables land to be used more efficiently.
items.notes: 否定假冲突，再用 whether 界定真正问题。

items.zh: 要求企业公开薪酬差距不能自动实现公平，但能使不平等更容易被审查。
items.en: Requiring companies to publish pay gaps cannot create equality by itself, but it can make inequality easier to scrutinise.
answers: Requiring companies to publish pay gaps cannot create equality by itself, but it can make inequality easier to scrutinise.
items.notes: 引言准确界定透明度措施的功能。

items.zh: 与其争论科技本身好坏，本文关注谁能使用科技以及谁承担其风险。
items.en: Rather than judging technology as simply good or bad, this essay examines who can access it and who bears its risks.
answers: Rather than judging technology as simply good or bad, this essay examines who can access it and who bears its risks.
items.notes: rather than 重构二元问题；两个 who 从句说明分析方向。

items.zh: 公共交通免费是否合理，取决于目标是帮助低收入者、减少拥堵，还是惠及所有乘客。
items.en: Whether free public transport is justified depends on whether the aim is to support low-income users, reduce congestion, or benefit all passengers.
answers: Whether free public transport is justified depends on whether the aim is to support low-income users, reduce congestion, or benefit all passengers.
items.notes: 引言先区分政策目标，再评估手段。

items.zh: 新闻平台应对虚假信息承担责任，但责任范围必须考虑编辑控制程度。
items.en: News platforms should bear responsibility for misinformation, although its extent should reflect the degree of editorial control they exercise.
answers: News platforms should bear responsibility for misinformation, although its extent should reflect the degree of editorial control they exercise.
items.notes: although 限定责任强度；reflect the degree of 提供标准。

items.zh: 本文主张优先修复现有住房，因为这通常比拆除重建更快，也更少浪费材料。
items.en: This essay favours repairing existing housing because doing so is usually faster and wastes less material than demolition and rebuilding.
answers: This essay favours repairing existing housing because doing so is usually faster and wastes less material than demolition and rebuilding.
items.notes: because 给出两项可比较理由；doing so 回指维修。

items.zh: 个人健康选择很重要，但这些选择受到收入、工作时间和居住环境的共同塑造。
items.en: Individual health choices matter, but they are shaped jointly by income, working hours, and the local environment.
answers: Individual health choices matter, but they are shaped jointly by income, working hours, and the local environment.
items.notes: 引言将个人责任置于结构条件中。

items.zh: 是否保留历史建筑，应比较文化价值、改造成本和继续使用的可能性。
items.en: Whether a historic building should be retained requires a comparison of cultural value, renovation cost, and the possibility of continued use.
answers: Whether a historic building should be retained requires a comparison of cultural value, renovation cost, and the possibility of continued use.
items.notes: whether 从句作主语并给出三项评价维度。

items.zh: 本文认为，志愿服务可以补充公共服务，却不应成为政府削减基本保障的理由。
items.en: This essay argues that volunteering can supplement public services but should not justify reducing essential state provision.
answers: This essay argues that volunteering can supplement public services but should not justify reducing essential state provision.
items.notes: supplement 而非 replace；立场划定志愿服务边界。

items.zh: 大型活动带来的声望难以量化，因此评估必须同时考虑可测收益和机会成本。
items.en: The prestige associated with major events is difficult to quantify, so evaluations must consider both measurable benefits and opportunity costs.
answers: The prestige associated with major events is difficult to quantify, so evaluations must consider both measurable benefits and opportunity costs.
items.notes: so 引出方法结论；both ... and 平衡收益与代价。

items.zh: 与其问网络教育是否更好，不如问它对哪些学习者、哪些课程和哪些目标更有效。
items.en: Instead of asking whether online education is better, we should ask for which learners, subjects, and purposes it is more effective.
answers: Instead of asking whether online education is better, we should ask for which learners, subjects, and purposes it is more effective.
items.notes: 把绝对问题改为条件化问题，形成清晰论文路线。

items.zh: 改善公交可靠性能够扩大就业机会，因为求职者可以考虑更远的工作地点。
items.en: More reliable public transport can widen access to employment because jobseekers are able to consider vacancies farther from home.
answers: More reliable public transport can widen access to employment because jobseekers are able to consider vacancies farther from home.
items.notes: 主题句给出主张，because 从句解释作用机制。

items.zh: 这一好处对轮班工作者尤其重要，因为他们的通勤时间往往不在普通公交时段内。
items.en: This benefit is particularly important for shift workers, whose journeys often fall outside standard service hours.
answers: This benefit is particularly important for shift workers, whose journeys often fall outside standard service hours.
items.notes: this benefit 承接前文，whose 从句提供具体支撑。

items.zh: 然而，增加班次只有在路线连接主要就业区时才会产生上述效果。
items.en: However, additional services will have this effect only if their routes connect residential areas with major employment centres.
answers: However, additional services will have this effect only if their routes connect residential areas with major employment centres.
items.notes: however 引入限制；only if 说明效果成立的条件。

items.zh: 因此，评估交通投资不能只计算乘客人数，还应考察新增就业可达性。
items.en: Transport investment should therefore be assessed not only by passenger numbers but also by the additional jobs made accessible.
answers: Transport investment should therefore be assessed not only by passenger numbers but also by the additional jobs made accessible.
items.notes: therefore 汇总机制；not only ... but also 扩展评价指标。

items.zh: 较短的住院时间可以降低成本，但前提是患者不会因此更频繁地再次入院。
items.en: Shorter hospital stays can reduce costs, provided that they do not lead to more frequent readmission.
answers: Shorter hospital stays can reduce costs, provided that they do not lead to more frequent readmission.
items.notes: 主体句包含条件，防止把成本下降写成无条件收益。

items.zh: 如果出院只是把护理工作转给家属，公共支出的下降就会掩盖私人负担。
items.en: If discharge merely transfers care to relatives, lower public expenditure will conceal a greater private burden.
answers: If discharge merely transfers care to relatives, lower public expenditure will conceal a greater private burden.
items.notes: 条件句说明成本转移机制。

items.zh: 例如，需要全天照护的人可能迫使一名家庭成员减少工作时间。
items.en: For example, a person requiring full-time care may force a relative to reduce paid working hours.
answers: For example, a person requiring full-time care may force a relative to reduce paid working hours.
items.notes: 例子将抽象私人负担具体化为收入损失。

items.zh: 因此，完整评估应把康复结果和无偿照护时间纳入成本计算。
items.en: A complete evaluation should therefore include recovery outcomes and unpaid caring time in its calculation of cost.
answers: A complete evaluation should therefore include recovery outcomes and unpaid caring time in its calculation of cost.
items.notes: therefore 从前述分析推导更全面的评价方法。

items.zh: 在学校提供免费午餐可以改善注意力，因为饥饿会干扰课堂学习。
items.en: Providing free school meals can improve concentration because hunger interferes with learning in class.
answers: Providing free school meals can improve concentration because hunger interferes with learning in class.
items.notes: 主题句将措施、结果和机制连接起来。

items.zh: 这一政策还可能减少家庭之间可见的差异，尤其是所有学生吃同样午餐时。
items.en: The policy may also reduce visible differences between households, particularly when every pupil receives the same meal.
answers: The policy may also reduce visible differences between households, particularly when every pupil receives the same meal.
items.notes: also 增加第二条机制；when 限定情境。

items.zh: 不过，统一菜单若不适应健康和文化需求，也会排除部分儿童。
items.en: A standard menu may, however, exclude some children if it fails to accommodate medical and cultural requirements.
answers: A standard menu may, however, exclude some children if it fails to accommodate medical and cultural requirements.
items.notes: however 和 if 引出政策设计限制。

items.zh: 由此可见，普遍提供服务仍需要灵活的个别安排。
items.en: Universal provision therefore still requires flexible arrangements for individual needs.
answers: Universal provision therefore still requires flexible arrangements for individual needs.
items.notes: therefore 概括普遍性与灵活性的结合。

items.zh: 远程办公可以减少通勤排放，但总环境收益取决于家庭能源使用。
items.en: Remote working can reduce commuting emissions, but its overall environmental benefit depends on household energy use.
answers: Remote working can reduce commuting emissions, but its overall environmental benefit depends on household energy use.
items.notes: 主题句先给收益，再提出决定净效果的变量。

items.zh: 如果每名员工在冬天单独供暖，办公室节省的能源可能只是转移到了住宅。
items.en: If every employee heats a separate home in winter, energy saved in the office may simply be shifted to residences.
