answers: If every employee heats a separate home in winter, energy saved in the office may simply be shifted to residences.
items.notes: 条件例子具体说明排放转移。

items.zh: 共享工作空间能够缓解这一问题，同时保留较短的通勤距离。
items.en: Shared workspaces can mitigate this problem while preserving shorter journeys.
answers: Shared workspaces can mitigate this problem while preserving shorter journeys.
items.notes: mitigate this problem 承接前句；while doing 说明双重效果。

items.zh: 所以，比较办公模式时需要使用总能耗，而不是只看办公楼账单。
items.en: Comparisons between working patterns should therefore use total energy consumption rather than office bills alone.
answers: Comparisons between working patterns should therefore use total energy consumption rather than office bills alone.
items.notes: so/therefore 形成可执行评价结论。

items.zh: 严格的建筑标准能防止低质量住房在市场上长期存在。
items.en: Strict building standards can prevent poor-quality housing from remaining in use for decades.
answers: Strict building standards can prevent poor-quality housing from remaining in use for decades.
items.notes: 主题句提出监管的长期保护作用。

items.zh: 开发商在开工前知道要求，也更容易把合规成本纳入预算。
items.en: Developers who know the requirements before construction can also incorporate compliance costs into their budgets.
answers: Developers who know the requirements before construction can also incorporate compliance costs into their budgets.
items.notes: who 从句限定了解规则者；also 补充可预见性收益。

items.zh: 但标准频繁变化会增加不确定性，尤其影响资金较少的小型项目。
items.en: Frequent changes to standards can create uncertainty, especially for small projects with limited finance.
answers: Frequent changes to standards can create uncertainty, especially for small projects with limited finance.
items.notes: but 转向执行成本，并识别受影响群体。

items.zh: 稳定而定期的更新周期比突然修改更能兼顾质量与可预见性。
items.en: A stable cycle of periodic revision can therefore balance quality and predictability better than abrupt change.
answers: A stable cycle of periodic revision can therefore balance quality and predictability better than abrupt change.
items.notes: therefore 综合前述正反因素提出设计原则。

items.zh: 公共数据能够帮助研究者发现单个机构看不到的区域模式。
items.en: Public data can help researchers identify regional patterns that no single organisation can observe.
answers: Public data can help researchers identify regional patterns that no single organisation can observe.
items.notes: 主题句说明数据开放的知识收益。

items.zh: 不同团队还能复核计算，从而更早发现错误。
items.en: Independent teams can also check the calculations, allowing errors to be detected earlier.
answers: Independent teams can also check the calculations, allowing errors to be detected earlier.
items.notes: also 添加审查机制；allowing 表示结果。

items.zh: 然而，删除姓名并不总能防止小群体中的个人被识别。
items.en: Removing names, however, does not always prevent individuals in small groups from being identified.
answers: Removing names, however, does not always prevent individuals in small groups from being identified.
items.notes: however 引出隐私限制；prevent A from being done。

items.zh: 因此，开放程度应随重新识别风险而变化，而不是对所有数据采用同一规则。
items.en: The level of access should therefore vary with the risk of re-identification rather than follow one rule for every data set.
answers: The level of access should therefore vary with the risk of re-identification rather than follow one rule for every data set.
items.notes: therefore 给出风险分级结论；rather than 对照统一规则。

items.zh: 一个有说服力的主体段应当让例子检验主张的边界，而不只是把主张换句话重复。
items.en: A persuasive body paragraph uses examples to test the limits of its claim rather than merely restating it.
answers: A persuasive body paragraph uses examples to test the limits of its claim rather than merely restating it.
items.notes: 元写作句强调例子的论证功能，避免同义反复。

items.zh: 房价上涨不仅源于需求增加，也与可建设土地的供应受限有关。
items.en: Rising house prices reflect not only stronger demand but also a constrained supply of developable land.
answers: Rising house prices reflect not only stronger demand but also a constrained supply of developable land.
items.notes: not only ... but also 呈现需求和供给两侧原因。

items.zh: 低回复率可能是问卷太长造成的，也可能是邀请邮件没有获得信任。
items.en: The low response rate may result from the length of the questionnaire or from a lack of trust in the invitation email.
answers: The low response rate may result from the length of the questionnaire or from a lack of trust in the invitation email.
items.notes: result from 两端保持平行；may 避免把可能原因写成事实。

items.zh: 由于市中心岗位集中，外围居民即使居住成本较低，也承担更长通勤。
items.en: The concentration of jobs in the city centre gives peripheral residents longer commutes even when their housing costs are lower.
answers: The concentration of jobs in the city centre gives peripheral residents longer commutes even when their housing costs are lower.
items.notes: 名词化原因作主语；even when 引入反差条件。

items.zh: 频繁更换短期合同会降低员工投入，因为他们看不到长期发展的回报。
items.en: Repeated short-term contracts can weaken staff commitment because employees see little return from investing in long-term development.
answers: Repeated short-term contracts can weaken staff commitment because employees see little return from investing in long-term development.
items.notes: because 从员工激励机制解释结果。

items.zh: 道路变宽可能提高车速，从而使行人更难安全过街。
items.en: A wider road may encourage higher speeds, which in turn make it harder for pedestrians to cross safely.
answers: A wider road may encourage higher speeds, which in turn make it harder for pedestrians to cross safely.
items.notes: which in turn 明确中间机制：宽路、车速、过街难度。

items.zh: 投诉突然增加未必说明质量下降，也可能是新的反馈渠道更容易使用。
items.en: A sudden rise in complaints need not indicate poorer quality; it may instead reflect easier access to a new feedback channel.
answers: A sudden rise in complaints need not indicate poorer quality; it may instead reflect easier access to a new feedback channel.
items.notes: need not 与 may instead 提供替代因果解释。

items.zh: 儿童接触自然的机会减少，一部分是因为户外空间缩小，一部分是因为家长担心安全。
items.en: Children have less contact with nature partly because outdoor space has diminished and partly because parents have safety concerns.
answers: Children have less contact with nature partly because outdoor space has diminished and partly because parents have safety concerns.
items.notes: partly because ... and partly because 平衡两个原因。

items.zh: 统一考试会影响课堂内容，因为学校倾向于把时间投入可被测量的技能。
items.en: Standardised tests shape classroom content because schools tend to devote time to skills that can be measured.
answers: Standardised tests shape classroom content because schools tend to devote time to skills that can be measured.
items.notes: because 解释激励机制；devote time to 后接名词。

items.zh: 补贴结束后参与下降，说明价格可能影响了持续使用，但不能排除季节变化。
items.en: Participation fell after the subsidy ended, suggesting that price affected continued use, although a seasonal effect cannot be ruled out.
answers: Participation fell after the subsidy ended, suggesting that price affected continued use, although a seasonal effect cannot be ruled out.
items.notes: suggesting 保留推断性；although 加入竞争解释。

items.zh: 小企业采用新技术较慢，既受资金限制，也受缺少内部技术支持影响。
items.en: Small firms adopt new technology more slowly because of both financial constraints and limited technical support within the firm.
answers: Small firms adopt new technology more slowly because of both financial constraints and limited technical support within the firm.
items.notes: because of both A and B 保持名词结构平行。

items.zh: 延误之所以扩大，是因为最初的故障使后续检查都被推迟。
items.en: The delay grew because the initial failure pushed back every subsequent inspection.
answers: The delay grew because the initial failure pushed back every subsequent inspection.
items.notes: 说明延误如何沿流程传播，而非只重复“发生延误”。

items.zh: 空气质量改善可能来自工厂排放下降，也可能来自风向暂时改变。
items.en: Better air quality may arise from lower industrial emissions or from a temporary change in wind direction.
answers: Better air quality may arise from lower industrial emissions or from a temporary change in wind direction.
items.notes: arise from 两种解释平行，保留气象混杂因素。

items.zh: 当工作人员必须在多个系统重复录入数据时，错误既增加，处理速度也下降。
items.en: When staff must enter the same data into several systems, errors increase and processing slows.
answers: When staff must enter the same data into several systems, errors increase and processing slows.
items.notes: when 从句给出共同原因，主句列出两个不同结果。

items.zh: 免费入场提高了参观人数，却因现场拥挤缩短了平均停留时间。
items.en: Free admission increased attendance but shortened the average visit by making the venue more crowded.
answers: Free admission increased attendance but shortened the average visit by making the venue more crowded.
items.notes: by doing 解释第二个结果的机制。

items.zh: 健康差距会代际延续，因为童年环境影响教育、收入和成年健康。
items.en: Health inequalities can persist across generations because childhood conditions affect education, income, and health in adulthood.
answers: Health inequalities can persist across generations because childhood conditions affect education, income, and health in adulthood.
items.notes: because 展开跨代影响链条。

items.zh: 在高峰时段提高票价可能分散需求，也可能只是增加无法改期者的成本。
items.en: Higher peak fares may spread demand, or they may simply increase costs for travellers who cannot change their journey time.
answers: Higher peak fares may spread demand, or they may simply increase costs for travellers who cannot change their journey time.
items.notes: or 并列预期机制和分配性替代结果。

items.zh: 参与人数多并不必然提高讨论质量，因为大群体中的发言机会可能更不均等。
items.en: A larger number of participants does not necessarily improve discussion because speaking opportunities may be distributed less evenly in a bigger group.
answers: A larger number of participants does not necessarily improve discussion because speaking opportunities may be distributed less evenly in a bigger group.
items.notes: because 解释规模为何可能不转化为质量。

items.zh: 管理层频繁改变目标会削弱问责，因为结果可以事后用新标准解释。
items.en: Frequent changes to targets weaken accountability because results can be reinterpreted against a new standard after the event.
answers: Frequent changes to targets weaken accountability because results can be reinterpreted against a new standard after the event.
items.notes: because 指出目标漂移如何妨碍问责。

items.zh: 线上预约减少了电话等待，却把负担转移给数字技能较弱的人。
items.en: Online booking reduces telephone queues but shifts the burden to people with weaker digital skills.
answers: Online booking reduces telephone queues but shifts the burden to people with weaker digital skills.
items.notes: but 说明问题不是消失而是渠道间转移。

items.zh: 受保护的自行车道能增加骑行，因为它降低了新手对交通风险的感知。
items.en: Protected cycle lanes can increase cycling by reducing the traffic risk perceived by inexperienced riders.
answers: Protected cycle lanes can increase cycling by reducing the traffic risk perceived by inexperienced riders.
items.notes: by reducing 说明设施影响行为的中介机制。

items.zh: 低工资会导致人员流动，而人员流动又会增加培训成本并损害服务连续性。
items.en: Low pay can cause staff turnover, which then raises training costs and disrupts continuity of service.
answers: Low pay can cause staff turnover, which then raises training costs and disrupts continuity of service.
items.notes: which then 清楚呈现连续因果链。

items.zh: 信息过多也会降低透明度，因为读者可能找不到与决定直接相关的内容。
items.en: Excessive information can reduce transparency because readers may be unable to locate what is directly relevant to a decision.
answers: Excessive information can reduce transparency because readers may be unable to locate what is directly relevant to a decision.
items.notes: 解释数量增加为何反而妨碍透明。

items.zh: 医院就诊量增加既可能反映疾病更多，也可能说明基层服务减少。
items.en: Higher hospital attendance may reflect greater illness, but it may also indicate reduced access to primary care.
answers: Higher hospital attendance may reflect greater illness, but it may also indicate reduced access to primary care.
items.notes: 同一指标对应需求增加或替代服务减少两种机制。

items.zh: 夜间照明会提高安全感，却可能通过干扰睡眠损害居民健康。
items.en: Night-time lighting may improve perceptions of safety while harming residents' health through sleep disruption.
answers: Night-time lighting may improve perceptions of safety while harming residents' health through sleep disruption.
items.notes: while 对照两种结果；through 表示健康影响路径。

items.zh: 准确的因果段落不仅指出两个现象同时发生，还要说明一个现象如何改变另一个。
items.en: An accurate causal paragraph does more than show that two events coincide; it explains how one could alter the other.
answers: An accurate causal paragraph does more than show that two events coincide; it explains how one could alter the other.
items.notes: 元写作句区分相关描述与机制解释。

items.zh: 解决预约爽约不能只靠罚款，还应让取消和改期更容易。
items.en: Reducing missed appointments requires more than penalties; cancellation and rescheduling must also be made easier.
answers: Reducing missed appointments requires more than penalties; cancellation and rescheduling must also be made easier.
items.notes: more than 引出组合方案；被动语态突出流程设计。

items.zh: 增加住房供应需要时间，因此短期租金援助仍有必要。
items.en: Expanding housing supply takes time, so short-term rental assistance remains necessary.
answers: Expanding housing supply takes time, so short-term rental assistance remains necessary.
items.notes: so 连接长期供给方案与短期缓冲措施。

items.zh: 如果目标是减少食物浪费，较小包装必须比大包装按单位价格更有吸引力。
items.en: If the aim is to reduce food waste, smaller packs must be priced attractively relative to larger ones.
answers: If the aim is to reduce food waste, smaller packs must be priced attractively relative to larger ones.
items.notes: if 明确方案目标；relative to 提供消费者选择基准。

items.zh: 培训可以改善规则执行，但前提是主管人员也按相同标准作出判断。
items.en: Training can improve enforcement, provided that supervisors apply the same standard in their decisions.
answers: Training can improve enforcement, provided that supervisors apply the same standard in their decisions.
items.notes: provided that 指出一线培训依赖管理层一致性。

items.zh: 设置服务热线能帮助不会上网的人，却需要在需求最高时安排足够人员。
items.en: A telephone helpline can assist people who are offline, but it requires adequate staffing when demand is highest.
answers: A telephone helpline can assist people who are offline, but it requires adequate staffing when demand is highest.
items.notes: 方案与实施资源约束同句呈现。

items.zh: 试点应先覆盖需求差异明显的地区，以检验方案是否具有适应性。
items.en: The pilot should include areas with contrasting needs so that the adaptability of the scheme can be tested.
answers: The pilot should include areas with contrasting needs so that the adaptability of the scheme can be tested.
items.notes: so that 说明选点目的；contrasting needs 提高检验价值。

items.zh: 与其统一延长营业时间，不如根据各网点的客流调整时段。
items.en: Rather than extending opening hours uniformly, providers should adjust them to demand at each location.
answers: Rather than extending opening hours uniformly, providers should adjust them to demand at each location.
items.notes: rather than 对照一刀切和按需求配置。

items.zh: 新规应设复审日期，以免临时限制在风险消失后仍继续存在。
items.en: The new rule should include a review date so that a temporary restriction does not outlast the risk it addresses.
answers: The new rule should include a review date so that a temporary restriction does not outlast the risk it addresses.
items.notes: review date 提供退出机制；outlast 表示持续超过风险。

items.zh: 向所有家庭发放同额补贴容易管理，但定向支持能把更多资金给最需要的人。
items.en: A flat payment to every household is simple to administer, whereas targeted support directs more money to those in greatest need.
answers: A flat payment to every household is simple to administer, whereas targeted support directs more money to those in greatest need.
items.notes: whereas 对照行政简便和资源精准。

items.zh: 安装传感器只有在有人负责回应警报时才能提高安全。
items.en: Installing sensors improves safety only if someone is responsible for responding to the alarms.
answers: Installing sensors improves safety only if someone is responsible for responding to the alarms.
items.notes: only if 说明技术工具必须连接响应职责。

items.zh: 学校可以减少作业数量，但应先确认哪些任务真正促进学习。
items.en: Schools could reduce the volume of homework, but they should first identify which tasks genuinely support learning.
answers: Schools could reduce the volume of homework, but they should first identify which tasks genuinely support learning.
items.notes: 方案先评估任务价值，避免按数量机械削减。

items.zh: 针对拥堵的收费应提供豁免，以保护没有可行替代交通的人。
items.en: Congestion charging should include exemptions for people who have no viable transport alternative.
answers: Congestion charging should include exemptions for people who have no viable transport alternative.
items.notes: include exemptions for 确保方案考虑受约束群体。

items.zh: 把申请表变短之前，应检查删去的问题是否用于资格判断。
items.en: Before shortening the application form, officials should check whether the omitted questions determine eligibility.
answers: Before shortening the application form, officials should check whether the omitted questions determine eligibility.
items.notes: before 引出方案实施前的功能审查。

items.zh: 公开等候时间可以促进问责，但还应同时公布病例复杂程度。
items.en: Publishing waiting times can improve accountability, but case complexity should be reported alongside them.
answers: Publishing waiting times can improve accountability, but case complexity should be reported alongside them.
items.notes: alongside 补充公平比较所需背景。

items.zh: 旧建筑可以分阶段改造，让最危险的问题先得到处理。
items.en: An old building can be renovated in stages so that the most serious hazards are addressed first.
answers: An old building can be renovated in stages so that the most serious hazards are addressed first.
items.notes: in stages 与 so that 说明分阶段方案的优先逻辑。

items.zh: 限制一次性用品时，应确保可重复使用的替代品真的会被重复使用。
items.en: When single-use items are restricted, reusable alternatives must actually be used repeatedly.
answers: When single-use items are restricted, reusable alternatives must actually be used repeatedly.
items.notes: 方案成效取决于替代品的真实使用次数。

items.zh: 社区咨询应在设计早期进行，此时意见仍能改变方案。
items.en: Community consultation should occur early in the design process, while feedback can still alter the proposal.
answers: Community consultation should occur early in the design process, while feedback can still alter the proposal.
items.notes: while 表示意见仍具有实际影响的时间窗口。

items.zh: 提高教师数量若没有增加教室空间，未必能缩小实际班级。
items.en: Hiring more teachers may not reduce class size unless additional classroom space is available.
answers: Hiring more teachers may not reduce class size unless additional classroom space is available.
items.notes: unless 指出人员方案所依赖的物理资源。

items.zh: 数据共享协议必须说明谁能访问、用于何种目的以及保存多久。
items.en: A data-sharing agreement must specify who may have access, for what purposes, and for how long.
answers: A data-sharing agreement must specify who may have access, for what purposes, and for how long.
items.notes: 三个并列疑问明确治理方案的核心要素。

items.zh: 减少洪水风险不能只建防洪墙，还要避免在天然蓄洪区继续开发。
items.en: Reducing flood risk requires not only physical defences but also limits on development in natural floodplains.
answers: Reducing flood risk requires not only physical defences but also limits on development in natural floodplains.
items.notes: not only ... but also 组合工程措施与土地管理。

items.zh: 奖励节能行为时，基准必须防止用户因过去浪费更多而获得更大奖励。
items.en: An energy-saving incentive needs a baseline that does not reward users merely for having wasted more in the past.
answers: An energy-saving incentive needs a baseline that does not reward users merely for having wasted more in the past.
items.notes: that 从句说明公平基准要防止的逆向激励。

items.zh: 延长保修期可以促进耐用设计，但必须有方便消费者实际索赔的程序。
items.en: Longer warranties can encourage durable design, but consumers also need a practical process for making claims.
answers: Longer warranties can encourage durable design, but consumers also need a practical process for making claims.
items.notes: 规则权利与可使用的执行渠道缺一不可。

items.zh: 招聘盲审能减少早期偏见，却无法纠正面试阶段的歧视。
items.en: Blind recruitment can reduce bias at the shortlisting stage but cannot address discrimination during interviews.
answers: Blind recruitment can reduce bias at the shortlisting stage but cannot address discrimination during interviews.
items.notes: 准确限定单项措施作用的阶段。

items.zh: 方案的效果应按净结果评估，包括它解决的问题和新产生的问题。
items.en: A solution should be judged by its net effect, including both the problem it reduces and any new difficulties it creates.
answers: A solution should be judged by its net effect, including both the problem it reduces and any new difficulties it creates.
items.notes: both A and B 评估净效果而非单边收益。

items.zh: 最稳健的改革通常包含试点、明确指标以及效果不佳时的调整机制。
items.en: The most robust reforms usually combine a pilot, explicit measures of success, and a mechanism for revision if outcomes are poor.
answers: The most robust reforms usually combine a pilot, explicit measures of success, and a mechanism for revision if outcomes are poor.
items.notes: 列出试验、评价和纠偏三个实施环节。

items.zh: 诚然，修复旧建筑费用很高，但拆除和重建也有环境成本。
items.en: Admittedly, repairing an old building is expensive, but demolition and rebuilding also carry environmental costs.
answers: Admittedly, repairing an old building is expensive, but demolition and rebuilding also carry environmental costs.
items.notes: admittedly 公平承认反方事实，再补充其遗漏成本。

items.zh: 有人说图书馆在网络时代已经过时，这忽略了图书馆提供的空间和支持服务。
items.en: The claim that libraries are obsolete in the internet age overlooks the space and support services they provide.
answers: The claim that libraries are obsolete in the internet age overlooks the space and support services they provide.
items.notes: 先准确概括反方，再指出其定义过窄。

items.zh: 即使多数人能在线办理，也不能据此取消少数人依赖的线下渠道。
items.en: Even if most people can complete the process online, this does not justify removing an offline route on which a minority relies.
answers: Even if most people can complete the process online, this does not justify removing an offline route on which a minority relies.
items.notes: even if 承认多数事实，但拒绝不成比例的政策推论。

items.zh: 较高工资会增加成本，不过人员稳定可能减少招聘和培训支出。
items.en: Higher pay raises immediate costs; however, greater staff retention may reduce spending on recruitment and training.
answers: Higher pay raises immediate costs; however, greater staff retention may reduce spending on recruitment and training.
items.notes: however 引入可抵消的长期成本。

items.zh: 反对者担心自行车道减少停车位，但这一比较没有计算道路空间的其他公共用途。
items.en: Opponents worry that cycle lanes remove parking spaces, but this comparison ignores other public uses of road space.
answers: Opponents worry that cycle lanes remove parking spaces, but this comparison ignores other public uses of road space.
items.notes: 指出反方比较框架遗漏的价值。

items.zh: 考试不完美，并不意味着任何替代评价都更公平。
items.en: The fact that examinations are imperfect does not mean that every alternative assessment is fairer.
answers: The fact that examinations are imperfect does not mean that every alternative assessment is fairer.
items.notes: 反驳从 A 有缺陷跳到 B 必然更好的逻辑。

items.zh: 小班教学不会自动提高成绩，但这不否定教师有更多时间反馈的价值。
items.en: Smaller classes do not automatically raise attainment, but this does not negate the value of giving teachers more time for feedback.
answers: Smaller classes do not automatically raise attainment, but this does not negate the value of giving teachers more time for feedback.
items.notes: 区分结果未保证与机制完全无价值。

items.zh: 经济增长可能增加税收，可若收益集中在少数人手中，公共福祉未必同步上升。
items.en: Economic growth may increase tax revenue, yet public well-being need not rise with it if the gains are narrowly distributed.
answers: Economic growth may increase tax revenue, yet public well-being need not rise with it if the gains are narrowly distributed.
items.notes: yet 和 if 限制从增长到福祉的推论。

items.zh: 统一制服可能减少明显的服装差异，却无法消除更深层的贫困。
items.en: A uniform may reduce visible differences in clothing, although it cannot remove the deeper effects of poverty.
answers: A uniform may reduce visible differences in clothing, although it cannot remove the deeper effects of poverty.
items.notes: 承认有限效果并划定不能解决的范围。

items.zh: 有人担心严格环保标准会阻碍创新，但明确的长期规则也能引导投资。
items.en: Strict environmental standards may be said to hinder innovation, but clear long-term rules can also direct investment towards it.
answers: Strict environmental standards may be said to hinder innovation, but clear long-term rules can also direct investment towards it.
items.notes: 回应反方时提出规则稳定带来的相反激励。

items.zh: 匿名发言能保护弱势员工，但也会让具体指控更难核实。
items.en: Anonymous reporting can protect vulnerable employees, while making specific allegations harder to verify.
answers: Anonymous reporting can protect vulnerable employees, while making specific allegations harder to verify.
items.notes: while doing 公平呈现保护与核实之间的张力。

items.zh: 免费大学教育惠及所有学生，但高收入家庭也因此获得大量补贴。
items.en: Free university tuition benefits all students, but it also gives substantial support to high-income households.
answers: Free university tuition benefits all students, but it also gives substantial support to high-income households.
items.notes: 指出普遍政策的分配性反论点。

items.zh: 技术提高效率的说法可能成立，但前提是把维护和培训时间也计入。
items.en: The claim that technology improves efficiency may be valid, provided that maintenance and training time are included.
answers: The claim that technology improves efficiency may be valid, provided that maintenance and training time are included.
items.notes: provided that 将同意限定在完整计算条件下。

items.zh: 反方指出数据公开会威胁隐私；这个担忧支持分级访问，而不是完全保密。
items.en: Concerns about privacy support tiered access to data rather than complete secrecy.
answers: Concerns about privacy support tiered access to data rather than complete secrecy.
items.notes: 承认问题后提出程度相称的回应。

items.zh: 惩罚确实能表达社会谴责，却未必能改变缺少替代选择者的行为。
items.en: Punishment can express social disapproval, but it may not change the behaviour of people who lack alternatives.
answers: Punishment can express social disapproval, but it may not change the behaviour of people who lack alternatives.
items.notes: 区分象征功能与行为改变效果。

items.zh: 有人认为市场会淘汰低质量服务，但消费者往往无法在购买前判断质量。
items.en: Markets may be expected to remove poor services, yet consumers often cannot assess quality before purchase.
answers: Markets may be expected to remove poor services, yet consumers often cannot assess quality before purchase.
items.notes: 用信息不对称回应市场自我纠正观点。

items.zh: 高密度居住可能减少私人空间，不过合理设计可以增加共享空间作为补偿。
items.en: High-density housing may reduce private space, but thoughtful design can compensate by providing more shared space.
answers: High-density housing may reduce private space, but thoughtful design can compensate by providing more shared space.
items.notes: 承认代价并提出设计层面的缓解机制。

items.zh: 延长寿命会增加养老支出，但健康寿命延长也能让人工作和独立生活更久。
items.en: Longer lives may increase pension costs, but longer healthy lives can also extend employment and independence.
answers: Longer lives may increase pension costs, but longer healthy lives can also extend employment and independence.
items.notes: 区分总寿命与健康寿命，修正单一成本论。

items.zh: 本地采购价格可能更高，可它能降低运输风险并保留地方技能。
items.en: Local purchasing may cost more, yet it can reduce transport risk and preserve skills within the community.
answers: Local purchasing may cost more, yet it can reduce transport risk and preserve skills within the community.
items.notes: 将价格反论点与韧性和技能收益比较。

items.zh: 公共艺术很难用门票收入衡量，但这并不意味着它没有公共价值。
items.en: Public art is difficult to assess through ticket revenue, but this does not imply that it lacks public value.
answers: Public art is difficult to assess through ticket revenue, but this does not imply that it lacks public value.
items.notes: 反驳不可量化等于无价值。

items.zh: 更详细的规则可以提高一致性，却可能让处理异常情况变得更僵化。
items.en: More detailed rules can improve consistency, although they may make exceptional cases harder to handle flexibly.
answers: More detailed rules can improve consistency, although they may make exceptional cases harder to handle flexibly.
items.notes: 同一制度目标下呈现规则细化的代价。

items.zh: 消费者也负有责任，但这不能免除企业提供准确信息的义务。
items.en: Consumers bear some responsibility, but that does not release companies from their duty to provide accurate information.
answers: Consumers bear some responsibility, but that does not release companies from their duty to provide accurate information.
items.notes: 承认个人责任不等于取消机构义务。

items.zh: 私人投资可以加快建设，不过合同必须防止公共利益被短期利润取代。
items.en: Private investment can accelerate construction, but contracts must prevent short-term profit from displacing the public interest.
answers: Private investment can accelerate construction, but contracts must prevent short-term profit from displacing the public interest.
items.notes: 承认速度收益并提出治理保障。

items.zh: 农村服务单位成本较高，但单看成本会忽略基本服务的地域公平。
items.en: Rural services have a higher cost per user, but cost alone overlooks geographical equity in access to essential services.
answers: Rural services have a higher cost per user, but cost alone overlooks geographical equity in access to essential services.
items.notes: 指出效率指标遗漏的公平目标。

items.zh: 有效反驳不是否认反方所有事实，而是说明这些事实为何不足以支持其结论。
items.en: An effective rebuttal does not deny every opposing fact; it explains why those facts are insufficient to support the opposing conclusion.
answers: An effective rebuttal does not deny every opposing fact; it explains why those facts are insufficient to support the opposing conclusion.
items.notes: 元写作句区分反驳事实和反驳推论。

items.zh: 第一项改革降低了申请门槛。第二项改革则针对获批后的支持不足。
items.en: The first reform lowered the barrier to application. The second, by contrast, addressed inadequate support after approval.
answers: The first reform lowered the barrier to application. The second, by contrast, addressed inadequate support after approval.
items.notes: the second 清楚承接列举；by contrast 说明功能不同。

items.zh: 报告先确定问题集中在周末。基于这一发现，团队调整了排班，而没有增加总工时。
items.en: The report first established that the problem was concentrated at weekends. On the strength of that finding, the team changed the rota without increasing total hours.
answers: The report first established that the problem was concentrated at weekends. On the strength of that finding, the team changed the rota without increasing total hours.
items.notes: on the strength of that finding 明确后续行动的证据基础。

items.zh: 部分住户无法使用新门户。更具体地说，屏幕阅读器无法识别提交按钮。
items.en: Some residents could not use the new portal. More specifically, screen readers failed to identify the submission button.
answers: Some residents could not use the new portal. More specifically, screen readers failed to identify the submission button.
items.notes: more specifically 从总体问题推进到可诊断的细节。

items.zh: 费用增加只是一个问题。更根本的是，新的续期流程没有提前通知。
items.en: Higher cost is only one concern. More fundamentally, the new renewal process was introduced without prior notice.
answers: Higher cost is only one concern. More fundamentally, the new renewal process was introduced without prior notice.
items.notes: more fundamentally 建立问题重要性层级。

items.zh: 试点按时完成，这说明实施能力较强。但这并不能回答干预是否有效。
items.en: The pilot finished on schedule, which indicates strong delivery capacity. That does not, however, answer whether the intervention was effective.
answers: The pilot finished on schedule, which indicates strong delivery capacity. That does not, however, answer whether the intervention was effective.
items.notes: that 回指实施事实；however 转向不同评价问题。

items.zh: 短期数字有所改善。要判断这种改善是否持久，还需要下一轮数据。
items.en: The short-term figures improved. Determining whether that improvement lasts will require data from the next round.
answers: The short-term figures improved. Determining whether that improvement lasts will require data from the next round.
items.notes: that improvement 承接前句；动名词短语推进到证据需求。

items.zh: 两个方案都能减少排放。它们的区别在于成本由谁承担。
items.en: Both options reduce emissions. Where they differ is in who bears the cost.
answers: Both options reduce emissions. Where they differ is in who bears the cost.
items.notes: where they differ 概括转折点；who 从句说明分配问题。

items.zh: 委员会没有拒绝目标本身。它质疑的是拟议手段与目标是否相称。
items.en: The committee did not reject the goal itself. What it questioned was whether the proposed means were proportionate to that goal.
answers: The committee did not reject the goal itself. What it questioned was whether the proposed means were proportionate to that goal.
items.notes: what 强调结构承接并精确纠正立场。

items.zh: 维修解决了漏水问题。尽管如此，受潮造成的结构损坏仍需处理。
items.en: The repair stopped the leak. Nevertheless, the structural damage caused by damp still requires attention.
answers: The repair stopped the leak. Nevertheless, the structural damage caused by damp still requires attention.
items.notes: nevertheless 表示第一问题解决后仍有后续后果。

items.zh: 样本不包括临时居民。这个限制尤其影响对季节性需求的估计。
items.en: The sample excludes temporary residents. This limitation is particularly relevant to estimates of seasonal demand.
answers: The sample excludes temporary residents. This limitation is particularly relevant to estimates of seasonal demand.
items.notes: this limitation 明确回指抽样遗漏并说明影响对象。

items.zh: 先分析需求，再讨论资金来源。颠倒这一顺序会让可用预算替代实际需要。
items.en: Need should be assessed before funding sources are discussed. Reversing that order risks allowing the available budget to define the problem.
answers: Need should be assessed before funding sources are discussed. Reversing that order risks allowing the available budget to define the problem.
items.notes: that order 回指分析顺序；第二句解释顺序的实质影响。

items.zh: 支持者强调新增岗位。相比之下，批评者关注岗位是否稳定。
items.en: Supporters emphasise the number of new jobs. Critics, by comparison, focus on whether those jobs are secure.
answers: Supporters emphasise the number of new jobs. Critics, by comparison, focus on whether those jobs are secure.
items.notes: those jobs 清晰回指；by comparison 转换评价维度。

items.zh: 道路流量下降了。与此同时，邻近街道的流量上升，说明车辆可能只是改道。
items.en: Traffic fell on the main road. Meanwhile, it rose on neighbouring streets, suggesting that vehicles may simply have changed route.
answers: Traffic fell on the main road. Meanwhile, it rose on neighbouring streets, suggesting that vehicles may simply have changed route.
items.notes: meanwhile 连接同期变化；suggesting 给出谨慎推论。

items.zh: 研究测量了知识，却没有测量行为。后一项遗漏限制了对实际效果的判断。
items.en: The study measured knowledge but not behaviour. The latter omission limits what can be concluded about practical impact.
answers: The study measured knowledge but not behaviour. The latter omission limits what can be concluded about practical impact.
items.notes: the latter omission 回指未测行为，避免模糊的 this。

items.zh: 该政策有两个目标：降低成本和扩大覆盖。下文将分别评估这两个目标。
items.en: The policy has two aims: reducing cost and widening access. Each is assessed separately below.
answers: The policy has two aims: reducing cost and widening access. Each is assessed separately below.
items.notes: each 回指两个目标中的每一个，避免重复列举。

items.zh: 最初方案依赖志愿者。修订版则为协调工作设置了带薪岗位。
items.en: The original plan relied on volunteers. Its revised version instead created a paid coordination role.
answers: The original plan relied on volunteers. Its revised version instead created a paid coordination role.
items.notes: its revised version 清楚连接版本；instead 表示关键改变。

items.zh: 机构公布了平均处理时间。除此之外，还需要分布数据来显示等待最久者的经历。
items.en: The agency published the average processing time. Beyond that, distributional data are needed to show the experience of those waiting longest.
answers: The agency published the average processing time. Beyond that, distributional data are needed to show the experience of those waiting longest.
items.notes: beyond that 从已有信息推进到缺失信息。

items.zh: 价格不是唯一障碍。例如，部分用户即使免费也无法在开放时段到场。
items.en: Price is not the only barrier. For instance, some users cannot attend during opening hours even when the service is free.
answers: Price is not the only barrier. For instance, some users cannot attend during opening hours even when the service is free.
items.notes: for instance 用反例支撑上一句的非唯一性。

items.zh: 调查结果与行政数据一致。这种一致性提高了结论的可信度，但不能消除两者共有的偏差。
items.en: The survey agrees with the administrative data. This consistency strengthens the conclusion but cannot remove biases shared by both sources.
answers: The survey agrees with the administrative data. This consistency strengthens the conclusion but cannot remove biases shared by both sources.
items.notes: this consistency 概括跨来源一致；but 限定其证明力。

items.zh: 方案先在两地试行。随后，根据用户反馈修改了申请步骤。
items.en: The scheme was piloted in two locations. Subsequently, the application steps were revised in response to user feedback.
answers: The scheme was piloted in two locations. Subsequently, the application steps were revised in response to user feedback.
items.notes: subsequently 表示有因果背景的后续步骤，不只是同时。

items.zh: 用户不仅需要初次指导。随着系统更新，他们还需要持续支持。
items.en: Users need more than initial guidance. They also require continuing support as the system changes.
answers: Users need more than initial guidance. They also require continuing support as the system changes.
items.notes: more than 与 also 将一次支持推进到持续支持。

items.zh: 报告详细描述了程序。至于程序是否公平，证据仍然不足。
items.en: The report describes the procedure in detail. As for whether it is fair, the evidence remains insufficient.
answers: The report describes the procedure in detail. As for whether it is fair, the evidence remains insufficient.
items.notes: as for 转换到相关但未解决的评价问题。

items.zh: 第二组得分较高。不过，两组在测试前就存在差异。
items.en: The second group achieved a higher score. It should be noted, however, that the groups already differed before the test.
answers: The second group achieved a higher score. It should be noted, however, that the groups already differed before the test.
items.notes: however 引入基线限制；形式主语结构保持正式语气。

items.zh: 这一段先解释原因，下一段将检验该解释是否符合不同群体的数据。
items.en: This paragraph explains the proposed mechanism; the next tests whether it is consistent with the data for different groups.
answers: This paragraph explains the proposed mechanism; the next tests whether it is consistent with the data for different groups.
items.notes: the next 代替 paragraph；whether 推进到证据检验。

items.zh: 清晰的衔接应说明下一句是在补充、限制、解释还是反驳，而不是只使用复杂连接词。
items.en: Clear cohesion shows whether the next sentence adds, limits, explains, or challenges; it does not depend on elaborate linking words alone.
answers: Clear cohesion shows whether the next sentence adds, limits, explains, or challenges; it does not depend on elaborate linking words alone.
items.notes: 元写作句强调逻辑功能而非连接词堆砌。

items.zh: 虽然总量恢复到原有水平，来源构成却发生了显著变化。
items.en: Although the total returned to its original level, the composition by source changed substantially.
answers: Although the total returned to its original level, the composition by source changed substantially.
items.notes: 区分总量恢复与构成变化，避免只看终点。

items.zh: 甲组的增长主要发生在前两年，乙组则集中在最后一年。
items.en: Most of the growth in Group A occurred during the first two years, whereas growth in Group B was concentrated in the final year.
answers: Most of the growth in Group A occurred during the first two years, whereas growth in Group B was concentrated in the final year.
items.notes: whereas 对照增长发生的时间分布。

items.zh: 该比例在十年间净增五个百分点，中间经历了两次短暂回落。
items.en: The proportion recorded a net increase of five percentage points over the decade, despite two temporary declines.
answers: The proportion recorded a net increase of five percentage points over the decade, despite two temporary declines.
items.notes: percentage points 用于比例差；despite 补充过程波动。

items.zh: 最高值约为最低值的四倍，但两者只相隔三年。
items.en: The peak was approximately four times the lowest value, although the two occurred only three years apart.
answers: The peak was approximately four times the lowest value, although the two occurred only three years apart.
items.notes: four times the value 表示倍数；although 突出时间距离短。

items.zh: 人数增加而人均使用量下降，说明新增用户的使用频率较低。
items.en: User numbers rose while use per person fell, suggesting that new users engaged less frequently.
answers: User numbers rose while use per person fell, suggesting that new users engaged less frequently.
items.notes: while 对照总人数和人均强度；suggesting 为谨慎推论。

items.zh: 北部在期初排名最后，到期末却升至第二。
items.en: The north ranked last at the beginning of the period but had risen to second place by the end.
answers: The north ranked last at the beginning of the period but had risen to second place by the end.
items.notes: rank last 与 rise to second；by the end 表示截止变化。

items.zh: 三类支出合计保持稳定，但教育所占份额持续挤压行政支出。
items.en: Combined spending across the three categories remained stable, but education took a steadily larger share at the expense of administration.
answers: Combined spending across the three categories remained stable, but education took a steadily larger share at the expense of administration.
items.notes: at the expense of 描述构成内一增一减。

items.zh: 女性参与率每年都较高，不过性别差距从十二个百分点缩小到三个。
items.en: Female participation was higher in every year, although the gender gap narrowed from twelve percentage points to three.
answers: Female participation was higher in every year, although the gender gap narrowed from twelve percentage points to three.
items.notes: 同时报告方向稳定和差距缩小。

items.zh: 折线波动很大，因此用起点和终点概括会掩盖中间变化。
items.en: The line fluctuates sharply, so a comparison of its starting and finishing points would conceal the intervening changes.
answers: The line fluctuates sharply, so a comparison of its starting and finishing points would conceal the intervening changes.
items.notes: so 说明为何端点比较不足；intervening 指中间发生的。

items.zh: 该类别在数量上最小，却贡献了总增长的近一半。
items.en: The smallest category accounted for nearly half of the overall increase.
answers: The smallest category accounted for nearly half of the overall increase.
items.notes: account for 表示对总增长的贡献，不等同于最终份额。

items.zh: 平均值变化不大，因为一个地区的上升抵消了另一个地区的下降。
items.en: The average changed little because an increase in one region offset a decline in another.
answers: The average changed little because an increase in one region offset a decline in another.
items.notes: offset 表示方向相反的变化相互抵消。

items.zh: 2024年的估计区间比此前更宽，表明不确定性增加。
items.en: The estimate for 2024 has a wider interval than the earlier estimates, indicating greater uncertainty.
answers: The estimate for 2024 has a wider interval than the earlier estimates, indicating greater uncertainty.
items.notes: wider interval 关联更大不确定性；indicating 保留解释性质。

items.zh: 销售额在促销月翻倍，但次月跌至略低于原有水平。
items.en: Sales doubled during the promotional month but fell slightly below their previous level in the following month.
answers: Sales doubled during the promotional month but fell slightly below their previous level in the following month.
items.notes: 区分短期峰值与促销后的回落。

items.zh: 两项指标直到最后两个季度才开始向相反方向变化。
items.en: The two indicators did not begin to move in opposite directions until the final two quarters.
answers: The two indicators did not begin to move in opposite directions until the final two quarters.
items.notes: not ... until 突出分化开始时间。

items.zh: 尽管样本扩大了一倍，误差范围只小幅缩窄。
items.en: Although the sample doubled in size, the margin of error narrowed only slightly.
answers: Although the sample doubled in size, the margin of error narrowed only slightly.
items.notes: although 对照样本增幅和精度改善幅度。

items.zh: 总数下降是由于小额交易减少，大额交易数量基本不变。
items.en: The overall decline resulted from fewer small transactions, while the number of large transactions was broadly unchanged.
answers: The overall decline resulted from fewer small transactions, while the number of large transactions was broadly unchanged.
items.notes: result from 指明总量变化来源；while 补充另一类稳定。

items.zh: 实际值在上半年低于目标，下半年则一直略高于目标。
items.en: The actual figure remained below target in the first half of the year and slightly above it throughout the second.
answers: The actual figure remained below target in the first half of the year and slightly above it throughout the second.
items.notes: it 回指 target；throughout 表示整个下半年。

items.zh: 柱状图显示不同地区的水平差异，折线图则显示全国随时间的变化。
items.en: The bar chart compares levels across regions, whereas the line chart traces national change over time.
answers: The bar chart compares levels across regions, whereas the line chart traces national change over time.
items.notes: 用 compare 与 trace 区分静态横向和动态纵向图表功能。

items.zh: 最年轻组和最年长组数值相近，中间年龄组明显更高。
items.en: The youngest and oldest groups had similar values, with a noticeably higher figure among the middle age groups.
answers: The youngest and oldest groups had similar values, with a noticeably higher figure among the middle age groups.
items.notes: with 结构补充非线性年龄模式。

items.zh: 图表没有给出样本人数，因此相同的百分比可能代表不同数量的人。
items.en: The chart gives no sample sizes, so identical percentages may represent different numbers of people.
answers: The chart gives no sample sizes, so identical percentages may represent different numbers of people.
items.notes: 指出比例图缺少分母时的解释限制。

items.zh: 累计总量持续上升，即使每月新增数量已经开始下降。
items.en: The cumulative total continued to rise even after the monthly addition had begun to fall.
answers: The cumulative total continued to rise even after the monthly addition had begun to fall.
items.notes: 区分存量累计与增量速度。

items.zh: 剔除通胀后，表面上的支出增长变成了实际下降。
items.en: After adjustment for inflation, the apparent increase in spending becomes a decline in real terms.
answers: After adjustment for inflation, the apparent increase in spending becomes a decline in real terms.
items.notes: apparent 与 in real terms 区分名义和实际变化。

items.zh: 两个系列的季节性模式相似，但第二个系列总是晚一个月达到峰值。
items.en: The two series follow similar seasonal patterns, but the second consistently peaks one month later.
answers: The two series follow similar seasonal patterns, but the second consistently peaks one month later.
items.notes: follow a pattern 与 peak later 描述形状相似和时间滞后。

items.zh: 占比下降并不意味着数量下降，因为同期总市场扩大了。
items.en: A smaller share does not imply a lower number because the total market expanded over the same period.
answers: A smaller share does not imply a lower number because the total market expanded over the same period.
items.notes: 解释份额与绝对数量可能方向不同。

items.zh: 准确的概述应挑出主导趋势、重要反差和异常点，而不是逐项抄写数字。
items.en: An accurate overview selects the dominant trends, major contrasts, and anomalies rather than listing every figure.
answers: An accurate overview selects the dominant trends, major contrasts, and anomalies rather than listing every figure.
items.notes: 元写作句说明图表概述的筛选原则。

items.zh: 流程始于收集雨水，随后经过过滤和紫外线处理。
items.en: The process begins with the collection of rainwater, which is then filtered and treated with ultraviolet light.
answers: The process begins with the collection of rainwater, which is then filtered and treated with ultraviolet light.
items.notes: which 回指 rainwater；被动语态突出处理流程。

items.zh: 原料进入第一个容器前，会先被称重并检查杂质。
items.en: Before entering the first chamber, the raw material is weighed and checked for impurities.
answers: Before entering the first chamber, the raw material is weighed and checked for impurities.
items.notes: before doing 的逻辑主语为 raw material；两个被动动作并列。

items.zh: 两股水流在冷却阶段之后汇合，再被泵入储水罐。
items.en: The two streams merge after the cooling stage before being pumped into a storage tank.
answers: The two streams merge after the cooling stage before being pumped into a storage tank.
items.notes: after 与 before 标明连续顺序；being pumped 保持被动。

items.zh: 不合格产品会从主线移除并送回破碎环节。
items.en: Products that fail inspection are removed from the main line and returned to the crushing stage.
answers: Products that fail inspection are removed from the main line and returned to the crushing stage.
items.notes: that 从句定义不合格产品；两个被动谓语描述处理。

items.zh: 最后一步产生的热量会回收，用于加热最初的混合物。
items.en: Heat generated in the final stage is recovered and used to warm the initial mixture.
answers: Heat generated in the final stage is recovered and used to warm the initial mixture.
items.notes: generated 后置修饰 heat；recovered and used 平行。

items.zh: 公园北侧新增了一条小路，把停车场与湖边连接起来。
items.en: A new path has been added to the northern side of the park, linking the car park to the lakeside.
answers: A new path has been added to the northern side of the park, linking the car park to the lakeside.
items.notes: 现在完成时描述地图变化；linking 表示新路径功能。

items.zh: 原来的仓库被拆除，腾出的地块改成了住宅。
items.en: The former warehouse has been demolished, and the cleared site has been converted into housing.
answers: The former warehouse has been demolished, and the cleared site has been converted into housing.
items.notes: 两个现在完成时被动描述连续改造。

items.zh: 河流没有改道，但旧桥下游新建了一座人行桥。
items.en: The course of the river is unchanged, but a footbridge has been built downstream from the old bridge.
answers: The course of the river is unchanged, but a footbridge has been built downstream from the old bridge.
items.notes: is unchanged 与 has been built 对照保留和新增。

items.zh: 过去位于入口旁的售票处，现在被咖啡馆占据。
items.en: The site formerly occupied by the ticket office is now used as a café.
answers: The site formerly occupied by the ticket office is now used as a café.
items.notes: formerly occupied by 后置修饰 site；be used as 表示新用途。

items.zh: 村庄向东扩展，而西侧农田基本保持不变。
items.en: The village has expanded eastwards, while the farmland to the west has remained largely unchanged.
answers: The village has expanded eastwards, while the farmland to the west has remained largely unchanged.
items.notes: while 对照发展区和保留区。

items.zh: 粉末加水搅拌，直到形成均匀的糊状物。
items.en: Water is added to the powder, and the mixture is stirred until a uniform paste forms.
answers: Water is added to the powder, and the mixture is stirred until a uniform paste forms.
items.notes: and 连接加水与搅拌两个步骤；until 表示混合终点。

items.zh: 经过干燥后，材料被切成薄片并按尺寸分类。
items.en: Once dried, the material is cut into sheets and sorted by size.
answers: Once dried, the material is cut into sheets and sorted by size.
items.notes: once dried 为被动时间从句省略；by size 表示分类依据。

items.zh: 车辆入口移至南侧，使中央广场成为步行区。
items.en: The vehicle entrance has been relocated to the south, allowing the central square to become pedestrian-only.
answers: The vehicle entrance has been relocated to the south, allowing the central square to become pedestrian-only.
items.notes: allowing 表示入口移动带来的结果。

items.zh: 旧铁路沿线被改造成自行车道，但车站建筑得到保留。
items.en: The former railway line has been converted into a cycle path, while the station building has been retained.
answers: The former railway line has been converted into a cycle path, while the station building has been retained.
items.notes: converted 与 retained 对照用途改变和建筑保留。

items.zh: 液体在密封罐中静置两天，以便固体沉到底部。
items.en: The liquid remains in a sealed tank for two days so that the solids can settle at the bottom.
answers: The liquid remains in a sealed tank for two days so that the solids can settle at the bottom.
items.notes: so that 解释静置目的；settle at the bottom。

items.zh: 完成质量检查后，成品会包装并运往零售商。
items.en: Following a quality check, the finished product is packaged and transported to retailers.
answers: Following a quality check, the finished product is packaged and transported to retailers.
items.notes: following 表示在检查之后；两个被动动作并列。

items.zh: 学校操场面积缩小，为两间新教室腾出了空间。
items.en: The school playground has been reduced in size to make room for two new classrooms.
answers: The school playground has been reduced in size to make room for two new classrooms.
items.notes: to make room for 表示缩小的目的。

items.zh: 图书馆仍位于原处，但内部被重新划分为学习区和活动区。
items.en: The library remains in its original position, although its interior has been divided into study and activity areas.
answers: The library remains in its original position, although its interior has been divided into study and activity areas.
items.notes: although 对照位置未变与内部改变。

items.zh: 气体上升到顶部，通过管道进入第二个处理单元。
items.en: The gas rises to the top and passes through a pipe into the second treatment unit.
answers: The gas rises to the top and passes through a pipe into the second treatment unit.
items.notes: to、through、into 依次描述方向、路径和终点。

items.zh: 在循环结束时，未使用的水会返回起始水箱。
items.en: At the end of the cycle, unused water is returned to the initial tank.
answers: At the end of the cycle, unused water is returned to the initial tank.
items.notes: at the end of 表示流程节点；unused 后置意义由形容词表达。

items.zh: 住宅区与工业区之间新增了一片绿化带。
items.en: A strip of green space has been created between the residential and industrial zones.
answers: A strip of green space has been created between the residential and industrial zones.
items.notes: between 明确两区关系；现在完成时描述地图变化。

items.zh: 主路向北延伸，与新建的环路相接。
items.en: The main road has been extended northwards to meet the new ring road.
answers: The main road has been extended northwards to meet the new ring road.
items.notes: extend northwards 与 meet a road 描述路线变化。

items.zh: 只有通过最后检测的部件才会进入组装线。
items.en: Only components that pass the final test proceed to the assembly line.
answers: Only components that pass the final test proceed to the assembly line.
items.notes: only 限定进入下一步的对象；that 从句说明条件。

items.zh: 地图显示的主要变化，是开放空间从中心转移到了外围。
items.en: The principal change shown on the map is the relocation of open space from the centre to the perimeter.
answers: The principal change shown on the map is the relocation of open space from the centre to the perimeter.
items.notes: relocation of A from B to C 概括空间格局变化。

items.zh: 流程描述应交代阶段顺序、材料变化和循环路径，而不是猜测设计原因。
items.en: A process description should report the sequence of stages, changes to the material, and any cycles without speculating about design motives.
answers: A process description should report the sequence of stages, changes to the material, and any cycles without speculating about design motives.
items.notes: 元写作句限定流程图写作的信息范围。

items.zh: “一致”已经包含相同的含义，通常不需要再加“完全”。
items.en: The word identical already expresses complete sameness, so modifying it with completely is usually redundant.
answers: The word identical already expresses complete sameness, so modifying it with completely is usually redundant.
items.notes: 识别同义程度词叠加造成的冗余。

items.zh: 把“在目前这个时间点”改为“目前”，句意不会损失。
items.en: At present conveys the same meaning more concisely than at this point in time.
answers: At present conveys the same meaning more concisely than at this point in time.
items.notes: 用简洁时间副词替代空泛长短语。

items.zh: “未来的计划”通常可以简化为“计划”，除非要与过去方案对比。
items.en: Future can usually be removed from future plans unless the phrase contrasts them with earlier proposals.
answers: Future can usually be removed from future plans unless the phrase contrasts them with earlier proposals.
items.notes: plan 本身多指未来；有对照时才保留限定。

items.zh: “共同合作”中的“共同”重复了合作的含义。
items.en: The word together is unnecessary in collaborate together because collaboration already implies joint action.
answers: The word together is unnecessary in collaborate together because collaboration already implies joint action.
items.notes: 动词语义已包含共同，不重复添加副词。

items.zh: 与其写“作出减少的决定”，不如直接写“决定减少”。
items.en: Writing that someone decided to reduce something is clearer than saying they made a decision to reduce it when the decision itself is not the focus.
answers: Writing that someone decided to reduce something is clearer than saying they made a decision to reduce it when the decision itself is not the focus.
items.notes: 用动词替代不必要的名词化，使主干更清楚。

items.zh: “原因是因为”重复表达因果，应保留“原因是”或“因为”之一。
items.en: Using because immediately after the reason is needlessly duplicates the causal link.
answers: Using because immediately after the reason is needlessly duplicates the causal link.
items.notes: 避免 the reason is because 的重复因果标记。

items.zh: “每一位所有员工”应改为“每位员工”或“所有员工”。
items.en: Use every employee or all employees, not both determiners before the same noun.
answers: Use every employee or all employees, not both determiners before the same noun.
items.notes: every 与 all 不能同时限定同一名词短语。

items.zh: “包括但不限于”只应在清单确实开放时使用。
items.en: Including but not limited to should be used only when the list genuinely remains open.
answers: Including but not limited to should be used only when the list genuinely remains open.
items.notes: 避免把法律式套话用于封闭列表。

items.zh: 删去“我个人认为”通常不会削弱本来就是作者观点的句子。
items.en: Removing personally from I believe usually loses nothing when the sentence already presents the writer's view.
answers: Removing personally from I believe usually loses nothing when the sentence already presents the writer's view.
items.notes: 第一人称观点中的 personally 往往重复。

items.zh: “各自分别”只需保留一个词，就能表达一一对应。
items.en: Either respectively or individually may be sufficient; using both can repeat the same distributive meaning.
answers: Either respectively or individually may be sufficient; using both can repeat the same distributive meaning.
items.notes: 识别两个分配副词的语义重叠。

items.zh: 将“有能力能够完成”改为“能够完成”，可删除重复情态。
items.en: Saying that someone can complete a task is more concise than combining several expressions of ability.
answers: Saying that someone can complete a task is more concise than combining several expressions of ability.
items.notes: 多个能力表达叠加会使句子笨重。

items.zh: “过去的历史记录”在多数语境下只需写“历史记录”。
items.en: The phrase historical records normally needs no additional reference to the past.
answers: The phrase historical records normally needs no additional reference to the past.
items.notes: historical 已表达过去属性。

items.zh: 不要用“等等”结束一个只列出全部三项的清单。
items.en: Do not add and so on after a list that is intended to contain all three items.
answers: Do not add and so on after a list that is intended to contain all three items.
items.notes: 开放列表标记不能与完整列举同时使用。

items.zh: “可能也许会”应根据把握程度只保留一个情态表达。
items.en: Choose a single modal expression instead of combining may, might, and perhaps in the same claim.
answers: Choose a single modal expression instead of combining may, might, and perhaps in the same claim.
items.notes: 多个不确定标记叠加不会自动更谨慎。

items.zh: “最终结果”有时必要，但若没有中间结果，“结果”已经足够。
items.en: Final adds useful contrast only when an earlier or interim result also exists.
answers: Final adds useful contrast only when an earlier or interim result also exists.
items.notes: 是否保留 final 取决于文本中是否存在阶段对照。

items.zh: “提前预先通知”应简化为“提前通知”。
items.en: Advance notice already means that notice is given beforehand.
answers: Advance notice already means that notice is given beforehand.
items.notes: advance 与 beforehand 的概念不需重复。

items.zh: 一句话连续使用三次“的事实”会掩盖真正的主语和动词。
items.en: Repeated use of the fact that can hide the real subjects and verbs in a sentence.
answers: Repeated use of the fact that can hide the real subjects and verbs in a sentence.
items.notes: 删除空泛名词框架，让具体行为承担句子主干。

items.zh: “返回回来”在英文中只需用 return。
items.en: Return does not need to be combined with come back when both refer to the same movement.
answers: Return does not need to be combined with come back when both refer to the same movement.
items.notes: 避免两个同义方向动词重复表达。

items.zh: 把“关于……方面”改成一个介词，可以让主题关系更直接。
items.en: A single preposition such as on or regarding is usually clearer than a chain of phrases introducing the same topic.
answers: A single preposition such as on or regarding is usually clearer than a chain of phrases introducing the same topic.
items.notes: 主题引介不需要多层介词短语。

items.zh: 若“明显”没有比较基准或证据，应删除或说明依据。
items.en: Clearly should be removed or supported when the basis for the judgement is not evident.
answers: Clearly should be removed or supported when the basis for the judgement is not evident.
items.notes: 评价副词不能代替论证。

items.zh: “真正的实际原因”应根据意思选择“真正原因”或“实际原因”。
items.en: Choose either the real reason or the practical reason according to the intended meaning, rather than combining both adjectives.
answers: Choose either the real reason or the practical reason according to the intended meaning, rather than combining both adjectives.
items.notes: real 与 practical 并非可随意叠加的同义强调。

items.zh: 用“目前”限定结论，比写“永远”更符合短期数据。
items.en: Currently matches short-term evidence more accurately than a claim framed with always.
answers: Currently matches short-term evidence more accurately than a claim framed with always.
items.notes: 时间限定词应与证据覆盖期一致。

items.zh: “绝对必要”可以使用，但应确认强调的是不可缺少，而不只是有帮助。
items.en: Absolutely necessary is appropriate only when something is indispensable, not merely helpful.
answers: Absolutely necessary is appropriate only when something is indispensable, not merely helpful.
items.notes: necessary 本身强度高，absolutely 应有严格依据。

items.zh: 将两个很长的名词化结构改成动词，通常能揭示谁做了什么。
items.en: Turning long nominalisations into verbs often reveals who performed each action.
answers: Turning long nominalisations into verbs often reveals who performed each action.
items.notes: 主动谓语帮助明确施事者和责任。

items.zh: 简洁改写应删除重复信息，而不是删除限制结论所必需的条件。
items.en: Concise revision removes repetition without discarding conditions that define the limits of a claim.
answers: Concise revision removes repetition without discarding conditions that define the limits of a claim.
items.notes: 精简与准确并行，必要限定不能当作冗词。

items.zh: 请说明你为何无法按原日期入住，并提出两个可接受的替代日期。
items.en: Please explain why you cannot move in on the original date and propose two alternative dates that would be acceptable.
answers: Please explain why you cannot move in on the original date and propose two alternative dates that would be acceptable.
items.notes: why 从句说明原因；that 从句限定替代日期。

items.zh: 虽然我理解维修需要时间，但连续三周没有热水已经影响基本生活。
items.en: Although I understand that repairs take time, having no hot water for three consecutive weeks has affected basic living conditions.
answers: Although I understand that repairs take time, having no hot water for three consecutive weeks has affected basic living conditions.
items.notes: although 保持礼貌，让动名词短语清楚陈述影响。

items.zh: 如果退款已经处理，请提供交易编号，以便我向银行查询。
items.en: If the refund has been processed, please provide the transaction reference so that I can trace it with my bank.
answers: If the refund has been processed, please provide the transaction reference so that I can trace it with my bank.
items.notes: if 条件与 so that 目的组合成可执行请求。

items.zh: 我支持在附近增建住房，但希望入口避开上下学最繁忙的路段。
items.en: I support additional housing in the area, provided that its entrance is kept away from the busiest school route.
answers: I support additional housing in the area, provided that its entrance is kept away from the busiest school route.
items.notes: provided that 表达有条件支持，比先支持后完全反对更一致。

items.zh: 附件中的报价不包括安装，因此不能与另一份全包报价直接比较。
items.en: The attached quotation excludes installation and is therefore not directly comparable with the other all-inclusive offer.
answers: The attached quotation excludes installation and is therefore not directly comparable with the other all-inclusive offer.
items.notes: therefore 由范围差异推导不可直接比较。

items.zh: 请确认培训是否必须一次完成，还是可以分两个上午参加。
items.en: Could you confirm whether the training must be completed in one session or may be attended over two mornings?
answers: Could you confirm whether the training must be completed in one session or may be attended over two mornings?
items.notes: whether ... or 提出两个具体选项；语气礼貌。

items.zh: 我错过预约并非忘记，而是提醒短信发送到了旧号码。
items.en: I missed the appointment not because I forgot but because the reminder was sent to an old number.
answers: I missed the appointment not because I forgot but because the reminder was sent to an old number.
items.notes: not because ... but because 准确纠正原因。

items.zh: 该公园需要更多照明，不过灯具应向下照射，以减少对周边住宅的影响。
items.en: The park needs better lighting, but fixtures should direct light downwards to limit the impact on nearby homes.
answers: The park needs better lighting, but fixtures should direct light downwards to limit the impact on nearby homes.
items.notes: but 在需求和减缓措施之间建立平衡。

items.zh: 作为轮班员工，我只能参加晚上六点后的课程，而目前所有场次都在白天。
items.en: As a shift worker, I can attend only after 6 p.m., whereas all current sessions take place during the day.
answers: As a shift worker, I can attend only after 6 p.m., whereas all current sessions take place during the day.
items.notes: as 说明身份背景；whereas 对照可参加时间与现有安排。

items.zh: 这份说明没有写清押金何时退还，也没有说明扣款时如何申诉。
items.en: The guidance states neither when the deposit will be returned nor how a deduction can be challenged.
answers: The guidance states neither when the deposit will be returned nor how a deduction can be challenged.
items.notes: neither ... nor 连接退款时间和申诉方式两个缺失信息。

items.zh: 我建议保留周六班车，因为它是没有汽车的员工唯一可行的通勤方式。
items.en: I recommend retaining the Saturday bus because it is the only viable means of commuting for staff without cars.
answers: I recommend retaining the Saturday bus because it is the only viable means of commuting for staff without cars.
items.notes: because 提供具体受益群体和不可替代性。

items.zh: 我们可以接受分阶段交付，前提是第一批包含冬季急需的设备。
items.en: We can accept delivery in stages, provided that the first batch contains the equipment needed for winter.
answers: We can accept delivery in stages, provided that the first batch contains the equipment needed for winter.
items.notes: provided that 清楚表达接受条件。

items.zh: 报告称咨询具有代表性，却没有列出参与者来自哪些地区。
items.en: The report describes the consultation as representative but does not identify the areas from which participants were drawn.
answers: The report describes the consultation as representative but does not identify the areas from which participants were drawn.
items.notes: but 指出代表性主张缺少的样本信息。

items.zh: 若要我在周五前作出决定，请先发送包含全部费用的最终合同。
items.en: If I am to decide by Friday, please first send the final contract showing all charges.
answers: If I am to decide by Friday, please first send the final contract showing all charges.
items.notes: if ... am to 表示完成任务所需前提；showing 后置修饰合同。

items.zh: 我同意控制噪声的目标，但拟议时段会阻止儿童在放学后使用球场。
items.en: I agree with the aim of controlling noise, but the proposed hours would prevent children from using the pitch after school.
answers: I agree with the aim of controlling noise, but the proposed hours would prevent children from using the pitch after school.
items.notes: 先承认目标，再具体批评手段的意外影响。

items.zh: 即使错误没有改变总额，它也改变了各部门之间的费用分配。
items.en: Although the error did not alter the total, it changed how the cost was allocated between departments.
answers: Although the error did not alter the total, it changed how the cost was allocated between departments.
items.notes: although 对照总额不变与分配改变；how 从句说明影响。

items.zh: 请把我的记录更正为“未参加”，因为我没有同意参加这项研究。
items.en: Please amend my record to show that I did not participate, as I did not consent to take part in the study.
answers: Please amend my record to show that I did not participate, as I did not consent to take part in the study.
items.notes: amend a record to show；consent to do 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 与目前每周送货相比，每两周送一次会使我们需要更多储存空间。
items.en: Fortnightly delivery would require more storage space than the current weekly service.
answers: Fortnightly delivery would require more storage space than the current weekly service.
items.notes: 比较对象为两种配送频率，句子主干简洁。

items.zh: 我无法判断新收费是否合理，因为通知没有说明它涵盖哪些服务。
items.en: I cannot judge whether the new charge is reasonable because the notice does not specify which services it covers.
answers: I cannot judge whether the new charge is reasonable because the notice does not specify which services it covers.
items.notes: whether 为判断对象；because 给出信息不足原因。

items.zh: 如果会议决定公开，请删除能识别个别儿童身份的细节。
items.en: If the meeting decides to publish the document, please remove details that could identify individual children.
answers: If the meeting decides to publish the document, please remove details that could identify individual children.
items.notes: if 引出发布条件；that 从句限定需删除信息。

items.zh: 我们愿意试用新系统，但希望旧渠道保留到数据迁移完成。
items.en: We are willing to test the new system, but we would like the existing channel to remain available until data migration is complete.
answers: We are willing to test the new system, but we would like the existing channel to remain available until data migration is complete.
items.notes: but 表达合作中的保障要求；until 界定保留期限。

items.zh: 请解释为什么同一损坏在第一次检查时属于保修范围，第二次却被排除。
items.en: Please explain why the same fault was covered by the warranty at the first inspection but excluded at the second.
answers: Please explain why the same fault was covered by the warranty at the first inspection but excluded at the second.
items.notes: why 从句内用 but 对照两次不一致处理。

items.zh: 我赞成提高回收率，不过公寓楼需要有足够空间存放分类容器。
items.en: I support higher recycling rates, although apartment buildings need sufficient space for separate containers.
answers: I support higher recycling rates, although apartment buildings need sufficient space for separate containers.
items.notes: although 提出实施条件而不否定目标。

items.zh: 在收到书面确认之前，我不会取消现有预订，以免两个安排都失去。
items.en: I will not cancel the existing booking until I receive written confirmation, in case both arrangements otherwise fall through.
answers: I will not cancel the existing booking until I receive written confirmation, in case both arrangements otherwise fall through.
items.notes: not until 表示行动前提；in case 表示防范双重损失。

items.zh: 有说服力的实用写作应明确说明事实、影响和希望对方采取的行动。
items.en: Effective practical writing states the facts, explains their impact, and specifies the action requested of the reader.
answers: Effective practical writing states the facts, explains their impact, and specifies the action requested of the reader.
items.notes: 元写作句用三个平行谓语概括实用写作结构。
